rulings.text: Can use his ability to cancel a master card multiple times each turn. [ANK 20200420-2]
When using his ability, the cost of the canceled card must still be paid. [LSJ 20090601-2]

Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]

The cost for a canceled non-action-card is still paid, including additional and alternative cost (e.g. to play {100598|Eagle's Sight} to block a Wraith or zombie while {201726|Parijat, the Dark Oracle} is ready the top card of the Library must be burned, even if {100598|Eagle's Sight} was canceled) [RBK cancel-a-card] [ANK 20260216]

rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: "Once each turn" means once during each player's turn. [ANK 20180719-4]

Does not stack with similar effects (or another copy of itself) to provide superior version of the discipline(s) (e.g. {101083|Leech} and {101526|Putrescent Servitude} together does not provide superior [POT]) [ANK 20180111]
Can be used to meet one (but not more than one) of the normal Discipline requirements of a multi-Discipline card. [LSJ 20011217] [LSJ 20090508]
While a minion has an effect that allows them to play cards that require Discipline(s), they do not actually have those Discipline(s). [LSJ 19980303]

Multiple similar effects (e.g. two {100978|Infernal Familiar}, or {200616|Ian Forestal} with an {100978|Infernal Familiar}) cannot be used to meet the requirements of a multi-Discipline card that the minion is missing one or more Disciplines to play. [LSJ 20020218]

While using their ability to meet a discipline requirement, they also meet that requirement for any other cards associated with the original effect (e.g. meeting the [ani] requirement for {101342|Pack Alpha} or {101255|Muricia's Call} also meets the [ani] requirement for the {101550|Raven Spy} employed by that effect). [LSJ 20080205-2] [LSJ 20060417]
The ally counts as "independent" when playing cards as a vampire [LSJ 20020503] [LSJ 20060126]

Once the range is set, no other effect can be used to reset the range that round, but other pre-range effects can be played afterwards. Skip the Determine Range step for that round. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20180720]
If another effect was already setting that round's range (e.g. {101276|Neutral Guard}), that effect has priority. [PIB 20120214]

text:
Werewolf with 4 life. 2 strength, 1 bleed.
Ananasi gets an optional maneuver each combat. Once each combat, she can burn a life during the press step to get a press and set the range in the next round of that combat, if any. She can gain a life as a +1 stealth action. Once each turn, she may play a card that requires basic Animalism [ani] as a vampire.

es.name: La Prensa Libre Anarquista
es.text:
Única. Requiere a un Anarquista preparado.
Pon esta carta en juego. Gírala para darle +1 de intercepción a un Anarquista que controles. Gírala después de que un Anarquista cace con éxito para añadir 1 de sangre a ese Anarquista.

fr.name: Presse libre Anarch
fr.text:
Unique. Requiert un Anarch disponible.
Mettez cette carte en jeu. Vous pouvez l'incliner pour donner +1 en interception à un Anarch que vous contrôlez. Vous pouvez l'incliner après qu'un Anarch chasse avec succès pour ajouter 1 point de sang à cet Anarch.

rulings.text: A hunt is not successful if no blood is gained, even if the hunt action is still successful. [LSJ 20050720-2]
Using it for the hunt bonus does not make the hunt an action "requiring an Anarch". [ANK 20220317]

text:
Unique. Requires a ready Anarch.
Put this card in play. You can lock this card to give an Anarch you control +1 intercept. You can lock this card after an Anarch successfully hunts to add 1 blood to that Anarch.

Equipment.
The anarch with this equipment gets +1 stealth on actions that require an anarch. Titled non-Anarch vampires get +1 strength in combat with this minion. A minion may have only one Anarch Manifesto.

es.name: Ferrocarril Anarquista
es.text:
Lugar único.
Gírala para darle +1 de sigilo a un Anarquista.
es.flavor:
El Tren de la Libertad te llevará de regreso al este, al menos hasta Staten Island. Si quieres cruzar el puente cuando llegues allí, probablemente estarás por tu cuenta.
Almiro Suarez, Anarquista Tremere

fr.name: Chemin de fer Anarch
fr.text:
Lieu unique.
Vous pouvez l'incliner pour donner +1 en discrétion à un Anarch.
fr.flavor:
Le Train de la Liberté te ramènera à l'est, au moins jusqu'à Staten Island. Une fois arrivé, tu devras probablement te débrouiller tout seul si tu veux traverser le pont.
Almiro Suarez, Anarch Tremere

text:
Unique location.
You can lock this card to give an Anarch +1 stealth.
flavor:
The Freedom Train will get you back east, at least as far as Staten Island. If you want to cross the bridge when you get there, you'll probably be on your own.
Almiro Suarez, Tremere Anarch

rulings.text: The cost is cumulative if they are multiple copies in play. [LSJ 19980225]
If a Methuselah controls no ready Anarch by the end of the unlock phase, they must burn 1 pool, even if they had a ready Anarch at some point during the unlock phase. [LSJ 20080106]

text: Put this card in play. A Methuselah not controlling a ready Anarch burns 1 pool during their unlock phase. Vampires can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.
flavor:
The Ventrue are working with us on this? Those Anarchs must be more annoying than I thought.
Brujah, Rome 2002 Winter Storyline

text:
Requires an Anarch.
Successful referendum means each ready Anarch gains 1 blood and each Methuselah controlling an Anarch gains 1 pool.

+1 stealth action. Requires a ready, non-anarch, titled vampire.
This vampire becomes Anarch. If he or she had a city title, put this card on him or her as a title card to represent the title of baron of the same city. Minions without titles cannot block this action.

es.name: Alborotador anarquista
es.text:
Única.
Pon esta carta en juego. Durante tu fase de enderezamiento, puedes darle el control del Alborotador anarquista a tu presa y girar hasta dos vampiros que controle o bien quemar un equipo de uno de sus siervos.
es.flavor:
Soy el acusador y vengador de la sangre...
William Blake, "El fantasma de Abel"

fr.name: Anarch fauteur de trouble
fr.text:
Unique.
Mettez cette carte en jeu. Durant votre phase de redressement, vous pouvez donner le contrôle de l'Anarch fauteur de trouble à votre proie et soit incliner jusqu'à deux vampires sous son contrôle, soit brûler un équipement sur l'un de ses serviteurs.
fr.flavor:
Je suis l'accusateur et le vengeur du sang...
William Blake, "Le Fantôme d'Abel"

rulings.text: Can lock a vampire that is already locked. [PIB 20121031]

text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. During your unlock phase, you can give your prey control of the Anarch Troublemaker and either lock up to two vampires they control or burn an equipment on one of their minions.
flavor:
I am the accuser and avenger of blood...
William Blake, "The Ghost of Abel"

es.name: Alzamiento Anarquista
es.text: Si el referéndum prospera, cada Matusalén quema 1 de reserva sanguínea por cada siervo que controle.
es.flavor:
Todos somos hermanos de la opresión, y hoy, los hermanos de la opresión se identifican entre sí en todo el mundo.
Malcolm X.

fr.name: Soulèvement d'anarchistes
fr.text: Si le référendum passe, chaque Mathusalem brûle 1 point de réserve pour chaque serviteur sous son contrôle.
fr.flavor:
Nous sommes tous frères d'oppression, et aujourd'hui les frères d'oppression sont associés aux autres tout autour du monde.
Malcolm X.

rulings.text: If multiple ousts happen, players whose prey gets ousted get a victory point, even if they are being ousted themselves. Only the surviving ones get 6 pool from the oust of their prey (not of their grand-prey). [LSJ 20000309]

text: Successful referendum means each Methuselah burns 1 pool for each minion they control.
flavor:
We are all brothers of oppression, and today, brothers of oppression are identified with each other all over the world.
Malcolm X

rulings.text: Burns the target vampire when the target is reduced to zero blood in combat, regardless of the source of the loss. [RTR 19980623]
Will not burn a vampire for entering a combat with zero blood: there must be an actual blood loss. [RTR 19980623]
Diablerie does not trigger Anathema. [LSJ 20021122-2] [ANK 20211112]
Does not trigger if the vampire is burned by aggravated damage during damage resolution. [LSJ 20021120]
Damage done by combat effects after combat ends do not trigger Anathema. [LSJ 19980225]
Multiple Anathemas don't multiply the pool gain. Once one Anathema resolves it burns the vampire and the others are burned before they get to resolve. [LSJ 20021117]
It is controlled by the controller of the minion it's on - it is not removed when another Methuselah is ousted. [PIB 20121028]

text:
Requires a prince or justicar.
Choose a ready vampire. Successful referendum means this card is put on the chosen vampire. If the attached vampire's blood is reduced to 0 in combat, the attached vampire is burned and the Methuselah controlling the opposing minion gains pool equal to the attached vampire's capacity.

Unique master.
Put this card on a Laibon with capacity above 4. This Laibon has +1 bleed and gets an additional vote in any referendum he or she calls.

Requires a ready Laibon.
[aus] [REACTION] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[AUS] [ACTION MODIFIER] Only usable during a bleed action. +1 bleed (limited).
flavor:
Take care, let us not die from blessings like the giants did.
Kenyatta, Ishtarri

Once in play, can be equipped from the minion it's on (rulebook action) by another minion that does not meet the requirements. [ANK 20180719-3]

text:
Unique.
The bearer gets +1 intercept during actions requiring Dominate [dom] or Presence [pre].

es.name: Influencia de los Ancianos
es.text:
Sólo se puede jugar o proponer un ejemplar de esta carta por partida.
Si el referéndum prospera, cada Matusalén puede elegir a un vampiro preparado que controle; cada Matusalén gana tanta reserva sanguínea como capacidad tenga el vampiro elegido, y luego quema 5 de reserva sanguínea.

fr.name: Influence antique
fr.text:
Pas plus d'un seul exemplaire ne peut être joué ou appelé par partie.
Si le référendum passe, chaque Mathusalem peut choisir un vampire disponible sous son contrôle ; chaque Mathusalem gagne autant de points de réserve que la capacité du vampire de son choix, puis brûle 5 points de réserve.

rulings.text: Applies a pool gain then a pool loss. {101406|Poison Pill} register a 5 pool loss in all cases, a Methuselah cannot withdraw even if the total was positive. [ANK 20180813]

Burning the card for a vote is not considered playing it. [ANK 20210309-2]

text:
Only one Ancient Influence can be played or called in a game.

text:
Only usable at close range.
[aus] Strike: dodge.
[obe] Strike: hand strike. Combat ends immediately after the resolution of this strike.
[OBE] As [obe] above, with first strike.
flavor:
Just relax; this won't hurt, much.
Blanche Hill, Salubri

Requirements apply but do not count as requirements for the action (eg. you cannot use CrimethInc. if the card requires an Anarch). [LSJ 20100725] [LSJ 20100303] [ANK 20180817]

text:
Master: out-of-turn. Requires a ready imbued.
Unlock an imbued, or equip a ready imbued you control with an equipment from your hand (requirements must be met; pay cost as normal). Not usable during combat.
flavor:
They also serve who only stand and wait.
John Milton, "On His Blindness"

text:
Only usable before range is determined. A vampire can play only one Angel's Gift each round.
[COMBAT] Equip this vampire with a melee weapon from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal).
[COMBAT] This round, this vampire gets 1 optional maneuver, only usable to get to close range.

rulings.text: Anima Gathering does not burn if the vampire moves through the uncontrolled region (via {100131|Banishment}, etc.) and returns to play unlocked. [LSJ 20060808-2] [LSJ 20060213]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[aus] Put this card on this acting vampire and choose another minion you control. Burn this card if this minion unlocks. During your unlock phase, you may choose not to unlock this minion as normal. The chosen minion gets +2 intercept.
[AUS] As above, and the chosen minion also gets +1 bleed.

rulings.text: Cannot be used during a referendum that is automatically passing. [PIB 20150105] [LSJ 19980107]

text:
Only usable during a referendum.
[ani][obf] This vampire gains 1 vote.
[ANI][OBF] This vampire gains 3 votes.

es.name: Animalismo
es.text:
Disciplina.
Ponle esta carta a un vampiro. Este vampiro obtiene +1 nivel de Animalismo [ani] y +1 de capacidad. No se le puede poner a un vampiro con Animalismo superior [ANI].

fr.name: Animalisme
fr.text:
Discipline.
Mettez cette carte sur un vampire. Ce vampire reçoit +1 niveau d'Animalisme [ani] et +1 capacité. Ne peut être mis sur un vampire avec le niveau supérieur d'Animalisme [ANI].

text:
Discipline.
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Animalism [ani] and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Animalism [ANI].

es.name: La Ciudadela de Ankara, Turquía
es.text:
Mientras esté en juego, esta carta de equipo representa un lugar y no cuenta como equipo. Única.
Jugar cartas que cuesten sangre y no sean modificadores de acción le cuesta a este vampiro la mitad de sangre, redondeando hacia abajo (primero va la multiplicación y la división, y luego la suma y la resta).

fr.name: La citadelle d'Ankara, Turquie
fr.text:
Tant qu'elle est en jeu, cette carte d'équipement représente un lieu et ne compte pas comme équipement. Unique.
Les cartes qui ne sont pas des modificateurs d'action coûtent moitié moins de points de sang à jouer, arrondie à l'inférieur (les multiplications et divisions s'appliquent en premier, suivies par les additions et soustractions).

rulings.text: Concerning the cost of the cards, multiplications and divisions are applied first, followed by additions and subtractions. [RTR 20070707]
May be put on any minion if the controller changes. If the new controller has no minions, it is burned. [RTR 19960112]
An action targeting it (eg. {100391|Conceal}) is directed at the Methuselah controlling it, not the minion it is on. [LSJ 20090324]"
Is an equipment while in hand, library or ash heap, both equipment and location when played (eg. for cost-related effects), and just a location while in play. [LSJ 20080114]

text:
While in play, this equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment. Unique.
Non-action modifier cards costing blood cost this vampire half as much blood to play, rounded down (multiplication and division are handled first, followed by addition and subtraction).

rulings.text: The equipment or retainer must be announced by name, and in hand, when the card or effect is declared (before the card, if any, is replaced), but need not to be shown until the effect resolves. [LSJ 20100130] [ANK 20180925-2] [LSJ 19991207]
rulings.group: Equip or employ another card from hand

When choosing a card whose effect depend on Discipline level, the vampire decides in respect to his disciplines the normal way. [LSJ 20080803]
Is an action of the appropriate type for the chosen card (recruit/employ/equip). [TOM 19960130]

text:
+3 stealth equip action. Requires a vampire.
Equip this vampire with a non-location equipment card from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal).

Unique.
Put this card in play. During each Methuselah's unlock phase, that Methuselah burns 1 pool unless they burn a vampire they control with capacity 4 or more to burn this card.

Gehenna.
Once each master phase, a Methuselah can use a master phase action to exchange a master card in his or her hand for one in his or her ash heap.
flavor:
The Red Star shines brightly -- more so, I am told, to those with the gift of superior sight, but it is obvious even to me. Can you truly not see that Gehenna is upon us?
Prince Giangaleazzo, Lasombra antitribu

text:
[aus] Strike: hand strike or use a melee weapon strike. This strike is at +2 damage.
[AUS] Burn 1 blood to cancel the opposing minion's strike card as it is played, and its cost is not paid (the minion chooses a strike again).

+3 stealth action.
Ⓓ Put this card on a non-Sabbat vampire with capacity less than 8. The vampire with this card cannot hunt. If he or she must hunt, he or she locks and goes to torpor instead. Burn this card during this vampire's discard phase.

rulings.text: Can be played at any time in combat, even if there is no damage to prevent yet. [LSJ 20010315]

text:
Do not replace until after combat.
[chi] This vampire can prevent 1 damage each round this combat.
[CHI] This vampire can prevent 2 damage each round this combat.
flavor:
Girls would come out of inadequate graves to stand near...
Rainer Maria Rilke, "Duino Elegy #7"

es.name: Aportación
es.text:
[tha] Acoso, sólo utilizable para continuar el combate.
[THA] Maniobra.
es.flavor:
El arma voló de mis manos como si Dios mismo hubiera intervenido.
Jacob Bragg

fr.name: Télétransport
fr.text:
[tha] Poursuivre, seulement utilisable pour continuer le combat.
[THA] Manœuvrer.
fr.flavor:
Le flingue s'envola de mes mains comme si Dieu Lui-même avait choisi d'intervenir.
Jacob Bragg

text:
[tha] Press, only usable to continue combat.
[THA] Maneuver.
flavor:
The gun flew from my hands like God himself chose to intervene.
Jacob Bragg

[ani] El siervo oponente recibe 1 de daño ambiental a distancia por asalto en este combate durante la resolución normal de ataques.
[ANI] Como antes, pero recibe 2 de daño ambiental a distancia.

fr.name: Corneilles noires
fr.text:
Seulement utilisable avant l'étape de manœuvre. Un vampire ne peut en jouer qu'un seul exemplaire par combat.
[ani] Le serviteur opposé subit 1 point de dégâts environnementaux à toute portée chaque round de ce combat durant la résolution des frappes normales.
[ANI] Comme ci-dessus, mais pour 2 points de dégâts environnementaux à toute portée.

rulings.text: Damage is inflicted even against a dodge. A "strike: combat ends" ends combat before damage is applied, as will a combattant going to torpor during first strike. [RTR 19941109] [TOM 19951216] [PIB 20140324] [ANK 20200422]

text:
Only usable before range is determined. A vampire can play only one Carrion Crows each combat.
[ani] This combat, the opposing minion takes 1R environmental damage each round during normal strike resolution.
[ANI] As above, but for 2R environmental damage.

Master.
Put this card in play. Brujah princes and Brujah justicars get +1 stealth on bleed actions. Any minion may burn this card as a Ⓓ action; Ventrue and Malkavians get -1 stealth on that action.

es.name: Cárnicas Carver
es.text:
Lugar único.
Después de que un vampiro con capacidad 3 o menos entre en letargo, ponle una ficha de rehén a él. Los vampiros con fichas de rehén no se pueden pasar a la zona preparada ni ser diabolizados. Gírala durante tu fase heril para añadir X de sangre a un vampiro preparado que controles, donde X es el número de vampiros en letargo con fichas de rehén. Durante cualquier fase de enderezamiento, cualquier vampiro preparado puede quemar 2 de sangre para quemar las fichas de rehén de cualquier vampiro. Después de que esta carta deje el juego, quema todas las fichas de rehén.

fr.name: Entrepôt de viande de Carver
fr.text:
Lieu unique.
Après qu'un vampire de capacité 3 ou moins va en torpeur, mettez 1 compteur otage sur lui. Les vampires avec au moins un compteur otage ne peuvent pas être déplacés vers la région disponible ou être diablés. Vous pouvez incliner ce lieu durant votre phase de maître pour ajouter X points de sang à un vampire disponible que vous contrôlez, où X est le nombre de vampires avec au moins un compteur otage. Durant n'importe quelle phase de redressement, n'importe quel vampire disponible peut brûler 2 points de sang pour brûler les compteurs otage de n'importe quel vampire. Après que cette carte quitte le jeu, brûlez tous les compteurs otage.

rulings.text: The effect to burn a hostage counter can be done only once per turn. [ANK 20200729] [RBK wording-templates]

text:
Unique location.
After a vampire with capacity 3 or less goes to torpor, put 1 hostage counter on them. Vampires with any hostage counters cannot be moved to the ready region or be diablerized. Lock during your master phase to add X blood to a ready vampire you control, where X is the number of vampires with any hostage counters. During any unlock phase, any ready vampire can burn 2 blood to burn any vampire's hostage counters. After this card leaves play, burn all the hostage counters.

rulings.text: "Before resolution" means after strikes have been declared but before they resolve. [RTR 19990105]
Cannot be played on an opponent's weapon. [LSJ 20020425]

text:
Ammo.
Only usable before resolution of a gun's strike. For the remainder of combat, once each round when the bearer strikes with this gun, the bearer gets an optional additional strike (limited), only usable to strike with this gun. No more than one ammo card can be used on a gun each combat.

+1 stealth action.
[cel] Ⓓ Bleed. If more than 1 pool is bled with this action, ignore the excess.
[CEL] Ⓓ Bleed any Methuselah. If more than 1 pool is bled with this action, ignore the excess.

rulings.text: May be put on any minion if the controller changes. If the new controller has no minions, it is burned. [RTR 19960112]
An action targeting it (eg. {100391|Conceal}) is directed at the Methuselah controlling it, not the minion it is on. [LSJ 20090324]"
Is an equipment while in hand, library or ash heap, both equipment and location when played (eg. for cost-related effects), and just a location while in play. [LSJ 20080114]
The discount applies to the action, regardless of who pays. [PIB 20110918] [LSJ 20020304-2]

text:
This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
When attempting to rescue a vampire from torpor, the vampire with this location gets +1 stealth and burns 1 less blood if successful.

rulings.text: [PRE] Damage is done by the vampire (not environmental). [RTR 19970630] [LSJ 19990723]
[PRE] If the strike is dodged, no damage is done. [LSJ 19980526] [RTR 20041202] [LSJ 20070124]

(Partial reversal of RTR 20010711) [RTR 20020501] [LSJ 19980109]
[PRE]Any blood loss occurs after combat (and will not trigger {100060|Anathema} or be available for {101945|Taste of Vitae}, etc). [LSJ 20031123]
[PRE]Damage is applied after combat, so cannot be prevented by combat cards. [LSJ 20100204-2]
[PRE]Is a damage dealing effect and can be modified by other effects like {100489|Dam the Heart's River}. [ANK 20170111] [PIB 20130319]

text:
[pre] Strike: combat ends.
[PRE] As above, and after combat ends, if the range is close, this vampire inflicts 1 unpreventable damage on the opposing minion.

es.name: Guiado por gatos
es.text:
[ani] Sólo utilizable por un vampiro girado que ha bloqueado, tras la resolución del bloqueo. Endereza a este vampiro.
[ANI] +1 de intercepción.
es.flavor:
Los amantes fervientes, los sabios venerables,
Sienten, cuando maduros, igual predilección
Por los gatos, orgullo de la casa, que son
Como ellos sedentarios y al frío vulnerables.
Charles Baudelaire, "Los gatos"

fr.name: Conseil des chats
fr.text:
[ani] Seulement utilisable par un vampire incliné qui a bloqué, après la résolution du blocage. Redressez ce vampire.
[ANI] +1 en interception.
fr.flavor:
Amis de la science et de la volupté
Ils cherchent le silence et l'horreur des ténèbres ;
L'Érèbe les eût pris pour ses coursiers funèbres,
S'ils pouvaient au servage incliner leur fierté.
Charles Baudelaire, "Les Chats"

rulings.text: [ani] Is played after all combats are handled. [RTR 19980623] [LSJ 20040219] [ANK 20221130]
[ani] Cannot be played if the vampire is in torpor, for example if he went into torpor during the combat resulting from the block. [RBK reaction-cards]

text:
[ani] Only usable by a locked vampire who has blocked, after block resolution. Unlock this vampire.
[ANI] +1 intercept.
flavor:
Your cat, now, linked to learning and to love,
Exhibits a taste for silences and gloom —
Would make a splendid messenger of doom
If his fierce pride would condescend to serve.
Charles Baudelaire, "Cats"

rulings.text: Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [TOM 19960225]

text:
Not usable on the first round of combat.
[tha] Strike: hand strike at +2 damage.
[THA] Strike: hand strike at +4 damage.
flavor:
I like the look of agony
Because I know it's true.
Emily Dickinson, "Untitled"

rulings.text: Cards and effects that can be played "after resolution" (and only them) can be played after the unlock effect. [ANK 20190113]
Takes the modified cost into account if it has been modified (eg. by {101807|The Slow Withering} or {100071|The Ankara Citadel, Turkey}). [PIB 20150725] [LSJ 20100429]
Applies even if the vampire it's on is not the one paying the cost (eg. rescuing from torpor). [LSJ 20100315]
"Once each turn" means once during each player's turn. [ANK 20180719-4]
The vampire's controller chooses to use the effect of the card or not. [ANK 20210309-3]
rulings.group: Master on vampire who can use it

text:
Archetype.
Put this card on a vampire you control. Once each turn, this vampire can burn 1 blood to unlock after performing a successful action costing blood. A vampire can have only one archetype.

rulings.text: The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]
rulings.group: Action requirements from a card in play

text:
Unique location.
Ministries you control can put 1 corruption counter on an ally or younger vampire controlled by your prey as a Ⓓ action. If the action is successful and the number of your corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds their capacity or cost, you can burn those counters to steal that minion.

Discipline.
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Celerity [cel] and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Celerity [CEL].

+1 stealth action.
[aus] Ⓓ Choose a Methuselah. That Methuselah selects all but one of the cards in his or her hand and shows them to you.
[AUS] As above, but all Methuselahs are chosen.

rulings.text: The ability to increase bleed can only be used during a bleed action before Action Resolution. [ANK 20231124] [LSJ 19970718]
rulings.group: Permanents that increase bleed amount during an action

text:
Unique master.
Put this card on a ready Black Hand vampire. During an action, this Black Hand vampire can lock to give any other Sabbat vampire +1 bleed or 2 additional votes for the current action. During an action, this Black Hand vampire can lock to give any other Black Hand vampire +1 intercept.

Master: unique location.
Weapons cost an additional pool.

rulings.text: Cannot bring more than one copy of a unique vampire out, by the rule prohibiting self-contesting. [LSJ 20040722]
If a commanded vampire is burned (eg. {100492|Daring the Dawn}), he is not brought back to the crypt. [LSJ 20040616]
If none of the vampires can bleed (eg. {200001|Aabbt Kindred}), they all go to the bottom of the crypt. [LSJ 20040518-2]
Crypt cards cannot be put in the library and library cards cannot be put in the crypt. [LSJ 20041201]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[dom] Put X younger vampires from your uncontrolled region in play with 1 blood from the blood bank each (and with any blood they already have). You cannot choose any unique vampires already in play. Those vampires must bleed. When one of them bleeds successfully, or when all that can bleed have, move them all to the bottom of your crypt.
[DOM] As above, but move X+1 younger vampires.

rulings.text: A second copy allows a second use in the same combat. [ANK 20230316]

text:
Weapon.
3 damage as a strike, only usable once each combat.

+1 stealth action.
[nec] Ⓓ Remove a mortal or ghoul (ally or retainer) from the game.
[NEC] Ⓓ Remove a non-wraith ally or retainer or a vampire with capacity 2 or less from the game.

rulings.text: The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]

rulings.text: The action provided by the equipment to the attached minion fizzles (resolves successfully for no effect) if the equipment is not attached to the acting minion when the action resolves unblocked. [RTR 19960221]

text:
Unique equipment. Requires a ready priscus, cardinal or regent.
The priscus, cardinal or regent with this equipment can give each other ready Sabbat vampire you control 1 blood from the blood bank as a +1 stealth action.

rulings.text: Cannot be used on a vampire who merged last turn: merging is not entering play. [PIB 20150728]
Can be used on one of your own vampire to make it Anarch. [LSJ 20080803-2]
Counts as requiring an Anarch (for eg. {101435|Powerbase: Los Angeles}). [LSJ 20080603] [LSJ 20050128]

text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a baron.
Ⓓ Take control of a younger vampire with capacity of X who entered play since your last minion phase. That vampire becomes Anarch.
flavor:
He who seeks to deceive will always find someone who will allow himself to be deceived.
Niccolò Machiavelli, "The Prince"

rulings.text:
[SPI]If the combat continues or a new combat begins, the after combat effect does not happen/is not usable (e.g. {101507|Psyche!}, {101950|Telepathic Tracking}).
(Partial reversal of RTR 20010711) [RTR 20020501] [LSJ 19980109]

When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]
[spi]The optional press can only be used during the current round. [TOM 19960521]
[SPI]An action cannot continue "as if unblocked" after a combat resulting from a successful action (e.g. {100266|Bum's Rush}). [RTR 19970630]
rulings.group: Action continues not specifically from block

rulings.text: [SPI]If the action continues "as if unblocked", all action modifiers and reaction cards are still in effect, even those pertaining to a successful block. [RTR 19941109] [ANK 20190116]
[SPI]If the action continues "as if unblocked", any Methuselahs that have declined to block before do not get another opportunity to block. [ANK 20190116]

[SPI]For actions resulting from an action card, "continue as if unblocked" moves the action card from the ash heap (where it went when the action was blocked) to limbo (where it should be if the action is not blocked). If the action card is not in the ash heap, then the action cannot be continued. [LSJ 20070808-1]

text:
[ani] Maneuver.
[spi] Press, or maneuver with an optional press.
[SPI] Only usable at long range. Strike: combat ends. If this vampire was blocked while performing an action other than bleeding, the action continues as if unblocked.
flavor:
Yes, yes. Rush on by, you hot-headed cur. Just us trees here; nothing to interest you.
The Siamese, Ahrimane

rulings.text: [REACTION] Can be used only when reactions can be used (unlocked or with a wake effect). It does not count as playing a reaction card. [LSJ 20070403] [LSJ 20070413]
[REACTION] The action still continues until the end of combat. The acting minion stays the same, effects applied during the action still applies during combat. [LSJ 20070217]
[REACTION] The action fails: it might be continued (eg. {100771|Form of Mist}) but still fails anyway. [LSJ 20070214-2]
Cannot be used while a block is being attempted, or has already been successful. [ANK 20260316] [LSJ 20041022]

[REACTION]If the action fails, modifiers and reactions that can be used at the end/after an action can still be used afterwards (after combat, if any). [ANK 20221205] [ANK 20220118] [RTR 20180719] [LSJ 20041022]
[REACTION]If the action fails, the action has reached resolution, so is subject to NRA (Non Repeatable Action) rules. [ANK 20211015] [RTR 20180719]
[REACTION]If an action fails, it was not blocked. Cards/effects depending on a block (e.g. {101222|Mirror Image}, [FOR] {100788|Freak Drive}) cannot be played/used. [LSJ 20070219]

text: [REACTION] [2 CONVICTION] Only usable when a monster controlled by another Methuselah is taking an action directed at you or an imbued controlled by any player. The action fails and the acting monster enters combat with this imbued instead.

es.name: Cambio de objetivo
es.text:
Sólo utilizable si este siervo es bloqueado, antes de la resolución del bloqueo.
Endereza a este siervo, y la acción termina (sin éxito). Este siervo no puede volver a realizar la misma acción en este turno.

fr.name: Changement de cible
fr.text:
Seulement utilisable si ce serviteur est bloqué, avant la résolution du blocage.
Redressez ce serviteur et l'action prend fin (sans succès). Ce serviteur ne peut pas effectuer la même action à nouveau ce tour-ci.

rulings.text: The action has reached resolution, so is subject to NRA (Non Repeatable Action) rules. [LSJ 20070709]
Actions without card (provided by the rulebook) are not "the same" as actions provided by cards (played or in play). [LSJ 20060522]  [LSJ 20060824] [LSJ 20080725] [LSJ 20090617]

Actions without card (provided by the rulebook) can be repeated if they have different targets. Equipping from a minion targets the equipments: if one equipment is the same, the action is the same. [RTR 19950509] [LSJ 20080710] [ANK 20200502]
Actions provided by different cards in play are not the same, even if the cards have the same name. [LSJ 20080725]
Is played after a minion successfully blocks, before the blocker is locked and combat begins. It cannot be used if the action is ended without being blocked. [LSJ 19980224] [RTR 19991206]
Effects triggered when the action is blocked are still applied (eg. {102076|Unleash Hell's Fury}, {102045|Truth of Blood}, {100018|Aching Beauty}). [RTR 19991206]
No other modifier or reaction can be played afterwards: the action has ended. [LSJ 20010803-1] [RTR 20180719]
If the card prevents the acting minion from performing a mandatory action, he is stuck and cannot act. [LSJ 19980112]
If used while leaving torpor, the blocker does not get an opportunity for diablerie. [LSJ 20050105-2]

text:
Only usable if this minion is blocked, before block resolution.
Unlock this minion. The action ends (unsuccessfully). This minion cannot perform the same action again this turn.

es.name: Metamorfo
es.text:
[vic] Sólo utilizable durante una acción de sangrado. +1 de sangrado (limitada).
[VIC] +1 de sigilo.

fr.name: Changelin
fr.text:
[vic] Seulement utilisable durant une action de morsure. +1 en morsure (limité).
[VIC] +1 en discrétion.

text:
[vic] Only usable during a bleed action. +1 bleed (limited).
[VIC] +1 stealth.

rulings.text: The superior Obfuscate is not optional. [RTR 19980707] [LSJ 19980722]

text:
Unique equipment.
The vampire with this equipment has superior Obfuscate [OBF]. The vampire with this equipment may burn it to get +2 intercept for the current action.

rulings.text: Applies to an action if any one of its targets would be enough to enable his effect. [LSJ 20080809-2] [RTR 20081119]
Cannot be used while a block is being attempted, or has already been successful. [ANK 20260316] [LSJ 20041022]

If the action fails, modifiers and reactions that can be used at the end/after an action can still be used afterwards (after combat, if any). [ANK 20221205] [ANK 20220118] [RTR 20180719] [LSJ 20041022]

The vampire's controller chooses to burn the card to fail an action or not.
rulings.group: Master on vampire who can use it

text:
Master.
Put this card on a vampire you control. Other Methuselahs' actions targeting this vampire cost an additional blood. This vampire can burn this card to cause an action targeting him or her to fail. A vampire may have only one Chanjelin Ward.
flavor: As Hannigan raised his hand to turn the knob, his knees buckled and the room spun. When his vision cleared, he found himself lying in the snow with the cold glow of pre-dawn light threatening him.

es.name: Canal 10
es.text:
Lugar único.
Gírala para darle a un siervo que controles +2 de intercepción. No se puede usar durante la primera acción de una fase servil.
es.flavor: Están muy contentos de ver una historia verídica que les ayude a pasar el tiempo, incluso aunque proceda de fuentes desconocidas. Ambos salimos ganando.

fr.name: Canal 10
fr.text:
Lieu unique.
Vous pouvez l'incliner pour donner +2 en interception à un serviteur que vous contrôlez. Non utilisable durant la première action d'une phase de serviteur.
fr.flavor:
Ils sont plus qu'heureux d'avoir une vraie histoire à passer en direct, même d'une source inconnue. C'est gagnant-gagnant.
Cock Robin, Justicar Nosferatu

rulings.text: Cannot be used if the first action was cancelled "as played" ({100545|Direct Intervention}) but can be used when the first action was cancelled after it was played ({101935|Tangle Atropos' Hand}). [LSJ 20100505] [ANK 20210124]

text:
Unique location.
You can lock this card to give a minion you control +2 intercept. Not usable during the first action in a minion phase.
flavor:
They're only too happy to get a real story to help fill the hour, even from unknown sources. We both win.
Cock Robin, Nosferatu Justicar

rulings.text: Adding damage to a strike that does not deal damage has no effect, so the strike still will not do damage. [RTR 19960221]
Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [RTR 19970630] [TOM 19960225]

text: Strike: hand strike or use a melee weapon strike. This strike is at +1 damage.
flavor:
Conquer yourself rather than the world.
Rene Descartes

es.name: Capilla
es.text:
Lugar único.
Gira esta carta y quema 1 de reserva sanguínea o 1 de sangre de un Tremere preparado que controles durante tu fase heril para pasar un Tremere del letargo a la zona preparada de su controlador.
es.flavor:
En libros que son como altares donde nos arrodillamos
Para consagrar el parpadeo, no la llama.
Edwin Arlington Robinson, "George Crabbe"

fr.name: Fondation
fr.text:
Lieu unique.
Vous pouvez incliner cette carte et brûler 1 point de réserve ou 1 point de sang d'un Tremere disponible que vous contrôlez durant votre phase de maître pour déplacer un Tremere de torpeur vers la région disponible de son contrôleur.
fr.flavor:
Dans les livres qui sont comme des autels devant lesquels on s'agenouille,
Pour consacrer la lueur vacillante et non la flamme.
Edwin Arlington Robinson, "George Crabbe"

text:
Unique location.
You can lock this card and burn 1 pool or 1 blood from a ready Tremere you control during your master phase to move a Tremere from torpor to their controller's ready region.
flavor:
In books that are as altars where we kneel
To consecrate the flicker, not the flame.
Edwin Arlington Robinson, "George Crabbe"

rulings.text: [spi]/[SPI] Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [TOM 19960225]

[for]If the action is unblocked when it resolves and the target is unlocked, the action "fizzles" (cost, if any, is paid, and it is considered successful, but has no effect). [ANK 20210124] [LSJ 20070411] [LSJ 20090514]

When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

[spi]/[SPI]Once the range is set, no other effect can be used to reset the range that round, but other pre-range effects can be played afterwards. Skip the Determine Range step for that round. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20180720]
[spi]/[SPI]If another effect was already setting that round's range (e.g. {101276|Neutral Guard}), that effect has priority. [PIB 20120214]

text:
[for] Ⓓ Enter combat with a locked minion.
[spi] Ⓓ Enter combat with a minion. Set the range for the first round of that combat to close, and this acting vampire's initial strike during that round is strike: hand strike at +1 damage.
[SPI] As [spi] above, but the strike is at +2 damage.

rulings.text: His replacement effect triggers before effects depending on the minion burning (eg. {101832|Soul Gem of Etrius}), but other replacements effect can be played before (eg. {100907|Heaven's Gate}), depending on sequencing. [LSJ 20071003-2] [ANK 20230816]

text:
Unique wraith with 1 life.
This Giovanni gets +1 stealth when hunting. If a minion controlled by your prey would be burned, instead remove that burning minion from the game and put 1 soul counter on Charigger. This Giovanni gets +1 bleed for each soul counter on Charigger.

Unique.
Put this card on a ready vampire. Recruit ally actions cost this vampire -1 blood or pool.
flavor:
Beauty is power; a smile is its sword.
Charles Reade

rulings.text: [aus][pre]Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

[aus][pre]If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

[aus][pre]The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
[aus][pre]If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
[aus][pre]A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]
[aus][pre]The burn blood effect is not reduced by effects that reduce the cost of the card (eg. {200011|Adana de Sforza}). [ANK 20210226]
[aus][pre]The card cannot be played if the minion cannot afford to burn the blood. [ANK 20210226]

text:
[aus][pre] Burn 1 blood to cancel a strike card (the minion chooses a strike again) or a grapple card as it is played by the opposing minion, and its cost is not paid. A vampire can play only one Charismatic Aura at basic each round.
[AUS][PRE] Strike: combat ends.

rulings.text: The target Political Action card is announced when announcing the action. It must be in hand before replacing the Charming Lobby. [RTR 19991001] [LSJ 20101210]

During the referendum that passes automatically, no "during a political action" and "during a referendum" effect can be played and effects that operate on the number of votes that the referendum passed by have no effect. [LSJ 19980107]
The next referendum (passing automatically) can be called by another Methuselah's vampire. [PIB 20110719]
Cannot be used on effects that allow to play a political action card "as if from hand" (eg. {100608|Echo of Harmonies}) [ANK 20201029]

If used on a political action card in hand, that card must be announced and in hand when Charming Lobby is played, before it is replaced, but need not to be shown: it can be kept apart face down. If the action is canceled or failed, the political action card stays in hand. [ANK 20220704] [ANK 20180925-2] [LSJ 20101210] [LSJ 20100130]

[dom] Lock this reacting vampire. Change the target of the bleed to another Methuselah other than the acting minion's controller (that Methuselah can attempt to block).
[DOM] As above, but do not lock this vampire.

es.name: Tácticas dilatorias
es.text:
Sólo utilizable durante la fase de votación de una acción política.
Cancela el referéndum. Endereza al vampiro activo. Si se ha jugado una carta de acción política para proponer este referéndum, devuélvela a la mano de su propietario (descartándose después). Los siervos controlados por el Matusalén activo no pueden volver a realizar la misma acción política este turno.

fr.name: Manœuvres dilatoires
fr.text:
Seulement utilisable durant l'étape de vote d'une action politique.
Annulez le référendum. Redressez le vampire qui agit. Si une carte d'action politique a été jouée pour appeler ce référendum, renvoyez-la dans la main de son propriétaire (ajuster la main). Les serviteurs contrôlés par le Mathusalem qui agit ne peuvent pas effectuer la même action politique à nouveau ce tour-ci.

rulings.text: May be played before, during, or after votes and ballots have been cast. [LSJ 19980130]
The acting minion is still considered to have taken a political action, so cannot perform another in the same turn. [RTR 19970630]

If played on a referendum called by a {100334|Charming Lobby}, the political action card (if any) is retrieved and other minions are forbidden to perform a {100334|Charming Lobby}. [ANK 20201029-2] [LSJ 20030426]

Will only retrieve a political action card played from the hand (eg. it does not retrieve an in-play {101663|Rumors of Gehenna} in the referendum to burn it or the card chosen by {100265|Bujo}). [LSJ 20041130] [LSJ 20100527]
It retrieves the political action card before it is burned (eg. if it was played from {100656|The Erciyes Fragments}, it is still returned into its owner's hand). [LSJ 20050324]
The results are not tallied (eg. {101692|Scorn of Adonis} or {100251|Bribes} have no effect). [LSJ 20010209]
If played on a referendum provided by a card in play (eg. {100055|Anarch Revolt}), does not prevent referendums provided by another copy of the same card in play. [LSJ 20020201]
Cannot be used during a referendum that is automatically passing. [PIB 20150105] [LSJ 19980107]

text:
Only usable during the polling step of a political action.
Cancel the referendum. Unlock the acting vampire. If a political action card [POLITICAL ACTION] was played to call this referendum, return it to its owner's hand (discard down afterward). Minions controlled by the acting Methuselah cannot perform the same political action again this turn.

rulings.text: Does not prevent the acting vampire from playing the equipment/retainer/ally directly this turn if he unlocks (not the same action). [ANK 20180817]
Requirements apply but do not count as requirements for the action (eg. you cannot use {100446|CrimethInc.} if the chosen card requires an Anarch). [ANK 20180817] [LSJ 20100303] [LSJ 20100725]
When choosing a card whose effect depend on Discipline level, the vampire decides in respect to his disciplines the normal way. [LSJ 20080803]
Is an action of the appropriate type for the chosen card (recruit/employ/equip). [TOM 19960130]

text:
Vehicle.
During your master phase, you may show a non-location equipment card from your hand to the other players and place it face down on the Delivery Truck if it doesn't already have one. You may look at the card at any time. Any minion you control may equip that card (face up) as a +1 stealth action (requirements and cost apply as normal). A minion may have only one vehicle.

Discipline.
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Dementation [dem] and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Dementation [DEM].

Unique master.
Put this card in play. Lock to cancel the votes and ballots of any vampire during the referendum of a political action.

rulings.text: Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]
[dom][for]If an action is canceled, it is not performed and the minion is free to attempt the same action again. [RBK cancel-a-card]
[dom][for]Cannot cancel cards that are not played from the hand in the normal fashion (e.g. can't cancel allies played via {101401|Piper}). [RTR 20001020]
[dom][for]Can be used to cancel all action cards, including employ retainer, recruit ally and political action. [ANK 20200813-2]
Cancelation must be immediate: a wake can be used in the "as played" window, but a reaction to "unlock and attempt to block" cannot. [LSJ 20021011]

text:
[dom][for] Cancel an action card a younger vampire plays that requires Presence [pre] as it is played. No cost is paid. Do not lock the acting vampire; that vampire cannot attempt the same action again this turn.
[DOM][FOR] Cancel an action modifier or combat card a younger vampire plays that requires Presence [pre] as it is played. No cost is paid.

[dem] [COMBAT] Press.
[DEM] [ACTION MODIFIER] +1 stealth.
flavor:
What we believe is, in the end, of little consequence. The only consequence is what we do.
John Ruskin

rulings.text: Cannot be used or played if the conditions for the terms of the referendum cannot be met (e.g. no legal selection, insufficient cards/players to choose from, prohibited by card text, uniqueness, etc). [LSJ 20100129] [ANK 20191228]

text:
Requires a ready archbishop, cardinal or regent.
Choose one or more Methuselahs who do not have a target counter. Successful referendum means each chosen Methuselah gets a target counter. During his or her unlock phase, a Methuselah with a target counter chooses one of his or her ready minions, who takes 2 unpreventable damage. A Methuselah may burn the Edge to burn his or her target counter.

Unique.
Put this card on a ready vampire you control. This vampire gets +1 strength. This vampire gets +1 stealth during diablerie actions. This vampire cannot recruit allies or employ retainers.

rulings.text: The clan and sect assigned to Derange is set when the card is played and does not change when it is moved. [LSJ 20070707]

If the target changes clan or sect to a clan or sect inappropriate for their title, they lose its benefit until their clan or sect is appropriate. They immediately yield the title if it is contested or they receives a new one. [RTR 20201130] [LSJ 20060904]
When removed, the vampire goes back to its underlying clan and sect. [RTR 20201130] [ANK 20200415]
Only requires one clan or the other (Malkavian or Malkavian antitribu) to be played. [ANK 20190203]
If another effect also changes the clan or sect (eg. {100353|Clan Impersonation}, {101000|Into the Fire}), the most recent one takes precedence. [LSJ 20021209]

Is a temporary effect that overrides the underlying sect. The most recent override takes precedence. It stays active if another effect changes the underlying sect, like using the default action to become Anarch. [LSJ 20100811] [ANK 20190619]
The "does not unlock as normal" effect is redundant with being infernal. If the minion is infernal, his controller can still pay a pool to unlock him. [LSJ 20050114]

text:
+1 stealth action.
Ⓓ Put this card on a younger vampire. The attached vampire is considered the same clan and sect as this acting vampire. The attached vampire does not unlock as normal. During their unlock phase, they can burn 1 blood to unlock. The attached vampire can move this card to another vampire as a Ⓓ action. Cannot be put on a Malkavian or Malkavian antitribu.

rulings.text: Breaks any temporary control effects, so the vampire is given, face down and out of play, to his current permanent controller, with the Descent into Darkness card which, as a minion card, is then controlled by that permanent controller. [LSJ 20040526]
Damage inflicted after the action resolution (eg. {100492|Daring the Dawn}) are not applied. [LSJ 20040616]
If played by an ally, the ally can never come back. [LSJ 20060124]
All cards on the vampire come back unlocked. [LSJ 20060908]
The vampire will remember all effects that had been applied to him, just as contested vampires do. This includes gained or lost titles. [RTR 20000501] [LSJ 20060908]
Cards and effects targeting the vampire (eg. {101536|The Rack}) will resume if and when the vampire comes back into play. [TOM 19960211] [LSJ 20010809-2] [LSJ 20010809-3] [LSJ 20060908]
If any card on the vampire was contested, it goes out of the contest until the vampire comes back. [LSJ 20080816]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[obt] Put this card on this vampire, then put this vampire and any other cards and counters on them out of play (breaking any temporary control effects; this card remains in play). During your influence phase, this vampire can gain 2 blood and you can choose to burn this card to return the vampire to play (in the same region as they were before), locked.
[OBT] As above, but the vampire is unlocked as they return to play.

Weapon, gun.
Strike: 2R damage.
flavor: Mike raised a pistol that, from Beckett's angle, appeared to be roughly the size of a howitzer.

rulings.text: The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]

text:
+1 stealth action.
Put this card on this Ishtarri and put 1 counter on this card. This Ishtarri gets +X bleed, where X is the number of counters on this card. This Ishtarri can add a counter to this card as a +1 stealth action that costs X blood.

Unique location.
During an action directed at you (or a card you control), you can lock this location to give a Nosferatu you control +1 intercept; if that Nosferatu blocks, you get +1 hand size during the resulting combat.

+1 stealth action.
Ⓓ Choose any minion; the chosen minion cannot block Nosferatu until the end of the turn.
flavor:
Dull and malevolent,
And odious, they seem,
With shades of twilight blended,
Part of an evil dream...
D.H. Lawrence, "Elysium"

[ani] Only usable during an action directed at a minion or location you control. The action fails unless the acting minion burns 2 blood (allies cannot burn blood).

Play when a monster controlled by your predator is bleeding you, after blocks are declined. Lock this reacting imbued. The monster is now bleeding your predator's predator.

Master: trifle.
When drawing to replace this card, you may take your choice of one of the cards from your research area instead of drawing from your library.

Ghouls are monsters, not mortal. [ANK 20200203-2] [LSJ 20060515]

Unique ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
If Deviki is ready during your master phase, you can lock her to search your library (shuffle afterward) and/or ash heap for a master Discipline card and put it on a ready Banu Haqim you control.
flavor:
When you are an anvil, be patient; when a hammer, strike.
Deviki Prasanta, Assamite ghoul

es.name: Día de los Muertos
es.text:
Sólo se puede jugar un ejemplar de esta carta por partida.
El primer referéndum que un vampiro Sabbat que controles proponga este turno prospera automáticamente (sáltate la fase de votación).
es.flavor:
Jugamos muy peligrosamente con la vida y nadie conoce nuestras reglas.
Parke Godwin

fr.name: Día de los Muertos
fr.text:
Pas plus d'un seul exemplaire ne peut être joué par partie.
Le premier référendum qu'un vampire du Sabbat que vous contrôlez appelle durant ce tour passe automatiquement (sautez l'étape de vote).
fr.flavor:
Nous jouons à des jeux très dangereux avec la vie et personne ne connaît nos règles.
Parke Godwin

text:

We play very dangerous games with life and no one knows our rules.
