Gírala durante la fase de votación de una acción política para dar +1 voto a cada vampiro Camarilla titulado preparado que controles.

fr.name: Élysée : le château de Versailles
fr.text:
Lieu unique.
Vous pouvez l'incliner durant l'étape de vote d'une action politique pour donner +1 voix à chaque vampire de la Camarilla titré disponible que vous contrôlez.

text:
Unique location.
You can lock this location during the polling step of a political action to give each titled Camarilla vampire you control +1 vote.

Requires a primogen.
[REACTION] +1 intercept.
[REACTION] Only usable by a locked primogen. This primogen unlocks and attempts to block.

es.name: El Abrazo
es.text:
Acción con +1 de sigilo. Requiere a un vampiro que no sea estéril.
Pon esta carta en juego. Se convierte en un vampiro no único con 1 de capacidad del mismo clan y secta que el vampiro activo, y debe cazar este turno.

fr.name: L'étreinte
fr.text:
Action à +1 en discrétion. Requiert un vampire non stérile.
Mettez cette carte en jeu. Elle devient un vampire (non unique) de capacité 1 des mêmes clan et secte que le vampire qui agit et doit chasser ce tour-ci.

rulings.text: Is not a vampire in the ash heap (eg. {101423|Possession} cannot target it). [LSJ 20020115]
If moved to the uncontrolled region (eg. by {100131|Banishment}), it stays a vampire and can be influenced. [RTR 19990712]
If it would be put into the crypt for any reason, it is burned instead [LSJ 20041201-2]

text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a non-sterile vampire.
Put this card in play. It becomes a 1-capacity non-unique vampire of the same clan and sect as the acting vampire, and must hunt this turn.

rulings.text: His ability cannot be used from the ash heap, he needs to be ready. [ANK 20180511-1]

When using his ability to put another one into play, it does not require a ready Harbinger, the pool cost of the new one is not paid, the new one can act this turn and can use his ability to bring another one immediately. [ANK 20180509]

text:
Wraith with 2 life. 2 strength, 1 bleed.
During your unlock phase, if you control fewer copies of Emerald Legionnaire than ready unique Harbinger of Skulls, you can remove 7 cards in your ash heap from the game to move an Emerald Legionnaire from your ash heap to the ready region with 2 life.

rulings.text: The burn option can be used if all your Seraph are in torpor. [LSJ 20091203]
The fact it is Unique has no bearing on the burn option. You cannot use the burn option if you meet the requirement, even if you already have a copy of the card in play. [LSJ 20100203-2]

text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready Seraph. Unique.
Put this card on the acting Seraph. During each political action, this Seraph gets X additional votes, where X is the number of Gehenna cards in play. If there are no Gehenna cards in play, burn this card.
flavor:
It is said that the Black Hand had to remove several Sabbat elders for the good of the sect.
Fatima al-Faqadi, Assamite

rulings.text: Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]

The cost for a canceled non-action-card is still paid, including additional and alternative cost (e.g. to play {100598|Eagle's Sight} to block a Wraith or zombie while {201726|Parijat, the Dark Oracle} is ready the top card of the Library must be burned, even if {100598|Eagle's Sight} was canceled) [RBK cancel-a-card] [ANK 20260216]

text:
Master: out-of-turn.
Burn 1 pool to cancel a Gehenna card as it is played. Alternatively, if there are at least two Gehenna cards in play, you may play this card during your minion phase to unlock a vampire with a capacity above 7.
flavor:
The duty of the living is to live. Nothing more, even for those of us whose lives are somewhat unnatural. I cannot speak to the duties of the dead.
Eugenio Estevez, Tremere

rulings.text: Is an undirected action, even when targeting another Methuselah's ash heap. [LSJ 20010627] [ANK 20180202]
Cannot be played if no target is available in any Methuselah's ash heap. [ANK 20200420-3]

text:
+1 stealth action.
Remove a mortal (ally or retainer) in any Methuselah's ash heap from the game to put this card on the acting Nagaraja. During your unlock phase you may burn this card to restore this ready Nagaraja to full capacity with blood from the blood bank. A vampire may have only one Emergency Rations.

rulings.text: Cannot be used during a referendum that is automatically passing. [PIB 20150105] [LSJ 19980107]
Counts as requiring an Anarch (for eg. {101435|Powerbase: Los Angeles}). [LSJ 20080603] [LSJ 20050128]

text:
Requires a ready baron. Only usable during a referendum before votes and ballots are cast.
Choose a ready unlocked anarch you control. Lock the chosen anarch. That anarch gains 3 votes. Any Camarilla vampire older than that anarch can lock to cancel that anarch's votes and ballots.
flavor:
But we can think new thoughts, dream of new forms of rule. It is time to turn the tables, to teach the old to be young again.
Salvador Garcia, Brujah anarch

text:
Requires a Sabbat vampire.
Choose one or more Methuselahs. Successful referendum means each chosen Methuselah burns 1 pool, plus 3 additional pool if they control a ready vampire with capacity 8 or more.
flavor:
Look back over the past, with its changing empires that rose and fell, and you can foresee the future too.
Marcus Aurelius, "Meditations"

rulings.text: Can only be played by the controller of the acting minion. [LSJ 19990425]

text:
Only usable during a bleed action by a ready unlocked vampire other than the acting minion.
[dom] The acting minion gets +1 bleed (limited).
[DOM] As above, but usable by a ready locked vampire.

es.name: Encantar a los Vástagos
es.text:
[pre] Ⓓ Sangra con +1 de sangrado.
[PRE] Acción con +1 de sigilo. Añade 2 de sangre a un vampiro menor de tu zona incontrolada.
es.flavor:
Vi pálidos reyes, y princesas también,
Pálidos guerreros, todos con la palidez de la muerte;
Ellos gritaban – "¡La bella dama sin piedad
Te ha esclavizado!"
John Keats, "La bella dama sin piedad"

fr.name: Enchanter la descendance
fr.text:
[pre] Ⓓ Mordre à +1 en morsure.
[PRE] Action à +1 en discrétion. Ajouter 2 points de sang à un vampire plus jeune dans votre région incontrôlée.
fr.flavor:
Je vis des rois pâles, et des princes pâles,
Des guerriers pâles, tous pâles comme la mort ;
— Ils me criaient : "La Belle Dame sans merci
T'a pris dans ses rets."
John Keats, "La Belle Dame Sans Merci"

text:
[pre] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.
[PRE] +1 stealth action. Add 2 blood to a younger vampire in your uncontrolled region.
flavor:
I saw pale kings, and princes too,
Pale warriors, death-pale were they all;
They cried, "La belle dame sans merci
Thee hath in thrall!"
John Keats, "La Belle Dame Sans Merci"

rulings.text: The effect is not optional. [RTR 19980707] [LSJ 19980722]
Once in play, can be equipped from the minion it's on (rulebook action) by another minion that does not meet the requirements. [ANK 20180719-3]

text:
Unique.
This Malkavian antitribu gets +1 bleed and +1 stealth during bleed actions.
flavor:
You see a doll. I see a chorus of voices obeying mine.
Vasantasena, Malkavian antitribu

es.name: Mirada cautivadora
es.text:
[pre][pro] +1 de sigilo.
[PRE][PRO] Como antes, y una vez en esta acción puedes quemar 1 de tus fichas de corrupción de un siervo bloqueador para hacer que su intento de bloqueo fracase, y no pueda intentar bloquear esta acción de nuevo.

fr.name: Regard enchanteur
fr.text:
[pre][pro] +1 en discrétion.
[PRE][PRO] Comme ci-dessus et une fois durant cette action, vous pouvez brûler 1 de vos compteurs corruption d'un serviteur qui bloque pour faire échouer sa tentative de blocage et il ne peut pas tenter de bloquer cette action à nouveau.

text:
[pre][pro] +1 stealth.
[PRE][PRO] As above, and once this action, you can burn 1 of your corruption counters from a blocking minion to have their block attempt fail, and they cannot attempt to block this action again.

+1 stealth action.
Put this card on the acting Osebo. This Osebo gets +1 strength. A minion can have only one Enforcer.
flavor:
Fire can soften iron.
Nkundo-Mongo proverb

rulings.text: When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[for] This vampire gains 2 blood.
[spi] As [for] above, and unlock this vampire during the next discard phase.
[SPI] This vampire gains 2 blood and unlocks.

rulings.text: The card stays there if the strike is dodged [ANK 20220923]
Cannot be used against an ally. [ANK 20220818] [ANK 20221102]
Once used, it becomes a typeless card and cannot be used as a weapon anymore. [ANK 20220818]

text:
Weapon.
Strike: 3 unpreventable damage and put this card on the opposing vampire; it becomes a card with "Cards requiring a Discipline cost this vampire +1 blood. After this vampire successfully hunts, burn this card".

es.name: Sentidos agudizados
es.text:
[aus] +1 de intercepción.
[AUS] +2 de intercepción.
es.flavor:
Las cosas dan a nuestros sentidos sólo lo que rechazan. La flor abandona su olor.
Paul Valéry

fr.name: Sens surdéveloppés
fr.text:
[aus] +1 en interception.
[AUS] +2 en interception.
fr.flavor:
Les choses ne donnent à nos sens que ce qu'elles rejettent. Nous les connaissons par leurs rebuts. La fleur abandonne son odeur.
Paul Valéry

text:
[aus] +1 intercept.
[AUS] +2 intercept.
flavor:
Perhaps to our senses things offer only their rejections. Perfume is what the flowers throw away.
Paul Valéry

es.name: Vasallo de Enkil
es.text:
Única. Requiere a un vampiro con capacidad 10 o más. Sólo utilizable tras la resolución de un sangrado exitoso contra tu presa.
Ponle esta carta a este vampiro. Este vampiro obtiene +1 de sangrado. Durante la fase servil de cualquier Matusalén, este vampiro puede girar esta carta para realizar una acción.

fr.name: Pion d'Enkil
fr.text:
Unique. Requiert un vampire de capacité 10 ou plus. Seulement utilisable après résolution d'une morsure réussie contre votre proie.
Mettez cette carte sur ce vampire. Ce vampire reçoit +1 en morsure. Durant la phase de serviteur de n'importe quel Mathusalem, ce vampire peut incliner cette carte pour effectuer une action.

rulings.text: If locked to take an action and the action is canceled as it is played (not if it is canceled after, eg. with {101935|Tangle Atropos' Hand}), it stays locked and the minion can choose to take an action again or let the Cog effect be lost. [LSJ 20081213-1] [ANK 20210124]

Is played after resolution, after all combats (if any) are handled, but still during the action. Action modifiers and effects that can be played "after resolution" can be played before or after it. [PIB 20150915] [LSJ 19981028] [ANK 20190425]

text:
Unique. Requires a vampire with capacity 10 or more. Only usable after resolution of a successful bleed against your prey.
Put this card on this vampire. This vampire gets +1 bleed. During any Methuselah's minion phase, this vampire can lock this card to take an action.

es.name: Teatro de Ennoia
es.text:
Lugar único.
Gírala para obtener +1 a la mano este turno. Gírala durante tu fase de influencia para obtener +1 transferencia.

fr.name: Théâtre d'Ennoia
fr.text:
Lieu unique.
Vous pouvez l'incliner pour recevoir +1 en taille de main ce tour-ci. Vous pouvez l'incliner durant votre phase d'influence pour recevoir +1 transfert.

rulings.text: Only requires one clan or the other (Gangrel or Gangrel antitribu) to be played. [ANK 20190203]
Can be used at any moment during the influence phase to get the additional transfer. [RTR 20180303]

text:
Unique location.
Lock to get +1 hand size this turn. Lock during your influence phase to get +1 transfer.

rulings.text: [PRE] If the vampire cannot burn 2 blood, he cannot attempt an action other than hunt or enter combat. [ANK 20180327]
[PRE] If the vampire it is on attempts an action and it is canceled (eg. {100545|Direct Intervention}) they do not burn 2 blood. [LSJ 20090208]

text:
+1 stealth action. Frenzy.
[pre] Put this card on a vampire you control. This vampire has +1 strength and may enter combat with any minion as a Ⓓ action. Burn this card at the end of this turn.
[PRE] Ⓓ Put this card on any vampire. This vampire must burn 2 blood to attempt any action except hunts and actions to enter combat. Burn this card after resolving this vampire's action.

rulings.text: [VIS][REACTION] The action still continues until the end of combat. The acting minion stays the same, effects applied during the action still applies during combat. [LSJ 20070217]
The action fails: it might be continued (eg. Form of Mist) but still fails anyway. [LSJ 20070214-2]
Cannot be used while a block is being attempted, or has already been successful. [ANK 20260316] [LSJ 20041022]

[VIS][REACTION]If the action fails, modifiers and reactions that can be used at the end/after an action can still be used afterwards (after combat, if any). [ANK 20221205] [ANK 20220118] [RTR 20180719] [LSJ 20041022]
[VIS][REACTION]If the action fails, the action has reached resolution, so is subject to NRA (Non Repeatable Action) rules. [ANK 20211015] [RTR 20180719]
[VIS][REACTION]If an action fails, it was not blocked. Cards/effects depending on a block (e.g. {101222|Mirror Image}, [FOR] {100788|Freak Drive}) cannot be played/used. [LSJ 20070219]

text:
[vis] [ACTION] +1 stealth action. Put this card on a location and unlock this vampire. While this vampire is ready, their controller can burn this card during an action directed at the attached location to have the action fail, and the acting minion and this vampire enter combat.
[VIS] [REACTION] Only usable during an action directed at a location. This vampire unlocks, the action fails, and the acting minion and this vampire enter combat.

Only usable during a bleed action.
+X bleed (limited), where X is the number of ready unlocked Daughters of Cacophony you control. Lock all ready Daughters of Cacophony you control.

rulings.text: [ANI]/[CEL]If an opponent then plays an effect that grants a strike (e.g, {100029|Aid from Bats}), they pay the additional cost. [LSJ 20090529]
rulings.group: Adding costs to a strike or strike card

rulings.text: [ANI]/[CEL]Strikes are paid at declaration. If an ally spends their last life on a strike, combat ends before strike resolution. If the strike damage depends on the amount of life/blood of the striking minion, it is calculated after the strike is paid for (e.g. {101751|Shambling Hordes}). [LSJ 20090703]
rulings.group: Adding costs to a strike or strike card

rulings.text: When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
[ani] or [cel] +1 intercept.
[ANI] or [CEL] As above, and strike cards cost the acting minion +1 blood or life during the resulting combat if this vampire blocks.
flavor:
O Hunter, snare me his shadow!
O Nightingale, catch me his strain!
Oscar Wilde, "In The Forest"

rulings.text: When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]
[OBF]/[PRE]You can draw more cards than are in the library or crypt (even from an empty library or crypt); draw as much as you can. [LSJ 20060620]

text:
[obf] or [pre] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.
[OBF] or [PRE] As above, and if the bleed is successful (for 1 or more), this vampire can burn 1 blood to draw 1 card from your crypt.
flavor:
I form’d them free: and free they must remain,
Till they enthrall themselves...
John Milton, "Paradise Lost"

rulings.text: Is directed at your prey. [LSJ 20010807]
If the edge is lost during the action (eg. {200597|High Priest Angra Mainyu}), the prey takes no damage but you still cannot bleed anymore this turn. [LSJ 20100527]

text:
[ser] Ⓓ Burn the Edge to burn 2 pool from your prey. Minions you control cannot bleed until the end of the turn.
[SER] As above, but your prey burns 3 pool.

es.name: Sepultura
es.text:
[obt] Ataque: quema al aliado oponente.
[OBT] Ataque: envía al vampiro oponente al letargo.
es.flavor:
Olvidaráse de ellos el seno materno; de ellos sentirán los gusanos dulzura; Nunca más habrá de ellos memoria.
Job 24:20 (VRJ)

fr.name: Inhumation
fr.text:
[obt] Frapper : brûler l'allié opposé.
[OBT] Frapper : envoyer le vampire opposé en torpeur.
fr.flavor:
— Mon âme est un tombeau que, mauvais cénobite,
Depuis l'éternité je parcours et j'habite.
Charles Baudelaire, "Le Mauvais Moine"

rulings.text: Only effective at close range. [RBK resolve-strike] [LSJ 20000110]
[OBT] The opponent is wounded (if they play {102068|Undying Tenacity}, they go to torpor after combat). [LSJ 20090622-2]

text:
[obt] Strike: burn the opposing ally.
[OBT] Strike: send the opposing vampire to torpor.
flavor:
The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered.
Job 24:20 (KJV)

es.name: Trance
es.text:
[pre] Ⓓ Sangra con +1 de sangrado.
[PRE] Acción Ⓓ con +1 de sigilo. Roba un aliado controlado por otro Matusalén.
es.flavor:
Tu fresco perfume me desconcierta
Y en tu opalescencia
Veo los habitados cielos de antaño,
Como por una puerta abierta.
Raoul Ponchon, "La absenta"

fr.name: Envoûtement
fr.text:
[pre] Ⓓ Mordre à +1 en morsure.
[PRE] Action à +1 en discrétion. Ⓓ Voler un allié contrôlé par un autre Mathusalem.
fr.flavor:
Ton frais parfum me déconcerte.
Et dans ton opale je vois
Des cieux habités autrefois,
Comme par une porte ouverte.
Raoul Ponchon, "L'Absinthe"

text:
[pre] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.
[PRE] +1 stealth action. Ⓓ Steal an ally controlled by another Methuselah.
flavor:
Your perfume disconcerts me
And in your opalescence
I see the full heavens of yore
As through an open door.
Raoul Ponchon, "L'Absinthe"

text:
+1 stealth action.
If this vampire has 4 or more blood, he or she gains 4 blood.
flavor:
Rather than a time of peace it was truly a time of preparation; it was peaceful only because the sword had grown dull and the lance was broken. Once reforged it would begin again.
Anonymous Malkavian, Das Buch von der Grabkrieg

rulings.text: The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]
rulings.group: Action requirements from a card in play

text:
Unique.
Put this card on a Ventrue with capacity 8 or more. This Ventrue gets +1 intercept and +1 vote. This Ventrue can force any vampire to yield a contested title as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

+2 stealth action. Requires an unmerged base vampire.
Unlock this acting vampire and search your crypt, uncontrolled region, or ash heap for his or her advanced version to move to him or her. Shuffle your crypt afterward.

rulings.text: Cannot be used when a card is played to draw a card that would cancel it "as it is played". [RTR 20040501]
If used to play a political action and {100519|Delaying Tactics} is played, the political action card goes to its owner's hand. [LSJ 20050322]
All other players can see which card is selected from the ash heap. [ANK 20200523]
Can be used during an action, when the controller has the opportunity to play an effect. [ANK 20200616]
If it leaves play, the card on it is burned. [LSJ 20021128]
Ignores all "do not replace" clauses and special replacement effects on cards played from it. [LSJ 20081126]
rulings.group: Play stored card as if from hand

rulings.text: The card on it cannot be discarded or burned to satisfy another effect (eg. {101958|Tension in the Ranks} or using political action cards for votes). [LSJ 20050118]
rulings.group: Play stored card as if from hand

rulings.text: A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]
rulings.group: Play stored card as if from hand

text:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Lock this card to move a library card from your prey's ash heap to this card, face down. You may look at that card at any time. You may play the card from the Fragments as if playing it from your hand (requirements and cost, if any, apply as normal). When that card is burned, remove it from the game instead. Only 1 card can be on this card at a time. Any vampire with a capacity above 4 can steal the Fragments (and any card on it) for his or her controller as a Ⓓ action.

rulings.text: Once in play, can be equipped from the minion it's on (rulebook action) by another minion that does not meet the requirements. [ANK 20180719-3]
The fact it is Unique has no bearing on the burn option. You cannot use the burn option if you meet the requirement, even if you already have a copy of the card in play. [LSJ 20100203-2]

text:
Unique equipment.
The Harbinger of Skulls with this equipment gets +1 stealth.
flavor:
Where wilt thou find a cavern dark enough
To mask thy monstrous visage?
William Shakespeare, "Julius Caesar", act II, scene 1

rulings.text: Erosion resets a minion's base strength. Any modifiers, including inherent modifiers, are applied to the new base. If another effect like {101993|Torn Signpost} later resets the base damage again, then the new amount wins out. [LSJ 19971211-2]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[qui] Ⓓ Put this card on a minion controlled by another Methuselah. The attached minion gets a strength of 0 and cannot use melee weapons. They can burn this card as a +1 stealth action.
[QUI] As above, but the action to burn this card does not get +1 stealth.

Only usable at long range. Not usable the first round of combat.
[qui] Strike: 2R aggravated damage.
[QUI] As above, and this vampire can burn X blood and randomly discard X cards to inflict X additional non-aggravated damage this strike.

rulings.text: If the action is unblocked when it resolves and the target is locked, the action "fizzles" (cost, if any, is paid, and it is considered successful, but has no effect). [ANK 20210124] [LSJ 20070411] [LSJ 20090514]

text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a Sabbat vampire.
Move 2 blood from the blood bank to an unlocked Sabbat vampire, or move 1 blood to each of two unlocked Sabbat vampires.

rulings.text: Must choose when declaring strike between a normal hand strike or the aggravated hand strike his ability gives him. [ANK 20190717-2]
Does not burn at the end of combat if another effect let him make a hand strike at +1 damage. "If he does so" only applies if his own effect is used directly. [LSJ 20001127-2] [RTR 20020501]
Does not burn at the end of combat if his strike does not resolve (eg. if his opponent uses a strike: combat ends or {101654|Rötschreck} is played). [LSJ 20001127-2] [LSJ 20010627] [LSJ 20070508]
If his strike resolves, he cannot be saved from burning (with eg. {100907|Heaven's Gate} of {101084|Left for Dead}). [LSJ 20070507] [LSJ 20021205]

text:
Mortal with 1 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
This ally can strike: hand strike at +1 damage, aggravated; burn him at the end of combat if this strike has resolved. This ally can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action.

rulings.text: You still gain the trifle master phase action, even if this card contests when played. [RBK contested-cards]

text:
Master: unique trifle.
Put this card in play. Lock during the referendum of a political action to give 3 additional votes to a vampire with a capacity above 6. During your discard phase, your predator takes control of Esgrima.
flavor:
Regular social interaction also serves a more fundamental function: survival. Whether a Kindred likes it or not, he is eventually drawn into the games of more experienced Kindred, and rarely is that a good thing.
Nicholas Cardiff, ghoul

[LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

And when I walk the streets

George Thorogood, "Bad to the Bone"

es.name: Impulso sobrenatural
es.text:
Sólo utilizable tras la resolución de la acción.
[for] Sólo utilizable si la acción tuvo éxito. Endereza a este vampiro.
[FOR] Sólo utilizable si la acción fue bloqueada. Endereza a este vampiro.

fr.name: Pulsion monstrueuse
fr.text:
Seulement utilisable après résolution de l'action.
[for] Seulement utilisable si l'action a été réussie. Redressez ce vampire.
[FOR] Seulement utilisable si l'action a été bloquée. Redressez ce vampire.

rulings.text: [FOR] Cannot be played if the action "failed" unless there was a successful block attempt. [RTR 20180719]
[FOR] Cannot be played if the action was "ended." [RTR 20180719]

Is played after resolution, after all combats (if any) are handled, but still during the action. Action modifiers and effects that can be played "after resolution" can be played before or after it. [PIB 20150915] [LSJ 19981028] [ANK 20190425]

[for]The after action resolution effect can be used if the action "fizzles" (is unblocked at resolution, but has no effect because some requirement cannot be met or cost can't be paid in full). [ANK 20220218]

text:
Only usable after action resolution.
[for] Only usable if the action was successful. Unlock this vampire.
[FOR] Only usable if the action was blocked. Unlock this vampire.

rulings.text: When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
Zombie with 3 life. 3 strength, 1 bleed.
[obl] or [tha] During your unlock phase, this ally burns 1 life. This ally can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action.
[OBL] or [THA] As above, but this ally has 4 life.

rulings.text: A vampire with no circle designation is in his own unique circle. Vampires with the same name (eg. {100633|The Embrace}, non-unique vampires) do not share a circle by default, each has his own circle of one by default. [LSJ 20020609]
[SAN]The optional press can only be used during the current round. [TOM 19960521]

text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[san] Lock this Blood Brother and any number of ready unlocked members you control of this circle. Once each round before range is determined, or whenever your combatant leaves the ready region, you may choose one of these ready Blood Brothers to become the combatant instead (and combat continues).
[SAN] As above, and each of these Blood Brothers gets an optional press this combat.

rulings.text: If there are insuffient targets to which to allocate all of the points allowed, then the card cannot be played. [LSJ 20010810]
The votes provided by the Priscii sub-referendum are not affected. [ANK 20180307-1]

Cannot be used or played if the conditions for the terms of the referendum cannot be met (e.g. no legal selection, insufficient cards/players to choose from, prohibited by card text, uniqueness, etc). [LSJ 20100129] [ANK 20191228]

text:
Requires an Independent or Anarch vampire.
Allocate X points among one or more ready vampires, where X is half the capacity of the acting vampire (rounded up). No more than 3 points points can be allocated to each vampire. Successful referendum means each vampire burns 1 blood for each point allocated. In this referendum, non-priscus titles are worth 1 less vote each, priscus title is worth 1 less ballot, and burning the Edge is worth 1 additional vote.

rulings.text: Only prevents the use of equipment after it is played - it will not cancel the effects of equipment used before it is played. [TOM 19960326]
Can be played on a minion that cannot play or use presses (eg. Mukhtar Bey) and does provide the presses, the minion is not the one pressing. [LSJ 20040521]

The provided press is applied before any other press. Another press cannot be used to continue (eg. {100244|Boxed In}, {101931|Talbot's Chainsaw}) if there's already a press to continue. [ANK 20200525-1]

text:
Master: out-of-turn. Frenzy.
Only usable before range is chosen. Choose a vampire in combat. In this round, that vampire cannot use equipment and cannot use presses to end combat. This round has a press, only usable to continue combat.

rulings.text: When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
Requires an Anarch.
[for] Reduce a bleed against you by 2.
[nec] +1 intercept.
[obt] Only usable after a vampire successfully bleeds you. The acting vampire burns 2 blood.

rulings.text: Requirements do not apply when taking control of a card already in play. [TOM 19960226-1]

text:
Master.
Take control of a minion controlled by a Methuselah with 3 or fewer pool. Not usable to take control of a vampire with capacity 7 or more. Only one From a Sinking Ship can be played in a game.
flavor:
This is not what I signed up for.
Theo Bell, Brujah archon.

es.name: Ataque frontal
es.text: Pon esta carta en juego. Cada siervo preparado que controles puede entrar en combate con un siervo controlado por tu presa con una acción Ⓓ. Ganas 1 de reserva sanguínea después de que un siervo preparado controlado por tu presa se queme o sea enviado al letargo. Durante tu fase de influencia, quema esta carta y quema 1 de reserva sanguínea por cada siervo preparado controlado por tu presa.

fr.name: Assaut frontal
fr.text: Mettez cette carte en jeu. Chaque serviteur disponible que vous contrôlez peut entrer en combat contre un serviteur contrôlé par votre proie en action Ⓓ. Vous gagnez 1 point de réserve après qu'un serviteur disponible contrôlé par votre proie est brûlé ou envoyé en torpeur. Durant votre phase d'influence, brûlez cette carte et brûlez 1 point de réserve pour chaque serviteur disponible contrôlé par votre proie.

rulings.text: If you play more than one, you gain and loose pool for all of them (they stack). [LSJ 20061018]

text: Put this card in play. Each ready minion you control can enter combat with a minion controlled by your prey as a Ⓓ action. You gain 1 pool after a ready minion controlled by your prey is burned or sent to torpor. During your influence phase, burn this card and burn 1 pool for each ready minion controlled by your prey.

rulings.text: When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]
If an acting minion leaves the ready region before block resolution, the action ends immediately and the blocking minion is not locked. [RBK resolve-the-action]

text:
+1 stealth action. A Methuselah can have only one Frozen Object.
[ser] Ⓓ Look at a Methuselah's hand and discard all equipment cards from it.
[tem] Put this card on this vampire. If this vampire blocks a directed action, you can burn this card to inflict 2 unpreventable environmental damage on the acting minion before block resolution.
[TEM] Put this card in play. You can burn this card after a minion successfully bleeds you to inflict 2 unpreventable environmental damage on them.

rulings.text: Is not replaced until the condition is met, even if it is burned. [LSJ 20080805]

text:
Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire commits diablerie.
This card comes into play with 10 counters. After another Gehenna event is played, burn 1 counter from this card. Blood hunts cannot be called on vampires with capacity greater than the number of counters on this card who diablerize a younger vampire.
flavor:
I'm starting to hear whispers of warehouses and old office buildings converted to internment centers — and buffets.
Okulos, Nosferatu

text:
Usable by a locked vampire.
[nec] Unlock a mummy, wraith, or zombie ally you control.
[NEC] Unlock up to two mummy, wraith, and/or zombie allies you control.

rulings.text: Is a change of the actual sect. A temporary effect overriding the sect has precedence and if it does, this card burns (eg. {102196|Writ of Acceptance}). [LSJ 20100811]

text:
Trifle.
Put this card on a ready non-titled, non-Anarch vampire you control to make them Anarch. If this vampire changes sects, burn this card.
flavor:
The neonate childe escaped. So intent on Galaric were the Ventrue that they ignored the childe until he was long gone from their grasp.
Salvador Garcia, Brujah anarch

rulings.text: If the controller of a Gambit in play withdraws, his or her predator gets a VP from the Gambit (the Methuselah who withdraws still gets a VP for withdrawing, of course). [RTR 20040501]

text:
Master.
Only usable if you have at least 1 victory point. Lose 1 victory point and put this card in play. During your unlock phase, move 1 pool from your prey's pool to your pool. If you are ousted, your predator gains an additional victory point. At the end of the game, if you have not been ousted, you gain an additional victory point.

es.name: Juego de Malkav
es.text: Cada uno de los demás Matusalenes elige en secreto un número entre 1 y 5 inclusive; tú eliges un número entre 1 y 6 inclusive. Cada Matusalén extiende el puño cerrado con el número de fichas elegido dentro. Revela las elecciones simultáneamente. Cada Matusalén gana la cantidad de reserva sanguínea que haya elegido, a no ser que otro Matusalén haya elegido exactamente una ficha menos que él, en cuyo caso, quema esa cantidad de reserva sanguínea en vez de ganarla.

fr.name: Jeu de Malkav
fr.text: Chaque autre Mathusalem choisit en secret un nombre entre 1 et 5 inclus ; vous choisissez un nombre entre 1 et 6 inclus. Chaque Mathusalem tend sa main avec le nombre choisi de compteurs dedans. Révélez les choix simultanément. Chaque Mathusalem gagne la quantité de points de réserve qu'il a choisie sauf si un autre Mathusalem a choisi exactement 1 de moins que lui, auquel cas il brûle cette quantité de points de réserve à la place.

text: Each other Methuselah secretly chooses a number between 1 and 5 inclusive; you choose a number between 1 and 6 inclusive. Each Methuselah holds a hand out with the chosen number of counters in it. Reveal the choices simultaneously. Each Methuselah gains the amount of pool they chose unless another Methuselah chose exactly 1 less than they did, in which case, they burn that amount of pool instead.

rulings.text: The gain blood effect is applied after combats ends, no combat card can be played afterwards. The acting player chooses the order of after-combat effects. [LSJ 20100324]

text:
Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
Ⓓ Enter combat with an older vampire controlled by another Methuselah. At the end of that combat, if only one combatant is ready, that ready vampire gains blood equal to the opposing vampire's capacity from the blood bank.
flavor:
Is this why you arranged for us to be alone together? So you could try to 'talk sense' into me? Or were you just feeling suicidal?
Tara, Brujah Prince of San Diego

rulings.text: If blocked, no other effect can be used to reset the range, but other pre-range effects can be played. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20180720]
If another effect also sets the range, the first to resolve has priority (eg. {100103|Asanbonsam Ghoul} and {101276|Neutral Guard} resolve after). [PIB 20120214]

Must be played (as well as other "as the action is announced" action modifiers) before action modifiers that are not explicitly played "as the action is announced" (e.g., {100401|Conditioning}). [ANK 20190425]
Replace the action card (if any) before playing it. [ANK 20181208]

Once the range is set, no other effect can be used to reset the range that round, but other pre-range effects can be played afterwards. Skip the Determine Range step for that round. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20180720]
If another effect was already setting that round's range (e.g. {101276|Neutral Guard}), that effect has priority. [PIB 20120214]

text:
Only usable when the action is announced.
If the action is blocked, the resulting combat is at close range. Other effects cannot change this; skip the determine range step during that combat.
flavor:
He who is skilled in the attack flashes forth from the topmost heights of heaven, making it impossible for the enemy to guard against him.
Sun Tzu, "The Art of War"

text:
Unique location.
During your influence phase, you can lock this location to add 1 blood to a Brujah antitribu in your uncontrolled region.

Master.
Put this card on a Gangrel. This vampire gets -1 bleed.

rulings.text: Can only be played if a Blood Hunt referendum succeeds, after votes and ballots have been cast. [LSJ 20081203-2]

text:
Master: out-of-turn.
Cancel a blood hunt called on a Gangrel antitribu. You may play this card during your turn.
flavor:
In America there are factions, but no conspiracies.
Alexis de Tocqueville, "Democracy in America"

rulings.text: Cannot be used or played if the conditions for the terms of the referendum cannot be met (e.g. no legal selection, insufficient cards/players to choose from, prohibited by card text, uniqueness, etc). [LSJ 20100129] [ANK 20191228]

text:
Title.
In this referendum, each Gangrel gets an extra vote. Choose a ready Camarilla Gangrel. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen Gangrel to represent the unique Camarilla title of Gangrel Justicar. This could lead to a contested title.

Unique.
Put this card in play. Gangrel you control get +1 strength. Non-Ravnos minions can burn this card as a Ⓓ action.

rulings.text: Does not count as a "slave" nor as a "Gargoyle" for game purposes. He is just an ally. [LSJ 20011210-4]

text:
Ally with 3 life. 2 strength, 0 bleed.
Gargoyle Slave cannot use ranged weapons. Gargoyle may prevent one damage each combat. If Gargoyle has less than 3 life, he or she can gain one life as a +1 stealth action.

rulings.text: When ending combat, cards that are played at the end of round/combat can still be played (eg. {101945|Taste of Vitae}, {100549|Disarm}). [RTR 20001020] [LSJ 20001024]

Can only retrieve cards whose requirements explicitly include Anarch (e.g. {101567|Reckless Agitation}) or Baron (e.g. {101324|Open War}); cannot retrieve cards that have a negative requirement that does not exclude Anarch, like "Non-Camarilla" (e.g. {101022|Jericho Founding}). [ANK 20250320] [LSJ 20080603] [LSJ 20050128]
Both the card in the ash heap and the card in hand have to be named when announcing the action or effect. [LSJ 20000222] [LSJ 20011023]

text:
Unique location.
You can lock this location and burn 1 pool during your unlock phase to exchange one card from your hand for one card in your ash heap requiring an Anarch. You can lock this location before range is determined to end a combat involving an Anarch you control and another Anarch.

rulings.text: The ability to burn an opponent going to torpor is not part of the strike. It can be used if the opponent dodges the strike but is still going to torpor. [ANK 20210612] [LSJ 20020416-2]

text:
Melee weapon.
Strike: strength damage, only usable at close range. If the opposing vampire would go to torpor during the strike resolution step of this strike and the bearer remains ready, the bearer may burn this card to burn the opposing vampire instead. This is not considered diablerie.

rulings.text: A second copy allows a second use in the same combat. [ANK 20230316]

text:
Melee weapon.
3 damage each strike. This weapon is only usable once each combat.

rulings.text: The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]
rulings.group: Action requirements from a card in play

text:
+1 stealth action. Unique.
Put this card in play with 1 counter. During your unlock phase, add 1 counter to this card. During your prey's unlock phase, for each counter on this card, they burn 1 pool or remove a library card at random in their ash heap from the game. Hecata you control with capacity 4 or more can add 1 counter to this card as a +1 stealth action. Vampires can burn this card as a Ⓓ action.

rulings.text: Only usable to move the target vampire from your uncontrolled region to your ready region. It cannot rescue a vampire from torpor. [LSJ 20030520-1]
Can be used (if unlocked) during any Methuselah's influence phase. [ANK 20240118]

text:
+1 stealth action. Unique.
Put this card in play, locked, and choose a younger Gangrel in your uncontrolled region. During the influence phase, you may lock this card to move that Gangrel from your uncontrolled region to your ready region, with any counters he or she has, unless that Gangrel would contest a vampire in play. Any vampire can burn this card as a Ⓓ action that costs 1 pool.

rulings.text: [nec] The card to retrieve must be announced when declaring the action. [LSJ 20010627]

When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
+1 stealth action. Requires an Anarch.
[nec] This Anarch unlocks. Move a card from your ash heap to your hand.
[pre] This Anarch unlocks and gets +1 stealth until the end of the turn.
[vic] This Anarch unlocks and gets +1 strength until your unlock phase.

rulings.text: Does not protect the minion's equipment, retainers, or any other cards on him. Just him and his blood. [LSJ 20031118]
[obf]The optional maneuver cannot be used if the strike cannot be used (eg. {100916|Hidden Lurker}). [LSJ 20021028]

text:
[obf] Strike: dodge, with an optional maneuver.
[OBF] Only usable before range is determined. For each strike made against this vampire, flip a coin. If it's tails, the strike has no effect on this vampire. This lasts until heads is flipped or combat ends. A vampire can play only one Gemini's Mirror at superior each combat.

rulings.text: A vampire with no circle designation is in his own unique circle. Vampires with the same name (eg. {100633|The Embrace}, non-unique vampires) do not share a circle by default, each has his own circle of one by default. [LSJ 20020609]

text:
Choose X ready Blood Brothers you control who belong to the same circle as this reacting vampire (including this vampire). Each chosen vampire must burn a blood, or this card has no effect.
[san] +X intercept.
[SAN] +X intercept, and this vampire may play cards as if he or she possessed all of the chosen Blood Brothers' Disciplines for the remainder of the action.

rulings.text: "Since your last turn" means between the end of your last turn and now. Your last turn does not qualify, your current turn does. [LSJ 20020429]
A minion can only perform this special hunt once per turn. [RBK action-card-or-card-in-play]
Is an undirected action, even when targeting another Methuselah's ash heap. [LSJ 20010627] [ANK 20180202]
Cannot be played if no target is available in any Methuselah's ash heap. [ANK 20200420-3]

text:
+1 stealth hunt action.
Choose a minion or retainer in any ash heap who was burned from play since your last turn. Remove the chosen minion or retainer from the game to add X blood to this Harbinger of Skulls, where X is the capacity of the chosen vampire or the starting life of the chosen ally or retainer.

rulings.text: Cannot be used if blocked when leaving torpor, as no combat would happen. [ANK 20181122-1]
Ghouls are monsters, not mortal. [ANK 20200203-2] [LSJ 20060515]

text:
Ghoul with 4 life. Requires a ready vampire.
When this vampire is blocked, he or she may burn this retainer and unlock instead of entering combat. (This does not unlock the blocker.)

rulings.text: Ghouls are monsters, not mortal. [ANK 20200203-2] [LSJ 20060515]

When blocked, all "if blocked" effects must be applied, ordered by the acting Methuselah, before any other card or effect can be used (eg. {100476|Crypt's Sons}, {100323|Change of Target}). [ANK 20220116] [ANK 20211207] [ANK 20210627] [RTR 19991206] [LSJ 20091125]

text:
Ghoul with 1 life. Requires a ready Laibon.
The vampire with this retainer may move it to another ready vampire as a +1 stealth action. If the action is successful, the new employer gains 1 blood from the blood bank, and the acting vampire unlocks at the end of the turn. If the action is blocked, cancel combat, burn the Messenger, and do not lock the blocking minion.

rulings.text: The 1 Damage is not inflicted at long range. [ANK 20210929]

The Ghoul is not the bearer of the weapon, the employer is (eg. using {100810|Garrote} does not allow the bearer to burn the opponent, {102208|Zip Gun}'s damage go to the employer). [TOM 19951114] [LSJ 20080210]

The Ghoul uses weapon as if making the strike, including all side-effects (eg. {102208|Zip Gun}'s damage, {102169|Weighted Walking Stick} tokens), and is not limited to damage dealing strikes (eg. {101655|Rowan Ring} sends to torpor, {100745|Flash Grenade} ends combat). It is not a strike and cannot provide a maneuver, press or additional strike to the employer (eg. {101191|Meat Hook}). [LSJ 20080210]
The Ghoul cannot play ammo cards (not even with a {101142|Magazine}), although it can benefit from ammo cards played by the employer in an earlier round (eg. {101689|Scattershot}). [LSJ 20080210]
The damage is environmental, the retainer is the damage source. Immunity to retainer or retainer type works against it. [ANK 20180612] [ANK 20211127]

Damage is inflicted even against a dodge. A "strike: combat ends" ends combat before damage is applied, as will a combattant going to torpor during first strike. [RTR 19941109] [TOM 19951216] [PIB 20140324] [ANK 20200422]
Ghouls are monsters, not mortal. [ANK 20200203-2] [LSJ 20060515]

text:
Ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength.
During the initial strike resolution each round, the Ghoul Retainer inflicts 1 damage or may use a weapon not used by the employing minion (or another retainer) that round (either before or after). This is not a strike, although it does count as "using" the weapon.

rulings.text: The ally is recruited as a mortal and changed to a ghoul afterwards (eg. {101904|Sunset Strip, Hollywood} can be used to reduce its cost). His "starting life" is still the base mortal amount. [LSJ 20030520-2]
Goes to the ash heap when played, if it has been removed when the action succeeds, it has no effect. [ANK 20220805]
Ghouls are monsters, not mortal. [ANK 20200203-2] [LSJ 20060515]

Must be played (as well as other "as the action is announced" action modifiers) before action modifiers that are not explicitly played "as the action is announced" (e.g., {100401|Conditioning}). [ANK 20190425]
Replace the action card (if any) before playing it. [ANK 20181208]

Does not stack with similar effects (or another copy of itself) to provide superior version of the discipline(s) (e.g. {101083|Leech} and {101526|Putrescent Servitude} together does not provide superior [POT]) [ANK 20180111]
Can be used to meet one (but not more than one) of the normal Discipline requirements of a multi-Discipline card. [LSJ 20011217] [LSJ 20090508]
While a minion has an effect that allows them to play cards that require Discipline(s), they do not actually have those Discipline(s). [LSJ 19980303]

Multiple similar effects (e.g. two {100978|Infernal Familiar}, or {200616|Ian Forestal} with an {100978|Infernal Familiar}) cannot be used to meet the requirements of a multi-Discipline card that the minion is missing one or more Disciplines to play. [LSJ 20020218]

While using their ability to meet a discipline requirement, they also meet that requirement for any other cards associated with the original effect (e.g. meeting the [ani] requirement for {101342|Pack Alpha} or {101255|Muricia's Call} also meets the [ani] requirement for the {101550|Raven Spy} employed by that effect). [LSJ 20080205-2] [LSJ 20060417]
The ally counts as "independent" when playing cards as a vampire [LSJ 20020503] [LSJ 20060126]

text:
Only usable when the action to recruit a mortal ally is announced.
If this action is successful, put this card on that ally and add 1 additional life to the ally from the blood bank. This ally is considered a ghoul and not a mortal. Once each combat, this ally can play a strike card that requires basic Potence [pot] as a vampire.

rulings.text: If they use their last life to play an action modifier, the action fails. If they use their last life to play a strike, combat ends before strike resolution. [ANK 20180928-1]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If they takes aggravated damage from a card they plays as a vampire (eg. {100273|Burst of Sunlight}), they lose one life but do not go to torpor. [LSJ 20060409]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If they use their last life to pay for an action, the action still resolves fully. If that leads to an oust, the oust is resolved before resolving effects triggered by the fact that they burn. [LSJ 20080512]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If a card they play as a vampire sends them to torpor (eg. {101581|Reform Body}), they burn. REVERSAL of previous rulings. [LSJ 20060409]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: They cannot use a card to commit diablerie (eg. {100043|Amaranth}) [RTR 19970630] [LSJ 20080717]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: Ghouls are monsters, not mortal. [ANK 20200203-2] [LSJ 20060515]
The ally counts as "independent" when playing cards as a vampire [LSJ 20020503] [LSJ 20060126]

text:
Ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
This ally can strike: 1R damage. This ally can play cards requiring basic Potence [pot] as a 2-capacity vampire.

rulings.text: Ghouls are monsters, not mortal. [ANK 20200203-2] [LSJ 20060515]

The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]
rulings.group: Action requirements from a card in play

text:
Unique ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
The Ghouls of Plaza Morería can strike: 1R damage. They get 1 optional maneuver each combat. They can burn 1 blood from a ready vampire and put 1 container counter on themselves as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. Any ready Banu Haqim can burn X container counters from them to gain X blood as a +1 stealth action.

rulings.text: She can use her ability to burn an equipment an opponent has commited to use as a strike (eg. by using the maneuver of a {100001|.44 Magnum}). In this case the opponent strike has no effect. [PIB 20141026]
She cannot use her ability to inflict damage if a "Strike: combat ends" was used, or if combat ends due to first strike aggravated damage. [ANK 20211130]
They can lock to use their ability the turn they where recruited. [ANK 20180517]
rulings.group: Allies with "lock this ally to" abilities

text:
Unique wraith with 2 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
If another minion you control is in combat, Gianna can lock and burn herself to burn an equipment on the opposing minion, or lock during normal strike resolution to inflict 1 unpreventable damage on the opposing minion.

es.name: Sangre del gigante
es.text:
Sólo se puede jugar un ejemplar de esta carta por partida.
Rellena a un vampiro hasta su plena capacidad con sangre del banco de sangre.
es.flavor:
Ox ya es difícil de manejar. Habría sido imparable si hubiera bebido la sangre del gigante. ¡No podíamos permitirlo!
Ventrue, Trondheim, Trama de 2002

fr.name: Sang de géant
fr.text:
Pas plus d'un seul exemplaire ne peut être joué par partie.
Choisissez n'importe quel vampire. Le vampire choisi gagne assez de points de sang pour atteindre sa capacité maximale.

rulings.text: Cannot target an uncontrolled vampire. [LSJ 20061109]

text:
Only one Giant's Blood can be played in a game.
Choose a vampire. The chosen vampire gains enough blood to reach full capacity.
flavor:
Ox is already difficult to manage. He would have been unstoppable after drinking the Giant's Blood. We couldn't allow it!

were like an underworld of death,
but for the spark
in the Gypsy boy's black eyes.
Edward Thomas, "The Gypsy"

Reg Driscoll, Samedi

Único.
Este vampiro obtiene Potencia superior [POT]. Este vampiro puede pasar a un vampiro de tu montón de ceniza a tu zona incontrolada con una acción.

flavor:
If music be the food of love, play on;
Give me excess of it, that, surfeiting,
The appetite may sicken, and so die.
William Shakespeare, "Twelfth Night", act I, scene 1

Donald H. McGannon

A través de mi ruina id pues sin que os remuerda.
Charles Baudelaire, "El muerto alegre"

À travers ma ruine allez donc sans remords.
Charles Baudelaire, "Le Mort joyeux"

es.name: Corazón de Nizchetus

Único.
Si el portador está preparado durante tu fase de enderezamiento, puedes robar hasta 3 cartas sin descartarte y luego pasar la misma cantidad de cartas de tu mano al fondo de tu biblioteca.
es.flavor:
En ocasiones, creo que lo veo latir. Tan sólo sombras danzantes, quizás, pero a continuación la fortuna me sonríe.
Radu Bistri, Tzimisce

fr.name: Cœur de Nizchetus
fr.text:
Unique.
Si son possesseur est disponible durant votre phase de redressement, vous pouvez piocher jusqu'à 3 cartes sans défausser et déplacer ensuite le même nombre de cartes de votre main vers le dessous de votre bibliothèque.

De temps en temps, je pense le voir battre. Ce ne sont peut-être que des ombres dansantes, mais la fortune sourit.
Radu Bistri, Tzimisce

text:
Unique.

Occasionally, I think I see it beat. Just dancing shadows, perhaps, but fortune follows.
Radu Bistri, Tzimisce

Somos nuestro propio demonio y hacemos de este mundo nuestro propio infierno.
Oscar Wilde

De flechas y de torres a plena luz la silueta

Paul Verlaine, "Efecto nocturno"

fr.text:
Lieu unique.
Vous pouvez l'incliner pour déplacer des points de sang, des équipements et/ou des compagnons entre deux vampires disponibles que vous contrôlez. Non utilisable durant une action.
fr.flavor:
La nuit. La pluie. Un ciel blafard que déchiquette
De flèches et de tours à jour la silhouette
D'une ville gothique éteinte au lointain gris.
Paul Verlaine, "Effet de nuit"

rulings.text: May not be locked "in response" to an effect: all effects are instantaneous except for actions and certain combat effects. [LSJ 20010110] [LSJ 20050111]
Cannot be used to put a card on a vampire who is prohibited to have it (eg. an equipment on {200424|Enkidu, The Noah}). [LSJ 19980831]
Cannot be used before damage is inflicted after action resolution (eg. {100759|Force of Will}, {100492|Daring the Dawn}): this is still during the action. [ANK 20171124]
Cannot be used after a diablerie or an {100004|Abactor} resolution and before the Blood Hunt: the Blood Hunt is part of the action although it is independent from it. [LSJ 20090722-2] [LSJ 20030618]
Can be used to move more blood than the target can hold: the excess goes to the blood bank. [ANK 20170804]
Can be used between two actions during another Methuselah's turn. [ANK 20210608]

text:
Unique location.
Lock to move blood, equipment and/or retainers between any two ready vampires you control. Cannot be used during an action.
flavor:
Night. Rain. The lurid sky that lets
The spires and towers show grey silhouettes
Of an old Gothic town by distance dimmed.
Paul Verlaine, "Night Effect"

rulings.text: If directly put (and not equipped) on the vampire, it is not locked (eg. using {100038|Alastor}). [LSJ 20090415] [LSJ 20100119]
It comes locked if it is equipped, even in an non-standard fashion (eg. {101143|Magic of the Smith}). [LSJ 20100119]

text:
Vehicle.
When a minion equips with the Helicopter, lock it. After resolving a successful action, this minion may lock the Helicopter to unlock. A minion may have only one vehicle.
flavor:
We'll take a helicopter. There and back in a night.
Hesha Ruhadze, Follower of Set

rulings.text: [cel] A limited additional strike can be played before or after. [LSJ 20001206] [ANK 20211124]

When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
Requires an Anarch. Only one Hell-for-Leather can be played at a given Discipline each combat.
[ani] Strike: dodge, with 1 additional strike (limited).
[cel] Additional strike that does not count against the limit.
[obt] Only usable if this Anarch is ready and the opposing minion is not. The opposing minion's controller burns 2 pool.

rulings.text: Ghouls are monsters, not mortal. [ANK 20200203-2] [LSJ 20060515]

text:
Ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
The Hellhound cannot take actions. If the Hellhound has only 1 life during your unlock phase, it gains 1 life from the blood bank.

rulings.text: Can use {100334|Charming Lobby} to call a referendum "as a vampire". [RTR 20020501]
If they use their last life to play an action modifier, the action fails. If they use their last life to play a strike, combat ends before strike resolution. [ANK 20180928-1]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If they takes aggravated damage from a card they plays as a vampire (eg. {100273|Burst of Sunlight}), they lose one life but do not go to torpor. [LSJ 20060409]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If they use their last life to pay for an action, the action still resolves fully. If that leads to an oust, the oust is resolved before resolving effects triggered by the fact that they burn. [LSJ 20080512]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If a card they play as a vampire sends them to torpor (eg. {101581|Reform Body}), they burn. REVERSAL of previous rulings. [LSJ 20060409]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: They cannot use a card to commit diablerie (eg. {100043|Amaranth}) [RTR 19970630] [LSJ 20080717]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: Does not stack with similar effects (or another copy of itself) to provide superior version of the discipline(s) (e.g. {101083|Leech} and {101526|Putrescent Servitude} together does not provide superior [POT]) [ANK 20180111]
While a minion has an effect that allows them to play cards that require Discipline(s), they do not actually have those Discipline(s). [LSJ 19980303]

Multiple similar effects (e.g. two {100978|Infernal Familiar}, or {200616|Ian Forestal} with an {100978|Infernal Familiar}) cannot be used to meet the requirements of a multi-Discipline card that the minion is missing one or more Disciplines to play. [LSJ 20020218]

While using their ability to meet a discipline requirement, they also meet that requirement for any other cards associated with the original effect (e.g. meeting the [ani] requirement for {101342|Pack Alpha} or {101255|Muricia's Call} also meets the [ani] requirement for the {101550|Raven Spy} employed by that effect). [LSJ 20080205-2] [LSJ 20060417]
The ally counts as "independent" when playing cards as a vampire [LSJ 20020503] [LSJ 20060126]

text:
Demon with 5 life. 3 strength, 1 bleed, flight [FLIGHT]. Infernal.
Herald of Topheth can play cards requiring basic Daimoinon [dai], basic Potence [pot] and/or basic Presence [pre] as a vampire with capacity 5. It can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action. If it has 4 or fewer life during your unlock phase, it gains 1 life.

es.name: El poder de un héroe
es.text:
Acción con +3 de sigilo.
[pot] Ponle esta carta a este vampiro. Este vampiro obtiene +1 de fuerza. Este vampiro puede atacar quemando equipo. Quema esta carta si este vampiro está en letargo. Un vampiro puede tener sólo un ejemplar de esta carta.
[POT] Como antes, con +1 de fuerza adicional, y este vampiro puede atacar con 2 de daño a distancia.

fr.name: Puissance héroïque
fr.text:
Action à +3 en discrétion.
[pot] Mettre cette carte sur ce vampire. Ce vampire reçoit +1 en force. Ce vampire peut frapper : brûler un équipement. Brûlez cette carte si ce vampire est en torpeur. Un vampire ne peut en avoir qu'un seul exemplaire.
[POT] Comme ci-dessus, avec +1 en force supplémentaire et ce vampire peut frapper à toute portée : 2 points de dégâts.

rulings.text: The strikes it provides are Potence [pot] strikes (eg. they benefit from {100971|Increased Strength}). [LSJ 20081120-2]

text:
+3 stealth action.
[pot] Put this card on this vampire. This vampire gets +1 strength. This vampire can strike: burn equipment. Burn this card if this vampire is in torpor. A vampire can have only one Heroic Might.
[POT] As above, with an additional +1 strength, and this vampire can strike: 2R damage.

Ally with 3 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Hexaped may give a link counter to any Methuselah as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. Remove Hexaped from the game if that action succeeds. The Tremere antitribu who recruited it gets +1 bleed and +1 stealth when bleeding the Methuselah with that link counter.

rulings.text: When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
[dai] Strike: 2R damage.
[str] Strike: 1R aggravated damage. [str] is not a Discipline.
[STR] As [str] above, and the damage is unpreventable.

rulings.text: Effects that end combat and then do something else after combat (include continuing the action as if unblocked) will be lost, except for unlock effects. [LSJ 19980109] [RTR 20020501]
Cannot be used to start a new combat if there is already a pending combat queued. [RTR 20020501]
Can only be played by the controller of the acting minion. [LSJ 19990425]
Cannot be used to enter combat with a vampire on his way to torpor. [LSJ 20100604-1]
Minions that cannot strike, cannot play or use the maneuver from a strike (e.g. {100001|.44 Magnum}, {101982|Thrown Gate}). [LSJ 20001126]
Minions can (uselessly) gain additional strikes even if they cannot strike. [LSJ 19970814-2]

text:
Only usable by a ready unlocked vampire other than the acting minion. Only usable after a combat between the acting minion you control and a blocking minion.
[obf] Lock this vampire. This vampire enters combat with the blocking minion. The first round of this new combat, the blocking minion cannot strike.
[OBF] As above, with an optional press.

[obf] Put this card in play. Your minions get +1 stealth on non-bleeding actions directed at your prey. Any minion may burn this card as a Ⓓ action. A Methuselah may have only one Hidden Pathways in play.
[OBF] As above, but playing this card is a +1 stealth action.

es.name: Fuerza oculta
es.text:
[for] Prevente de X+1 de daño.
[FOR] Como antes, con 1 acoso opcional.

fr.name: Force cachée
fr.text:
[for] Prévenir X+1 points de dégâts.
[FOR] Comme ci-dessus, avec 1 poursuite optionnelle.

rulings.text: The 'X' in card text refers to the cost of the card. [LSJ 19970224]
Prevents up to X+1 damage, it can prevent less (X can be higher than strictly needed). [RTR 20041202] [PIB 20121202]
Cannot be used if there is no damage to prevent (X cannot be negative). [LSJ 20001114] [LSJ 20030121]
X can be zero, but not less than zero. [LSJ 20030502]
[FOR]The optional press can only be used during the current round. [TOM 19960521]

text:
[for] Prevent X+1 damage.
[FOR] As above, with 1 optional press.

rulings.text: [REACTION] Can be used only when reactions can be used (unlocked or with a wake effect). It does not count as playing a reaction card. [LSJ 20070403] [LSJ 20070413]
[REACTION] Modifiers and reactions that can be used at the end/after an action can still be used afterwards. [LSJ 20041022] [RTR 20180719] [ANK 20221205]
[REACTION] The action has reached resolution, so is subject to NRA (Non Repeatable Action) rules. [RTR 20180719] [ANK 20211015]
[ACTION MODIFIER] [1 CONVICTION] Effects that are used "as the action is announced" must be used before playing "regular" action modifier or reaction cards. [ANK 20190425]
[REACTION]Cannot be used while a block is being attempted, or has already been successful. [ANK 20260316] [LSJ 20041022]

[REACTION]If the action fails, modifiers and reactions that can be used at the end/after an action can still be used afterwards (after combat, if any). [ANK 20221205] [ANK 20220118] [RTR 20180719] [LSJ 20041022]
[REACTION]If the action fails, the action has reached resolution, so is subject to NRA (Non Repeatable Action) rules. [ANK 20211015] [RTR 20180719]
[REACTION]If an action fails, it was not blocked. Cards/effects depending on a block (e.g. {101222|Mirror Image}, [FOR] {100788|Freak Drive}) cannot be played/used. [LSJ 20070219]

text:
Not usable by an imbued with <Illuminate>.
[ACTION MODIFIER] [1 CONVICTION] Only usable as the action is announced. Monsters get -1 intercept against this action.
[REACTION] [1 CONVICTION] Only usable during a monster's action directed at this imbued. The action fails.
flavor:
The surgical strike is better. Do damage. Disappear. Repeat.
Joshua "God45" Matthews, Wayward

rulings.text: [val] An ally has life, not blood, he cannot pay. [LSJ 20050216] [ANK 20190701]
[VAL] To reduce a bleed against another Methuselah, you need to be unlocked. [RBK wording-templates] [ANK 20230817]

When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

[val],[VAL]Sequencing rules apply. You must gain the impulse to be able to use the reaction, or use the effect (whichever is applicable).  Other Methuselahs must declare block attempts (or not) and pass the impulse to you as normal. [ANK 20200607]
Cannot be used while a block is being attempted, or has already been successful. [ANK 20260316] [LSJ 20041022]

[val]If the action fails, modifiers and reactions that can be used at the end/after an action can still be used afterwards (after combat, if any). [ANK 20221205] [ANK 20220118] [RTR 20180719] [LSJ 20041022]
[val]If the action fails, the action has reached resolution, so is subject to NRA (Non Repeatable Action) rules. [ANK 20211015] [RTR 20180719]
[val]If an action fails, it was not blocked. Cards/effects depending on a block (e.g. {101222|Mirror Image}, [FOR] {100788|Freak Drive}) cannot be played/used. [LSJ 20070219]

text:
[aus] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[val] The action fails, unless the acting minion burns 1 blood. Only one Hide the Heart can be played at [val] each action.
[VAL] Reduce a bleed against you by 2, or lock to reduce a bleed against any Methuselah by 2.

rulings.text: Cannot be used to cancel a card that could be played with [aus] but has not been (eg. {100066|Anesthetic Touch} played with [obe]). [PIB 20130704]

Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]

text:
[obf] [COMBAT] Cancel a combat card requiring Auspex [aus] as it is played, and its cost is not paid.
[OBF] [ACTION MODIFIER] Cancel a reaction card requiring Auspex as it is played, and its cost is not paid.

rulings.text: Cannot be used or played if the conditions for the terms of the referendum cannot be met (e.g. no legal selection, insufficient cards/players to choose from, prohibited by card text, uniqueness, etc). [LSJ 20100129] [ANK 20191228]

text:
Requires a Laibon.
If this referendum succeeds, put this card on the acting Laibon. This Laibon gets +1 bleed. Cards which require a non-Laibon title cannot be played on this Laibon nor while this Laibon is acting. A minion may have only one Hiding in the Open.

Choose any Ministry. Successful referendum means this card is put on the chosen vampire. This vampire gets +1 vote. If a vampire blocks this vampire, the blocking vampire burns 1 blood before block resolution.

rulings.text: The discard effect happens after action resolution (and all combats, if any). [LSJ 20060426]

text:
Requires a Laibon with three or more Aye.
+1 stealth, +2 stealth if this action is undirected. If the action succeeds, you may discard up to two cards from your hand (draw afterward).

rulings.text: When setting the range for the round, no other effect can be used to reset the range. Skip the determine range step this round, but other pre-range effects can be played afterwards. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20180720]

[FLIGHT]Once the range is set, no other effect can be used to reset the range that round, but other pre-range effects can be played afterwards. Skip the Determine Range step for that round. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20180720]
[FLIGHT]If another effect was already setting that round's range (e.g. {101276|Neutral Guard}), that effect has priority. [PIB 20120214]

text: Maneuver, only usable to go to long range. If this minion has flight [FLIGHT] and the opposing minion does not, play before range is determined to set the range for the round to long. A minion may play only one High Ground each round.

Master: unique location.
Gain 4 pool when you put this card into play or gain control of it. Any vampire can steal this location for his or her controller as a Ⓓ action. Burn 4 pool when you lose control of the High Museum (including when it is burned or becomes contested).

rulings.text: Applies to the current action card, if any. [LSJ 20091002]
The burn option cannot be used if control a Laibon with three Orun, even if they are in torpor. [ANK 20240610]

text:
Requires a Laibon with three or more Orun.
For the remainder of this action, cards that require any Disciplines cost this Laibon 1 less blood, and your hand size is one card larger.
flavor:
As nightfall does not come at once, neither does oppression... it is in such twilight that we all must be aware of change in the air -- however slight -- lest we become victims of the darkness.
William O. Douglas

text: Only usable if playing for ante. Successful referendum means each Methuselah decides whether to ante the next card in his or her library or be ousted from the game. Decisions should be made simultaneously, as follows: each Methuselah holds out a hand with zero or one blood in it. Open hands simultaneously. A pool in a Methuselah's hand indicates that he or she chooses not to be ousted.

[LSJ 20080205-2] [LSJ 20060417]
