The additional strike is mandatory. [PIB 20121028]

text:
Unique werewolf with 3 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
High Top gets +1 intercept. High Top may enter combat with any minion controlled by another Methuselah as a Ⓓ action. High Top gets an additional strike (limited) each round and an optional maneuver once each combat. He may play cards requiring basic Celerity [cel] as a vampire with a capacity of 4. If High Top has less than 3 life during your unlock phase, he gains 1 life.

Vehicle. Haven.
This minion gets an optional press to end combat on the first round of combat. If the bearer is an anarch, any vampire attempting an action directed at this anarch doesn't unlock as normal on his or her next unlock phase (even if the action isn't successful). Any werewolf may burn this equipment and enter combat with this minion as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. A minion may have only one haven and only one vehicle.
flavor:
The greatest haven is motion.
Stephen Lenoir, Lasombra antitribu

rulings.text: A vampire with no circle designation is in his own unique circle. Vampires with the same name (eg. {100633|The Embrace}, non-unique vampires) do not share a circle by default, each has his own circle of one by default. [LSJ 20020609]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[san] Unlock this Blood Brother and another ready Blood Brother of the same circle. Only one Hive Mind can be played at [san] each turn.
[SAN] Add 3 blood to a Blood Brother of the same circle in your uncontrolled region.

es.name: Homúnculo
es.text:
Criado con 1 de vida.
[pro] Durante la fase de enderezamiento de cualquier Matusalén, este vampiro puede quemar 1 de sangre para enderezarse.
[PRO] Como antes, pero el Homúnculo tiene 2 de vida.
es.flavor:
Un montón de huesos en un saco de piel, un globo desinflado; un bulto horrible.
R. Chetwynd-Hayes, "Buscando algo que chupar"

fr.name: Homoncule
fr.text:
Compagnon avec 1 point de vie.
[pro] Durant la phase de redressement de n'importe quel Mathusalem, ce vampire peut brûler 1 point de sang pour se redresser.
[PRO] Comme ci-dessus, mais ce compagnon a 2 points de vie.
fr.flavor:
Un tas d'os dans un sac de peau, un ballon dégonflé ; un paquet ignoble.
Ronald Chetwynd-Hayes, "En quête de quelque chose à sucer"

rulings.text: The discipline level used to recruit it decides which version it is (inferior or superior). This does not change once it is in play. [RTR 19941109] [ANK 20180612]

text:
Retainer with 1 life.
[pro] During any Methuselah's unlock phase, the employer can burn 1 blood to unlock.
[PRO] As above, but Homunculus has 2 life.
flavor:
A pile of bones in a skin bag, a deflated balloon; a hideous bundle.
R. Chetwynd-Hayes, "Looking For Something To Suck"

text: Successful referendum means each ready vampire with capacity of 8 or more gains 1 blood from the blood bank, and each vampire with capacity of 8 or more in any uncontrolled region gains 1 blood from the blood bank.

es.name: Forma horrenda
es.text:
Sólo utilizable antes de determinar la distancia.
[vic] Este vampiro obtiene +1 de fuerza en este combate.
[VIC] Como antes, y este vampiro puede prevenirse de 1 de daño por asalto.
es.flavor:
¿De dónde sales y quién eres, forma execrable?
John Milton, "El paraíso perdido"

fr.name: Forme monstrueuse
fr.text:
Seulement utilisable avant l'étape de manœuvre.
[vic] Ce vampire reçoit +1 en force ce combat.
[VIC] Comme ci-dessus et ce vampire peut prévenir 1 point de dégâts durant chaque round.
fr.flavor:
D'où viens-tu, et qui es-tu, forme exécrable...
John Milton, "Le Paradis perdu"

text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[vic] This vampire gets +1 strength this combat.
[VIC] As above, and this vampire can prevent 1 damage each round.
flavor:
Whence and what art thou, execrable shape?
John Milton, "Paradise Lost"

rulings.text: If no weapon can be found, the cost is still paid. [TOM 19951212-1]
If the weapon retrieved has requirements that the vampire does not meet, then it is burned. [RTR 20010711]
The weapon is burned or returned to the library if it is still in play, even if it is not on the minion anymore (eg. {101655|Rowan Ring}, {102192|Wooden Stake}). [LSJ 20001019]

text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[chi] Equip this vampire with the first weapon you find in your library (working down from the top; shuffle afterward; if the requirements are not met, it is burned). This weapon does not contest any card in play. Do not pay the cost for this weapon. At the end of this combat, burn the weapon if it is still in play.
[CHI] As above, but shuffle the equipment into your library at the end of combat if it is still in play.

Only usable when this vampire is blocked.
[pro] Unlock the blocking minion. This action is not blocked, and it is now unblockable.

rulings.text: If used on an ally and it burns as a result, this counts as a Ⓓ action burning an ally (eg. Trophies, {101479|Predator's Transformation}). [ANK 20220507]

text:
[pot] Ⓓ Inflict 1 unpreventable damage on a ready minion.
[POT] Ⓓ Inflict 2 unpreventable damage on a ready minion.

rulings.text: The action is successful even if no blood is gained. [LSJ 20050720-2]
The hunt bonus applies to non-standard hunt actions, blood comes from the target of the hunt. [RTR 20030519] [RTR 20180511]

text:
Master: unique location. Requires a ready anarch.
Lock when an anarch announces a hunting action. If that action is successful, the anarch gains an additional blood.
flavor:
It's easy work. Just eyeball the donor's chart before snacking so you don't get a sour one.
Sandra White, Caitiff anarch

rulings.text: The bidding is conducted in an open format, similar to a referendum. The player who played the card conducts the auction. [LSJ 19990104]

A Methuselah must be able to pay for their bid. Since the controller pays a reduce cost, they can bid up to twice their current pool total, while other Methuselahs can bid up to their pool total. [LSJ 19990825]

text:
Master.
Choose a vampire with capacity of 6 or less. Each Methuselah bids pool for control of that vampire. The highest bid goes to the vampire's controller; that bidder then takes control of the vampire. If the controller wins, half the winning bid (rounded up) goes to the blood bank.

rulings.text: The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]
rulings.group: Action requirements from a card in play

text:
Unique master.
Put this card on a ready Samedi you control. During your unlock phase, this Samedi gains 1 blood from the bank, and he or she may lock to gain an additional blood. Any other Samedi may move this card to himself or herself as a +1 stealth action.

rulings.text: When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]
[pot],[tem]You can draw more cards than are in the library or crypt (even from an empty library or crypt); draw as much as you can. [LSJ 20060620]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[pot] Draw 3 cards (discard down afterward).
[tem] Draw 4 cards without discarding, then move four cards from your hand to the top of your library in any order. Unlock this vampire.
[TEM] Put this card on this vampire. During your unlock phase, this vampire can burn 2 blood to add 1 counter to this card. While this vampire is ready, you get +1 hand size for each counter on this card.

Master: unique location.
Lock to unlock any card you control that is not a minion. If you do so, neither that card nor this location unlock as normal on your next unlock phase.

[LSJ 20080205-2] [LSJ 20060417]

rulings.text: [CEL] The card you discard need not be one of the cards that you just drew. [TOM 19950924]

text:

Robert Penn Warren, "Treasure Hunt"

Mortal único con 1 de vida.
El empleador obtiene +1 de sangrado.

fr.name: J. S. Simmons, Esq.
fr.text:
Mortel unique avec 1 point de vie.
Son employeur reçoit +1 en morsure.

text:
Unique mortal with 1 life.
The employer gets +1 bleed.

rulings.text: The equipment or retainer must be announced by name, and in hand, when the card or effect is declared (before the card, if any, is replaced), but need not to be shown until the effect resolves. [LSJ 20100130] [ANK 20180925-2] [LSJ 19991207]
rulings.group: Equip or employ another card from hand

rulings.text: Cannot select cards that are "playable as if in hand" (e.g. from {100656|The Erciyes Fragments}) [LSJ 20050913]
rulings.group: Equip or employ another card from hand

rulings.text: Does not prevent the acting vampire from playing the equipment/retainer/ally directly this turn if he unlocks (not the same action). [ANK 20180817]
Requirements apply but do not count as requirements for the action (eg. you cannot use {100446|CrimethInc.} if the chosen card requires an Anarch). [ANK 20180817] [LSJ 20100303] [LSJ 20100725]
When choosing a card whose effect depend on Discipline level, the vampire decides in respect to his disciplines the normal way. [LSJ 20080803]
Is an action of the appropriate type for the chosen card (recruit/employ/equip). [TOM 19960130]

text:
+2 stealth action. Requires a ready vampire.
This vampire equips or employs an equipment or retainer from your hand. The cost of that card is reduced by 1 pool or by up to 2 blood.
flavor:
Which are the bad bars, the ones you'd only go to in order to make a score?
Theo Bell, Brujah

rulings.text: The discipline level used to recruit it decides which version it is (inferior or superior). This does not change once it is in play. [RTR 19941109] [ANK 20180612]
Is neither a mortal nor a monster. [ANK 20200203-2] [LSJ 20060515]

text:
Animal with 1 life.
[ani] If your prey controls a ready Ministry or Banu Haqim, the minion with this retainer gets +1 stealth.
[ANI] As above, but this minion gets +2 stealth.

Unique mortal with 1 life.
This minion gets an optional maneuver each combat.

es.name: Jake Washington
es.text:
Única.
Pon esta carta en juego; se convierte en un aliado mortal único con 1 de vida, 0 de fuerza y 0 de sangrado y no cuenta como carta heril mientras esté en juego. Durante tu fase de enderezamiento, puedes quemar a Jake para añadir hasta 4 de sangre a un vampiro preparado sin sangre.

fr.name: Jake Washington
fr.text:
Unique.
Mettez cette carte en jeu ; elle devient un allié mortel unique avec 1 point de vie, 0 en force et 0 en morsure et ne compte pas comme une carte de maître tant qu'elle est en jeu. Durant votre phase de redressement, vous pouvez brûler Jake pour ajouter jusqu'à 4 points de sang à un vampire disponible qui n'a pas de sang.

rulings.text: Is not an ally in the ash heap (eg. {100388|Compel the Spirit} cannot be played on him). [LSJ 20071014] [LSJ 20020115] [LSJ 20030128]
His "starting life amount" is 1 ({102087|Vagabond Mystic} cannot give hime more life). [LSJ 20030520-2]

text:
Unique.
Put this card in play; it becomes a unique mortal ally with 1 life, 0 strength and 0 bleed. During your unlock phase, you can burn Jake to add up to 4 blood to a ready vampire with no blood.

rulings.text: Only requires one clan or the other (Tremere or Tremere antitribu) to be played. [ANK 20190203]
Using the Jar action does not force the minion to strike with it if he is blocked. [LSJ 19971215]
{100819|Ghoul Retainer} is not the bearer so he can use the Jar even if it has no counter on it. [ANK 20171003]
When used as a strike, it does not burn if combat ends before it resolves (eg. if the opponent uses a "strike: combat ends"). [LSJ 20001127-2] [LSJ 20010806-1] [LSJ 19981006]
Once in play, can be equipped from the minion it's on (rulebook action) by another minion that does not meet the requirements. [ANK 20180719-3]

The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]

rulings.text: The action provided by the equipment to the attached minion fizzles (resolves successfully for no effect) if the equipment is not attached to the acting minion when the action resolves unblocked. [RTR 19960221]

text:
Weapon.
The bearer may use this weapon only if it has a blood on it. Strike: 3R aggravated damage. This minion may inflict 3 aggravated damage on another minion as a Ⓓ action. Burn after either use. Any Gargoyle enslaved to this vampire may move 1 blood to this card as a +1 stealth action.

rulings.text: Does not damage vampires: an empty vampire will simply attempt to burn blood and fail. [TOM 19951212-2]
[SER] If it burns an ally as a result, this counts as a Ⓓ action burning an ally (eg. Trophies, {101479|Predator's Transformation}). [ANK 20220507]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Ⓓ Lock a ready minion.
[NEC] As above, and burn 1 blood or life from the target minion.

Requires a non-Camarilla vampire.
Successful referendum means all locations are burned. Any Methuselah can keep any locations he or she controls by repaying their pool cost.

rulings.text: [SER]Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

[SER]If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

[SER]A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]
[ser]The optional press can only be used during the current round. [TOM 19960521]

text:
Only usable in combat with an ally or younger vampire.
[ser] Strike: dodge, with 1 optional press, only usable to end combat.
[SER] Cancel the opposing minion's strike card as it is played, and its cost is not paid (the minion chooses another strike). A vampire can play only one The Jones at superior each round.

[LSJ 20080604]

text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. You can lock this card and burn 1 pool to have an action directed at a Pander you control fail. During your master phase, choose a Pander; once this turn, the chosen Pander can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action. Sabbat vampires can burn this card as a Ⓓ action.

text:
Unique melee weapon.
Strike: strength+1 damage. Damage inflicted on a Kiasyd by this weapon is aggravated. Once each combat, the bearer can cancel a grapple card played by the opposing minion as it is played, its cost is not paid, and the bearer's initial strike this round must be or have been with this weapon (not usable otherwise).

rulings.text: Equipping it does not put a counter on it [LSJ 20100207-2]
Once in play, can be equipped from the minion it's on (rulebook action) by another minion that does not meet the requirements. [ANK 20180719-3]
The fact it is Unique has no bearing on the burn option. You cannot use the burn option if you meet the requirement, even if you already have a copy of the card in play. [LSJ 20100203-2]

text:
Unique.
Add 1 counter to this card after this Salubri performs a successful action. Burn these counters if this card is moved. You can remove this ready Salubri from the game to move these counters to your pool, except during an action.

[for] This vampire treats aggravated damage as normal damage this round.
[FOR] As above, but for the remainder of the action if you lock an Aye on him or her.

rulings.text: If multiple copies of the card are in play, one must pay for each of them (they stack). [ANK 20200703-4]
The effect must be applied during the unlock phase, but other effects can be applied before. If an effect applied before burns the last non-Camarilla vampire, no pool is lost. [ANK 20181016]

text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a prince or justicar.
Put this card in play. Each Methuselah controlling a non-Camarilla vampire burns 1 pool during their unlock phase. Methuselahs can burn a non-Camarilla vampire they control during their master phase to burn this card.

Requires a ready prince or justicar. +1 stealth action.
Put this card in play. Any vampire may take a Ⓓ action to enter combat with any Brujah controlled by another Methuselah. Any Methuselah may burn this card by burning a Brujah he or she controls during his or her minion phase. Only one Death to the Brujah! card may be played during a game.

Master: unique location. Hunting ground.
Lock during your unlock phase to add 1 blood to this card if it has fewer than 3 blood. Lock during your unlock phase to move all the blood on this card to a ready Laibon you control. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground card each turn.

rulings.text: Counts the bleed amount that each vampire would have when attempting to bleed his prey. [RTR 19980623]

text:
Requires a Camarilla vampire.
Successful referendum burns all vampires with a current bleed of 3 or more.

rulings.text: Once in play, can be equipped from the minion it's on (rulebook action) by another minion that does not meet the requirements. [ANK 20180719-3]

Unique melee weapon.
Strike: strength+1 aggravated damage.

text:
Unique.
This Ravnos can add 2 blood to a younger Ravnos in your uncontrolled region as a +1 stealth action that costs 1 blood. Cards requiring Chimerstry [chi] cost this Ravnos 1 fewer blood.

Requires a ready vampire. Unique.
Ⓓ Put this card on a younger ready vampire. You still control this card. This vampire cannot block undirected actions. Directed actions cost this vampire an additional blood.

rulings.text: Does not make the vampire Sabbat nor infernal: it merely gives the option to such vampires. [PIB 20150809]
The two actions provided are not cross-restrictive. Each can be performed once during the same turn by the same minion. [LSJ 20100909]

You can draw more cards than are in the library or crypt (even from an empty library or crypt); draw as much as you can. [LSJ 20060620]

text:
Unique.
This Sabbat vampire can draw 5 cards as an action (discard down afterward). This infernal minion can add 3 blood to a vampire in your uncontrolled region as a +1 stealth action. An opposing minion can strike: steal this equipment.
flavor:
The last time I saw such prophecies, Constantinople burned, but its ashes gave us the Sabbat. As then, many will burn.
Sascha Vykos, The Angel of Caine

rulings.text: "Any crypt cards" means all of them. [LSJ 20080229]
Crypt cards cannot be put in the library and library cards cannot be put in the crypt. [LSJ 20041201]

text:
Master.
All Methuselahs move any crypt cards in their uncontrolled regions to their crypts. Any blood counters on them are moved to the Methuselah's pool, and any cards on them are burned. Each Methuselah shuffles his or her crypt and then moves as many cards from his or her crypt to his or her uncontrolled region as he or she shuffled in. Only one Kaymakli Nightmares may be played per game.

Unique equipment. Requires a ready Laibon.
This Laibon gets +1 bleed and 2 additional votes. Reaction cards that require Auspex [aus] cost an additional blood while this Laibon is acting.
Reduce a bleed against you by 1 for each point of stealth the acting minion has when this card is played.
flavor:
The mistakes are all there waiting to be made.
Chess Grandmaster Sawielly Tartakower

rulings.text: The damage done from the ranged strike is damage from the weapon, so it can be modified by effects that modify melee weapon damage. [LSJ 20051220]

text:
Melee weapon. Requires a Laibon.
Strength+1 damage each strike. Alternatively, inflict strength ranged damage as a strike and, after strike resolution, turn this weapon face down (out of play) until the end of the action.

es.name: Chaleco de kevlar
es.text: Una vez por combate, el portador puede prevenirse de 2 de daño procedente de ataques con armas de fuego o de 1 de daño procedente de otras fuentes. Un siervo puede tener sólo un Chaleco de kevlar.

fr.name: Gilet de Kevlar
fr.text: Une fois par combat, son possesseur peut prévenir 2 points de dégâts des frappes d'arme à feu ou 1 point de dégâts de n'importe quelle autre source. Un serviteur ne peut en avoir qu'un seul exemplaire.

rulings.text: Can be used to prevent the damage from two separated gun strikes doing one damage each. [LSJ 20081210]
If fewer points of (preventable) damage are being resolved, then the effect prevents all of those points. [RTR 20041202]
Unused prevention points can't be carried over unless optional ('can/may prevent'). [ANK 20200318] [LSJ 20001114]

text: Once each combat, the bearer can prevent 2 damage from gun strikes or 1 damage from any other source. A minion can have only one Kevlar Vest.

rulings.text: [obf] The ally is chosen at action resolution (not declaration). [ANK 20240706] [LSJ 20080608]
[obf] This counts as a Ⓓ action burning the ally (eg. for trophies). [LSJ 20080608]
[obf] The cost of an imbued is their starting life (cost to influence). Note this is not a cost to recruit (see {101053|Kindred Segregation}). [ANK 20220528]

When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
Requires an Anarch. More than one Discipline can be used to play this card. Ⓓ Bleed.
[cel] This vampire gains 1 blood.
[nec] The bleed is with +1 bleed.
[obf] If this action is successful, you can burn an ally controlled by your prey whose cost is not greater than the bleed amount.

Unique.
Put this card in play. Banu Haqim get +1 stealth when bleeding. Minions can burn this card as a Ⓓ action; Tremere get +1 stealth during that action.
flavor: The enemy of my enemy is my friend; the friend of my enemy is my enemy.

text:
+1 stealth action. Unique. Not usable if any non-mandatory actions have been performed this turn.
Put this card on this Banu Haqim and unlock them. This Banu Haqim gets +1 bleed. If your prey is ousted, you gain 4 additional pool. Burn this card during your unlock phase.

rulings.text: Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [TOM 19960225]

text:
Only usable if this Banu Haqim has been chosen for a contract on the opposing minion.
Strike: hand strike at +3 damage.

+1 stealth action.
Add 2 blood to a younger Banu Haqim in your uncontrolled region.
flavor:
The time has come for the faithful to prepare themselves, to make themselves worthy.
Thetmes, Assamite

rulings.text: Wraiths minions can act the turn they are put into play. [LSJ 20080426]
Minions put into play by the Diary go back to their owner's ash heap when burned. They do not count has allies burned from play (eg. for {101481|Pressing Flesh}). [PIB 20130128-2] [LSJ 20100325-2]
Is an undirected action, even when targeting another Methuselah's ash heap. [LSJ 20010627] [ANK 20180202]
Cannot be played if no target is available in any Methuselah's ash heap. [ANK 20200420-3]

The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]
rulings.group: Action requirements from a card in play

text:
+1 stealth action.
Put the Diary in play, or add 1 counter to one in play. After a unique minion in play is burned, add 1 counter. While this card has 7 or more counters, Giovanni get superior Necromancy [NEC] and can put a minion from any ash heap in play as a +1 stealth action to represent a wraith ally with 2 life, 0 strength, 1 bleed and +1 stealth.

rulings.text: If they use their last life to play an action modifier, the action fails. If they use their last life to play a strike, combat ends before strike resolution. [ANK 20180928-1]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If they takes aggravated damage from a card they plays as a vampire (eg. {100273|Burst of Sunlight}), they lose one life but do not go to torpor. [LSJ 20060409]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If they use their last life to pay for an action, the action still resolves fully. If that leads to an oust, the oust is resolved before resolving effects triggered by the fact that they burn. [LSJ 20080512]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If a card they play as a vampire sends them to torpor (eg. {101581|Reform Body}), they burn. REVERSAL of previous rulings. [LSJ 20060409]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: They cannot use a card to commit diablerie (eg. {100043|Amaranth}) [RTR 19970630] [LSJ 20080717]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If burned and shuffled into the library, other effects that apply when it is burned still apply (eg. {101731|Set's Curse} puts an ally into play). [ANK 20200813]
Is not shuffled into the library when it is discarded. [RTR 20010711]

Does not stack with similar effects (or another copy of itself) to provide superior version of the discipline(s) (e.g. {101083|Leech} and {101526|Putrescent Servitude} together does not provide superior [POT]) [ANK 20180111]
Can be used to meet one (but not more than one) of the normal Discipline requirements of a multi-Discipline card. [LSJ 20011217] [LSJ 20090508]
While a minion has an effect that allows them to play cards that require Discipline(s), they do not actually have those Discipline(s). [LSJ 19980303]

Multiple similar effects (e.g. two {100978|Infernal Familiar}, or {200616|Ian Forestal} with an {100978|Infernal Familiar}) cannot be used to meet the requirements of a multi-Discipline card that the minion is missing one or more Disciplines to play. [LSJ 20020218]

While using their ability to meet a discipline requirement, they also meet that requirement for any other cards associated with the original effect (e.g. meeting the [ani] requirement for {101342|Pack Alpha} or {101255|Muricia's Call} also meets the [ani] requirement for the {101550|Raven Spy} employed by that effect). [LSJ 20080205-2] [LSJ 20060417]
The ally counts as "independent" when playing cards as a vampire [LSJ 20020503] [LSJ 20060126]

text:
Unique mummy with 3 life. 3 strength, 2 bleed.
Kherebutu can play cards requiring basic Necromancy [nec] as a vampire with capacity 3. Kherebutu can burn himself and a Tremere with capacity 4 or less controlled by your prey as a Ⓓ action. If he is burned, shuffle him in his owner's library.

es.name: Torres Jobar, Al Jubar
es.text:
Lugar único.
Gírala durante tu fase de enderezamiento para retirar de la partida a un siervo preparado que controles y ganar X de reserva sanguínea, donde X es la capacidad de ese vampiro o el costo de sangre o reserva sanguínea de ese aliado.

fr.name: Tours de Khobar, al-Khubar
fr.text:
Lieu unique.
Vous pouvez l'incliner durant votre phase de redressement pour retirer un serviteur disponible que vous contrôlez de la partie et gagner X points de réserve, où X est sa capacité ou son coût.

rulings.text: If used on an ally with a cost of X, X pool are gained. The value of X is the one set when the ally was recruited . [ANK 20170716] [RTR 20020501]
The effect is ordered as the acting Methuselah wishes during his unlock phase (eg. can be used on {101293|Nocturn} before it burns). [ANK 20170625]

text:
Unique location.
Lock during your unlock phase to remove a ready minion you control from the game and gain X pool, where X is their capacity or cost.

rulings.text: [dom] Can force a vampire who has not voted yet to keep abstaining. [RTR 19991001]
[DOM] Playable on an abstaining vampire: it does not force them to vote, but restricts their choice if they do. [RTR 19991001] [LSJ 20030828]
Cannot be used during a referendum that is automatically passing. [PIB 20150105] [LSJ 19980107]

text:
Only usable during a referendum.
[dom] Force X vampires to abstain. This can cancel those vampires' votes and ballots. The affected vampires cannot be older than this reacting vampire.
[DOM] As above, but you may change the votes and ballots that the affected vampires cast to votes and ballots of your choice instead. (The affected vampires may choose to abstain if they have not already cast their votes and ballots.)

rulings.text: Cannot be played when the target crypt is empty. [RTR 20000501] [LSJ 20070411-2]
rulings.group: Move or reveal card from crypt

text:
+1 stealth action.
Move the top card from your crypt to your uncontrolled region.

rulings.text: Playable on an abstaining vampire: it does not force them to vote, but restricts their choice if they do. [RTR 19991001] [LSJ 20030828]
Cannot be used during a referendum that is automatically passing. [PIB 20150105] [LSJ 19980107]

text:
Only usable during a referendum.
Change the votes and ballots of a younger vampire to votes and ballots of your choice.

Requires a prince or justicar.
Choose a new seating order. Successful referendum means each Methuselah takes his or her new seat.

rulings.text: Only requires the pool cost to be paid in order to keep the ally. Allies with blood costs can be kept by paying 0 pool. [RTR 20010711]
Can be called even if there are no allies in play. [RTR 20010711]
One can decide to burn an ally with no pool cost (not paying zero). [ANK 20190724]
Imbued can be kept by paying 0 pool, as they have a "pool cost to recruit" of zero. [LSJ 20060409]

text: Successful referendum means that all allies are burned. Any Methuselah can keep an ally or allies he or she controls by repaying their pool cost to recruit.

rulings.text: If a vampire has two copies of Kindred Society Games, each copy exerts its own effect. Unlocking the vampire normally would require a total of 2 blood. If the vampire does not unlock normally, both Games are moved to other vampire(s), although the vampire could burn 1 blood to prevent one of the Games from moving on. [RTR 19951017]

text:
Master.
Put this card on a ready vampire. This vampire doesn't unlock as normal. During his or her controller's unlock phase, that vampire either puts Society Games on a younger locked vampire or burns 1 blood to unlock. If the vampire choses to move Society Games but there is no locked younger vampire, Society Games is burned.

es.name: Almas gemelas
es.text:
[dem] Ⓓ Sangra a cualquier Matusalén. Gana 1 de reserva sanguínea si este sangrado tiene éxito (de 1 o más).
[DEM] Como antes, con +1 de sangrado.
es.flavor:
Como gotas de agua, mezcladas en una.
William Cowper, "El reloj"

fr.name: Esprits analogues
fr.text:
[dem] Ⓓ Mordre n'importe quel Mathusalem. Gagnez 1 point de réserve si la morsure est réussie (pour 1 ou plus).
[DEM] Comme ci-dessus, avec +1 en morsure.
fr.flavor:
Comme des gouttes sœurs, ne faisant plus qu'une.
William Cowper, "L'Horloge"

text:
[dem] Ⓓ Bleed any Methuselah. Gain 1 pool if the bleed is successful (for 1 or more).
[DEM] As above, with +1 bleed.
flavor:
Like kindred drops, been mingled into one.
William Cowper, "The Timepiece"

es.name: Disputa de recursos ganaderos
es.text: Asigna 4 puntos entre dos o más Matusalenes. Si el referéndum prospera, cada Matusalén quema 1 de reserva sanguínea por cada punto asignado.

fr.name: Conflit sur le bétail
fr.text: Allouez 4 points entre deux Mathusalems ou plus. Si le référendum passe, chaque Mathusalem brûle 1 point de réserve pour chaque point alloué.

rulings.text: Cannot allocate 4 points to a single Methuselah, but you can allocate points to yourself. [LSJ 20000622]

If multiple ousts happen, players whose prey gets ousted get a victory point, even if they are being ousted themselves. Only the surviving ones get 6 pool from the oust of their prey (not of their grand-prey). [LSJ 20000309]
Can allocate more points than a Methuselah has pool. [LSJ 20020819]

text: Allocate 4 points among two or more Methuselahs. Successful referendum means each Methuselah burns 1 pool for each point allocated.

rulings.text: [FOR] Damage dealt to the opponent is environmental. [RTR 19970630] [LSJ 19970801]
[for]Cannot be used if there is no damage to prevent. [LSJ 20001114]

text:

flavor:
It is a mistake to try to look too far ahead. The chain of destiny can only be grasped one link at a time.
Sir Winston Churchill

rulings.text: The "does not unlock as normal" effect is redundant with being infernal. If the minion is infernal, his controller can still pay a pool to unlock him. [LSJ 20050114]
"Since your last turn" means between the end of your last turn and now. Your last turn does not qualify, your current turn does. [LSJ 20020429]

Cannot be used or played if the conditions for the terms of the referendum cannot be met (e.g. no legal selection, insufficient cards/players to choose from, prohibited by card text, uniqueness, etc). [LSJ 20100129] [ANK 20191228]

text: Choose a Methuselah who has received a victory point since your last turn. Successful referendum means the Methuselah must immediately lock all of his or her minions; the minions do not unlock as normal during the Methuselah's next unlock phase.

rulings.text: The additional cost does not apply once the minion has failed to block, so it does not apply to the cost of the action card. [LSJ 20080818]

text:
Requires an Anarch.
Put this card on an Anarch. Allies cannot block this Anarch. Cards requiring Dominate [dom] or Presence [pre] cost other minions +1 blood while this Anarch is acting, attempting to block or in combat.

rulings.text: The "does not unlock as normal" effect is redundant with being infernal. If the minion is infernal, his controller can still pay a pool to unlock him. [LSJ 20050114]

text:
Requires a ready titled non-Anarch vampire. +1 stealth action.
Choose up to two Anarch vampires with capacities of 5 or less. Each chosen vampire is locked and does not unlock as normal on his or her next unlock phase.

es.name: Zona de caza: Biblioteca
es.text:
Lugar único. Zona de caza.
Durante tu fase de enderezamiento, un vampiro preparado que controles puede ganar 1 de sangre. Un vampiro puede ganar sangre de sólo una zona de caza por turno.

fr.name: Bibliothèque, terrain de chasse
fr.text:
Lieu unique. Terrain de chasse.
Durant votre phase de redressement, un vampire disponible que vous contrôlez peut gagner 1 point de sang. Un vampire ne peut gagner de points de sang que d'un seul terrain de chasse à chaque tour.

text:
Unique location. Hunting ground.
During your unlock phase, a ready vampire you control can gain 1 blood. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground each turn.

es.name: Favor de por vida
es.text:
Fuera de turno. Favor.
Dale reserva sanguínea a un Matusalén sin reserva sanguínea para mantenerlo en la partida, y pon esta carta en juego. Durante cada una de sus fases de enderezamiento, puedes robarle 1 de reserva sanguínea a ese Matusalén. Cualquier punto de victoria que gane ese Matusalén lo ganas tú en su lugar, hasta que seas eliminado o hasta que hayas ganado 1 punto de victoria por esta carta. Quema esta carta después de que hayas ganado 1 punto de victoria por ella.

fr.name: Faveur à vie
fr.text:
Hors-tour. Faveur.
Donnez des points de réserve à un Mathusalem qui n'a plus de points de réserve pour le garder en jeu et mettre cette carte en jeu. Durant chacune de ses phases de redressement, vous pouvez voler 1 point de réserve de ce Mathusalem. Vous gagnez tout point de victoire que ce Mathusalem devrait gagner à sa place, jusqu'à ce que vous soyez éliminé ou jusqu'à ce que vous ayez gagné 1 point de victoire grâce à cette carte. Brûlez cette carte après que vous avez gagné 1 point de victoire grâce à cette carte.

rulings.text: If a player is saved more than once by Life Boon, the various Boons reserve a series of victory points, rather than competing with each other for a single victory point. [RTR 19951017]
If a player has gone to negative pool, or has to pay more than he has, the Life Boon player must give her enough pool to compensate for that. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20230817-2]
If the target receives half of a victory point, then the Methuselah who played the Boon receives that half. The Boon is not burned until a total of one victory point has been awarded. [RTR 19991206]

If the effect ousting the target simultaneously ousts the target's prey (eg. {101056|Kine Resources Contested}), the victory point goes to the Mathusalah who played Life Boon and the target gets 6 pool. [LSJ 20021029]
If you played a Life Boon on your predator, you will not get the VP when you are ousted.  (Reversal of RTR 19990712) [RTR 20000501] [LSJ 20020620-2]

text:
Out-of-turn. Boon.
Give pool to a Methuselah with no pool to keep them in the game, and put this card in play. During each of their unlock phases, you can steal 1 pool from that Methuselah. You gain any victory point gained by that Methuselah instead of them, until you are being ousted or until you have gained 1 victory point from this card. Burn this card after you have gained 1 victory point from this card.

es.name: Vida en la ciudad
es.text:
Nimiedad.
Añade 1 de sangre a un vampiro preparado.
es.flavor:
Evito pagar a clientes que puedan echar en falta, pero los solitarios son un buen blanco. Los contrabandistas creen que, además, trafico con esclavos.
Ingrid Galt, anarquista.

fr.name: Vivre en ville
fr.text:
Triviale.
Ajoutez 1 point de sang à un vampire disponible.
fr.flavor:
Je ne touche pas aux clients qui pourraient leur manquer, mais les solitaires font des proies idéales. Les trafiquants pensent que je pratique l'esclavage en dilettante.
Ingrid Galt, Anarch

text:
Trifle.
Add 1 blood to a ready vampire.
flavor:
I steer clear of paying customers who might be missed, but solos are fair game. The black marketers think I'm doing a little slave trade on the side.
Ingrid Galt, Anarch

text:
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Ⓓ Remove a vampire in any Methuselah's ash heap from the game and put this card in play under the control of that Methuselah. During this acting vampire's unlock phase, this acting vampire's controller can look at the hand of this Methuselah. Any minion can burn this card as a +1 stealth action.
[NEC] As above, but during any unlock phase.

rulings.text: If it leaves play, the card on it is burned. [LSJ 20021128]
Ignores all "do not replace" clauses and special replacement effects on cards played from it. [LSJ 20081126]
rulings.group: Play stored card as if from hand

rulings.text: The card on it cannot be discarded or burned to satisfy another effect (eg. {101958|Tension in the Ranks} or using political action cards for votes). [LSJ 20050118]
rulings.group: Play stored card as if from hand

rulings.text: A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]
rulings.group: Play stored card as if from hand

text:
Electronic.
The bearer gets 1 optional maneuver during the first round of combat. You can move any aim card the bearer uses to this card, face up and out of play (even if it is canceled). The bearer can play an aim card on this equipment as if from your hand; it is then removed from the game.

rulings.text: The burn blood effect is not reduced by effects that reduce the cost of the card (eg. {200011|Adana de Sforza}). [ANK 20210226]

text:
[cel] Additional strike (limited).
[CEL] Burn X blood to get X additional strikes (limited).
flavor:
Celerity is never more admired
Than by the negligent.
William Shakespeare, "Antony & Cleopatra", act III, scene 7

text:
Master.
Put this card in play. As a master phase action, you may lock this card to search your library for a master: Discipline card and choose a ready non-Bahari vampire you control who has no blood. That vampire gains the Discipline card (if any) and 3 blood and becomes Bahari.

rulings.text: If multiple ousts happen, players whose prey gets ousted get a victory point, even if they are being ousted themselves. Only the surviving ones get 6 pool from the oust of their prey (not of their grand-prey). [LSJ 20000309]
Can allocate more points than a Methuselah has pool. [LSJ 20020819]

text:
[mel] Allocate 4 points among one or more Methuselahs. Successful referendum means each Methuselah burns 1 pool for each point allocated.
[MEL] As above, and choose a Methuselah. Successful referendum means the chosen Methuselah gains 1 pool.

rulings.text: Can reduce the cost in blood (not in pool) of any action (ally, retainer, equipment, political). [ANK 20181007]
Cannot be used by an ally acting "as a vampire". [ANK 20200605]

Can be locked to reduce the cost at any point before resolution, from when the action is announced to just before the cost is paid. If it is used when announcing an action, and the action is cancelled as played (e.g. {100545|Direct Intervention}), it is not locked. [ANK 20230620] [ANK 20170605] [LSJ 20090705]
Can reduce the cost of an action card even if it is not played as an action (e.g. a weapon played with {100392|Concealed Weapon} or an Ally with {101401|Piper}). [ANK 20230824] [RTR 20070707]
Allows to play a card that could otherwise not be afforded, in which case, it must be locked when the action is announced. [LSJ 20090705] [LSJ 20030917] [ANK 20230721]

text:
Unique location.
You can lock this location to reduce the cost of an action card a vampire you control plays by 1 blood (this location is not locked if that card is canceled as it is played). Vampires can steal this location as a Ⓓ action.

es.name: Pelea entre bandas
es.text:
Requiere a un Anarquista.
[cel] Ⓓ Roba 1 de reserva sanguínea a otro Matusalén.
[pot] Ⓓ Entra en combate con un siervo.
[pre] Ⓓ Sangra con +1 de sangrado.

fr.name: Bagarre rangée
fr.text:
Requiert un Anarch.
[cel] Ⓓ Voler 1 point de réserve d'un autre Mathusalem.
[pot] Ⓓ Entrer en combat contre un serviteur.
[pre] Ⓓ Mordre à +1 en morsure.

rulings.text: When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
Requires an Anarch.
[cel] Ⓓ Steal 1 pool from another Methuselah.
[pot] Ⓓ Enter combat with a minion.
[pre] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.

rulings.text: [VIC]Minions that cannot strike, cannot play or use the maneuver from a strike (e.g. {100001|.44 Magnum}, {101982|Thrown Gate}). [LSJ 20001126]
[VIC]Minions can (uselessly) gain additional strikes even if they cannot strike. [LSJ 19970814-2]

text:
[vic] Strike: burn the opposing ally or burn 3 blood from the opposing younger vampire. If the opposing vampire has no blood after the resolution of this strike, combat ends.
[VIC] Only usable before range is determined in combat with a younger vampire. This vampire cannot strike this round. As their initial strike next round, this vampire can strike: diablerize the opposing younger vampire.

rulings.text: Is not playable if you have less than 7 cards in your library. [LSJ 20070901]

text:
Do not replace until your discard phase.
Burn 7 cards from the top of your library to gain 3 pool.
flavor:
How little you know about the age you live in if you think that honey is sweeter than cash in hand.
Ovid

text:
+1 stealth action.
This acting Samedi and all younger Samedi in your uncontrolled region each gain a blood from the bank.
flavor:
Dark hills at evening in the west,
Where sunset hovers like a sound
Of golden horns that sang to rest
Old bones of warriors under ground...
Edwin Arlington Robinson, "The Dark Hills"

es.name: Mansión viviente
es.text:
Mientras esté en juego, esta carta de equipo representa un lugar y no cuenta como equipo.
Este vampiro obtiene +1 de sangrado. Puede quemar esta carta antes de determinar la distancia para terminar el combate. Un vampiro puede tener sólo un ejemplar de esta carta.

fr.name: Manoir vivant
fr.text:
Tant qu'elle est en jeu, cette carte d'équipement représente un lieu et ne compte pas comme équipement.
Ce vampire reçoit +1 en morsure. Il peut brûler cette carte avant l'étape de manœuvre pour arrêter le combat. Un vampire ne peut en avoir qu'un seul exemplaire.

rulings.text: An action targeting it (eg. {100391|Conceal}) is directed at the Methuselah controlling it, not the minion it is on. [LSJ 20090324]
May be put on any minion if the controller changes. If the new controller has no minions, it is burned. [RTR 19960112]

text:
Location. While in play, this card does not count as equipment.
This vampire gets +1 bleed. They can burn this card before range is determined to end combat. A vampire can have only one Living Manse.

rulings.text: Once in play, can be equipped from the minion it's on (rulebook action) by another minion that does not meet the requirements. [ANK 20180719-3]
X can be zero, but not less than zero. [LSJ 20030502]

text:
Unique melee weapon.
Strength damage each strike. Imbued inflict +X damage each strike with this weapon. Using <Cleave> with this weapon will not burn this weapon.
flavor:
If you can't kill the damn thing, stop wasting your time.
Lupe "Cabbie22" Droin, Defender

text:
Only usable during a recruit ally action.
[vic] Put this card on the ally and lock the ally after action resolution if this action is successful. Actions requiring Dominate [dom] or Presence [pre] have no effect on the attached ally. The attached ally gets -1 bleed and cannot maneuver.
[VIC] As above, but the ally is not locked.

rulings.text: May be put on any minion if the controller changes. If the new controller has no minions, it is burned. [RTR 19960112]
An action targeting it (eg. {100391|Conceal}) is directed at the Methuselah controlling it, not the minion it is on. [LSJ 20090324]"
Is an equipment while in hand, library or ash heap, both equipment and location when played (eg. for cost-related effects), and just a location while in play. [LSJ 20080114]

The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]
rulings.group: Action requirements from a card in play

text:
Requires a ready Sabbat vampire. This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
The Sabbat vampire with this location may move 2 blood from the blood bank to any other ready Sabbat vampire as a +1 stealth action.

rulings.text: Once in play, applies to an action if any one of its targets would be enough to enable his effect. [LSJ 20080809-2] [RTR 20081119]

text:
This action is at +1 stealth if it is undirected.
Put this card on any minion. Other Methuselahs' actions targeting this minion cost monsters an additional blood or life. If this minion is a monster, he or she burns a blood or life when he or she attempts an action or a block. This minion may burn this card as an action. A minion can have only one Lock.

rulings.text: [PRO] The blood burned is not affected by effects modifying the hunt amount (eg. {200131|Ariadne}). [ANK 20220809]
A minion can only perform this special hunt once per turn. [RBK action-card-or-card-in-play]

text:
+1 stealth hunt action.
[pro] Hunt, and put this card on this vampire. This vampire can burn this card and 1 blood to get +1 stealth. A vampire can have only one Loki's Gift.
[PRO] Ⓓ As above, and burn 1 blood from any vampire. This vampire can burn this card as above, or can burn it during the polling step of any referendum to get +2 votes.

rulings.text: Sequencing rules apply. You must gain the impulse to be able to use the reaction, or use the effect (whichever is applicable).  Other Methuselahs must declare block attempts (or not) and pass the impulse to you as normal. [ANK 20200607]

text:
Master: unique location.
Lock to give any minion +1 intercept for the current action.
flavor:
He... remarked that the smuts in London were not so bad as they used to be when he was a student there.
Bram Stoker, "Dracula"

rulings.text: Only considers the minions controlled during the influence phase. It does not care if minions you no longer control acted this turn. [LSJ 20060616-1]

text:
Master: archetype.
Put this card on a vampire you control. During your influence phase, if this vampire successfully performed an action this turn and none of your other minions attempted any actions this turn, he or she gains 1 blood from the blood bank, if he or she is ready. A vampire can have only one archetype.

rulings.text: Must be played (as well as other "as the action is announced" action modifiers) before action modifiers that are not explicitly played "as the action is announced" (e.g., {100401|Conditioning}). [ANK 20190425]
Replace the action card (if any) before playing it. [ANK 20181208]

When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]
If blocked, the effect must be applied, ordered by the acting Methuselah, before any other card or effect can be used (eg. {100476|Crypt's Sons}, {100323|Change of Target}).

text:
Requires an Anarch. Only usable as the action is announced. If this action is blocked, apply the following effect before block resolution:
[dem] Lock a younger non-blocking vampire controlled by the blocking minion's controller.
[tha] Move 2 blood from a non-blocking vampire controlled by the blocking minion's controller to this vampire.
[vic] Damage from this vampire's hand strikes is aggravated during the resulting combat.

rulings.text: [for] Is not the default action, no blood is paid for the rescue. [ANK 20181017]
[for] If the action is unblocked when it resolves and all targets are no longer in torpor, the action "fizzles" (cost, if any, is paid, and it is considered successful, but has no effect).

When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[for] Rescue up to two vampires from torpor. Vampires can ignore the normal prey, predator or target restrictions for blocking this action.
[obe] Put this card on this vampire. During your unlock phase, this vampire can gain 1 blood. Vampires can burn this card as a Ⓓ action.
[OBE] As [obe] above, but this vampire can gain 2 blood.

rulings.text: [qui] Is directed against the Methuselah controlling the equipment or location, not the minion it's on. [LSJ 20090324]

text:
[qui] Ⓓ Burn an equipment or location on a minion controlled by your predator or prey.
[QUI] Ⓓ Bleed with +2 bleed.

es.name: Perdido en multitudes
es.text:
[obf] +1 de sigilo. Desaparecer y Perdido en multitudes no se pueden jugar en la misma acción.
[OBF] Como antes, pero +2 de sigilo.
es.flavor:
...sabe que un temible demonio
Va cerca detrás de él.
Samuel Taylor Coleridge, "La balada del viejo marinero"

fr.name: Perdu dans la foule
fr.text:
[obf] +1 en discrétion. Perdu dans la foule et les cartes nommées Volatilisé ne peuvent être joués durant la même action.
[OBF] Comme ci-dessus, mais pour +2 en discrétion.
fr.flavor:
... parce qu'elle croit qu'un être terrible
Lui ferme la route par-derrière.
Samuel Taylor Coleridge, "La Complainte du vieux marin"

text:
[obf] +1 stealth. Lost in Crowds and cards named <Into Thin Air> cannot both be played during the same action.
[OBF] As above, but for +2 stealth.
flavor:
...he knows a frightful fiend
Doth close behind him tread.
Samuel Taylor Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

rulings.text: Must be played before action resolution, ie. before any modifier or reaction played "as the action/bleed would be successful" are played. It cannot be played after a {101857|Spying Mission} on the vampire triggers. [LSJ 19980105]
Can be played when failing to block because of stealth: it is still declining to block. [ANK 20211003]

text:
Only usable when an ally or younger vampire is bleeding you, after blocks are declined.
Lock this reacting vampire. Choose another Methuselah other than the acting minion's controller. The acting minion is now bleeding the chosen Methuselah. Only one Lost in Translation may be played each action.

rulings.text: Can be used even if the stealth is not currently needed. [LSJ 20011214-2]

text:
Only one Loup can be played each turn.
Put this card in play. Toreador get +1 stealth. Burn this card at the end of the turn or after a Toreador performs a successful action.

rulings.text: Can be used at any time, even between two actions, during another Methuselah's turn. [ANK 20210608]
If a minion who is attempting to block is locked, then that block will fail, unless they woke earlier during the action. [LSJ 20010702] [RTR 19941006] [LSJ 19991025] [LSJ 20100527]
rulings.group: Lock a minion during block attempt

text:
Unique location.
You can lock this location to lock a Toreador. If you control the Prince of Paris, you can lock this location to lock a minion. Minions can steal this location as a Ⓓ action.

rulings.text: [ani] Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [TOM 19960225]
[val] [VAL] Damage is done by the vampire (not environmental). [RTR 19970630] [LSJ 19990723]
[val] [VAL] If the combat continues or a new combat begins, no damage is done. The vampire can still burn 1 blood to unlock. [RTR 20020501]
[val] [VAL] If the strike is dodged, no damage is done. [LSJ 19980526] [RTR 20041202] [PIB 20130319]
[VAL] The blood to unlock can be paid until the end of combat, including after other effects that are played at the end of round. [ANK 20180618]
[VAL]The burn blood effect is not reduced by effects that reduce the cost of the card (eg. {200011|Adana de Sforza}). [ANK 20210226]

[val]/[VAL]If the combat continues or a new combat begins, the after combat effect does not happen/is not usable (e.g. {101507|Psyche!}, {101950|Telepathic Tracking}).
(Partial reversal of RTR 20010711) [RTR 20020501] [LSJ 19980109]

When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]
[val]/[VAL]Any blood loss occurs after combat (and will not trigger {100060|Anathema} or be available for {101945|Taste of Vitae}, etc). [LSJ 20031123]
[val]/[VAL]Damage is applied after combat, so cannot be prevented by combat cards. [LSJ 20100204-2]
[val]/[VAL]Is a damage dealing effect and can be modified by other effects like {100489|Dam the Heart's River}. [ANK 20170111] [PIB 20130319]

text:
Only usable at close range.
[ani] Strike: hand strike at +1 damage.
[val] Strike: combat ends, and inflict 1 unpreventable damage on the opposing minion after combat ends.
[VAL] As [val] above, and this vampire can burn 1 blood to unlock before combat ends.
Mortal with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
flavor:
These are the hired bravos who defend
The tyrant's throne -- the bullies of his fear.
Percy Bysshe Shelley, "Queen Mab"

rulings.text: Cannot be used during a referendum that is automatically passing. [PIB 20150105] [LSJ 19980107]

If a minion who has gained the votes provided against the referendum, is subsequently forced to vote in favor, the provided votes are not counted when votes are tallied until that minion is again forced to vote against the referendum. [LSJ 20031115]
Cannot be used by a minion who is voting in favor of the referendum. [LSJ 20031115]
Gaining the provided votes immediately forces the minion to vote against the referendum, if they are not already doing so. [LSJ 20031119]

text:
Only usable during a referendum. Usable by a locked vampire.
This vampire gains 3 votes against the referendum. If the acting vampire is Sabbat and the referendum fails, move up to 2 blood from the acting vampire to this vampire.
flavor:
Old-fashioned Loyalists don't last all that long, even when they've got your potential for power.
Andrew Emory, Lasombra bishop

rulings.text: You cannot use another strike card as the hand strike for Lucky Blow. [LSJ 20010627]
Adding damage to a strike that does not deal damage has no effect, so the strike still will not do damage. [RTR 19960221]
Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [RTR 19970630] [TOM 19960225]

text:
Do not replace until after combat.
Strike: hand strike or use a melee weapon strike. This strike is at +1 damage.

rulings.text: The mandatory attack action must be taken before any non-mandatory actions. [LSJ 20001127]
If the minion it is on has entered combat and unlocks, he is free to take any other action. [LSJ 20090226] [ANK 20200227]
If a minion has two of those, he is stuck and cannot act. [LSJ 20041103]
The action to burn it is directed at the Methuselah who controls the minion it is on. It is undirected if it is yourself. [LSJ 20010328]
The two actions provided are not cross-restrictive. Each can be performed once during the same turn by the same minion. [LSJ 20100909]

text:
[dem] Ⓓ Put this card on a ready minion. During their minion phase, the attached minion must enter combat with a minion controlled by their prey as a Ⓓ action unless they must hunt. Minions can burn this card as an action.
[DEM] As above, and burning this card as an action inflicts 1 unpreventable environmental damage on the acting minion.

Master. Do not replace until your influence phase.
Each Methuselah (including you) discards 5 cards of his or her choice, then draws back up to his or her hand size. Only one Lupine Assault may be played in a game.

rulings.text: Requirements do not apply when taking control of a card already in play. [TOM 19960226-1]

text:
[ser] Ⓓ Steal a retainer controlled by another vampire.
[SER] Ⓓ Steal an ally controlled by another Methuselah.

rulings.text: May be put on any minion if the controller changes. If the new controller has no minions, it is burned. [RTR 19960112]
An action targeting it (eg. {100391|Conceal}) is directed at the Methuselah controlling it, not the minion it is on. [LSJ 20090324]"
Is an equipment while in hand, library or ash heap, both equipment and location when played (eg. for cost-related effects), and just a location while in play. [LSJ 20080114]

text:
This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment when in play. Unique.
Once during each political action, the vampire with this location can burn X blood to gain X additional votes.

rulings.text: All other players can see which card is selected from the ash heap. [ANK 20200523]

text:
Master: unique location.
You may lock this location to move a library card from your ash heap to this location, face down. You may use a master phase action to move a card from this location to the top of your library. Any vampire may burn this location as a Ⓓ action.

rulings.text: A weapon's "current damage" is the amount of damage that it would inflict if used as a strike by the bearer against a generic opponent at the appropriate range. [RTR 19980623]
The "current damage" amount is set when Machine Blitz is announced. [LSJ 19970224]
Does not count as using the weapon: no restriction nor side-effect apply (eg. {100233|Bomb} is not burned, {101685|Sawed-Off Shotgun} can be used multiple times). [LSJ 20010806-1]
Does not inflict aggravated damage if the target weapon does. [LSJ 20010806-1]

text:
[tha] Choose a weapon possessed by the opposing minion. Strike: ranged; X damage, where X is the amount of damage the chosen weapon would inflict as a strike.

es.name: Cóctel mólotov
es.text: Ataque a distancia: ponle esta carta a este siervo; se convierte en un equipo arma con el se que puede atacar a distancia infligiendo 2 de daño agravado, no utilizable en el asalto en el que se pone en juego. Quémala tras usarla o al final del combate.
es.flavor:
Este mundo siempre fue, es y será fuego eternamente vivo.
Heráclito

fr.name: Cocktail Molotov
fr.text: Frapper à toute portée : mettre cette carte sur ce serviteur ; elle devient un équipement arme qui peut frapper à toute portée : 2 points de dégâts aggravés, non utilisable le round où elle est jouée. Brûlez-la après usage ou à la fin du combat.
fr.flavor:
La chair est cendre, l'âme est flamme.
Victor Hugo, "L'Homme qui rit"

rulings.text: If the opponent strikes: combat ends, this strike is not resolved and the Cocktail is not put on this minion, even if combat continues thanks to another effect like {101595|Relentless Reaper}. [ANK 20200203-1]

text: Ranged strike: put this card on this minion; it becomes a weapon equipment that can strike: 2R aggravated damage, not usable the round it is put in play. Burn after use or at the end of combat.
flavor:
I got a dog eat dog sly smile
I got a Molotov cocktail with a match to go
I smoke my cigarette with style
Guns N' Roses, "Nightrain"

rulings.text: Can be used if a Slave locked to enter combat instead of the blocking minion, if the other conditions are met. [ANK 20200114]

Is played after resolution, but still during the action. Cards and effects that played "after resolution" (eg. {100788|Freak Drive}) can be played before it, but not after. [LSJ 19981028] [LSJ 20100206-2]
Is played after all combats are handled. Can be played from torpor. [LSJ 20030130] [ANK 20181219] [ANK 20180906]
An action cannot continue "as if unblocked" after a combat resulting from a successful action (e.g. {100266|Bum's Rush}). [RTR 19970630]
rulings.group: Action continues not specifically from block

rulings.text: If the action continues "as if unblocked", all action modifiers and reaction cards are still in effect, even those pertaining to a successful block. [RTR 19941109] [ANK 20190116]
If the action continues "as if unblocked", any Methuselahs that have declined to block before do not get another opportunity to block. [ANK 20190116]

For actions resulting from an action card, "continue as if unblocked" moves the action card from the ash heap (where it went when the action was blocked) to limbo (where it should be if the action is not blocked). If the action card is not in the ash heap, then the action cannot be continued. [LSJ 20070808-1]

text:
Requires a vampire with capacity 7 or more. Only usable after resolution of an action blocked by an ally or a vampire with capacity 5 or less. Not usable if, during this action, more than 1 round of combat has occurred or this vampire has lost 3 or more blood or ended combat before the press step.
The action continues as if unblocked.

Unique master. Only usable if you have one or more victory points.
Put this card in play. You may lock this card during your unlock phase to gain 1 pool.
flavor: It might have made Rufus feel better to know that he was far from the first Kindred to vanish off the streets of a Camarilla city in recent nights, and that he would be even farther from the last.

es.name: Monasterio de las Sombras
es.text:
Lugar único.
+1 a la mano. Gírala para darle a un vampiro con capacidad 8 o más +1 de sigilo.

fr.name: Monastère des ombres
fr.text:
Lieu unique.
+1 en taille de main. Vous pouvez l'incliner pour donner +1 en discrétion à un vampire de capacité 8 ou plus.

text:
Unique location.
+1 hand size. Lock to give a vampire with capacity 8 or more +1 stealth.

es.name: Planes frustrados
es.text:
Requiere a un Anarquista. Sólo utilizable durante una acción de sangrado.
+X de sangrado (limitada). X debe ser 1, 2 o 3.
es.flavor:
Sin embargo, el arma principal de los piratas era su capacidad de asombrar. Nadie más podía creerse lo crueles y codiciosos que eran, hasta que era demasiado tarde.
Kurt Vonnegut, "El desayuno de los campeones"

fr.name: Semer la pagaille
fr.text:
Requiert un Anarch. Seulement utilisable durant une action de morsure.
+X en morsure (limité). X doit être 1, 2 ou 3.
fr.flavor:
La meilleure arme des pirates, cependant, était leur capacité à surprendre. Personne ne pouvait croire, avant qu'il ne fût bien trop tard, à quel point ils étaient cruels et avides.
Kurt Vonnegut, "Le Petit Déjeuner des champions"

text:
Requires an Anarch. Only usable during a bleed action.
+X bleed (limited). X must be 1, 2 or 3.
flavor:
The chief weapon of sea pirates, however, was their capacity to astonish. Nobody else could believe, until it was too late, how heartless and greedy they were.
Kurt Vonnegut, "Breakfast of Champions"

rulings.text: The answer must be "yes" or "no", to the best of the player's knowledge. [LSJ 20021122-4]

The owner and target Methuselah have to agree on the meanings of the terms of the question (eg. "bounce" card). In case of doubt, they should discuss to agree on a shared meaning for those terms before answering the question. [LSJ 20030908]
The answer may be inexact when pertaining to an unverifiable element, such as the deck's content. A judge cannot be called to check the deck content. [LSJ 20021121-3] [PIB 20111213]
The owner must indicate that they are using the Monocle to ask the question, by whatever method passes for such an indication. [LSJ 20021121-4]
You can ask a question about multiple things using conjunctions, as long as the question as a whole can be answered by "yes" or "no". [LSJ 20021212]

text:
Unique equipment.
During your unlock phase, if bearer is ready, you can ask any Methuselah a yes-or-no question pertaining to the game. He or she must answer "yes" or "no" truthfully. If the question pertains to the future, the answer is not binding.

+1 stealth action. Requires a Laibon or non-titled vampire.

es.name: Sr. Winthrop
es.text:
Mortal único con 1 de vida.
El empleador obtiene +1 de intercepción.

fr.text:
Mortel unique avec 1 point de vie.
Son employeur reçoit +1 en interception.

Unique mortal with 1 life.
The employer gets +1 intercept.

Unique mortal with 1 life. 4 strength, 0 bleed.
The Muddled Vampire Hunter strikes with first strike. He may enter combat with a ready vampire controlled by another Methuselah as a Ⓓ action.
flavor:
And catching sight of us, he bit himself,
Like one whom fury devastates within.
Dante, "The Inferno", canto XII

text:

Burn this ally unless you remove three cards in your ash heap from the game. After a minion successfully bleeds you (for 1 or more), you can shuffle this ally into your library to inflict 2 damage on the acting minion.

(Partial reversal of RTR 20010711) [RTR 20020501] [LSJ 19980109]

text:
[ser] Strike: combat ends. This vampire unlocks and goes into torpor; put this card on the vampire. This vampire cannot attempt a leave torpor action. Burn this card if the vampire leaves torpor.
[SER] As above, but this vampire may attempt a leave torpor action.

rulings.text: The "does not unlock as normal" effect is redundant with being infernal. If the minion is infernal, his controller can still pay a pool to unlock him. [LSJ 20050114]
Once in play, can be equipped from the minion it's on (rulebook action) by another minion that does not meet the requirements. [ANK 20180719-3]

text:
Unique.
This vampire can burn this card during your master phase to lock any vampire. The locked vampire does not unlock as normal during their next unlock phase.

rulings.text: Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]
If an action is canceled, it is not performed and the minion is free to attempt the same action again. [RBK cancel-a-card]
Cannot cancel cards that are not played from the hand in the normal fashion (e.g. can't cancel allies played via {101401|Piper}). [RTR 20001020]
Can be used to cancel all action cards, including employ retainer, recruit ally and political action. [ANK 20200813-2]

text:
Master.

Alternatively, when a minion with no Orun plays an action card requiring a Discipline or Virtue, play this card to your ash heap as an out-of-turn master to cancel that card as it is played.

Y en el fondo del hoyo y de la fosa,
¡dispersaos!, ¡uníos!
Arthur Rimbaud, "Los cuervos"

Armée étrange aux cris sévères, [...]
Dispersez-vous, ralliez-vous !
Arthur Rimbaud, "Les Corbeaux"

In cold and gray and mournful weather
Scatter, hover, dive together!
Arthur Rimbaud, "Crows"

Put this card in play; it becomes a 2-capacity unique Nosferatu of the same sect as the acting Nosferatu with basic Animalism [ani]. Nosferatu Bestial cannot perform non-hunt actions, cast votes or ballots, or have or use equipment. During your unlock phase, Nosferatu Bestial can employ a retainer requiring Animalism from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal; this is not an action and cannot be blocked).

Master.
You may use a master phase action to look at one vampire in another Methuselah's uncontrolled region. Any minion who is not Toreador may burn Nosferatu Hosting as a Ⓓ action.

rulings.text: Only a Camarilla vampire can be chosen, it cannot be played without a valid target. [LSJ 20041026]

Cannot be used or played if the conditions for the terms of the referendum cannot be met (e.g. no legal selection, insufficient cards/players to choose from, prohibited by card text, uniqueness, etc). [LSJ 20100129] [ANK 20191228]

text:
Title.
Choose a ready Nosferatu. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen Nosferatu to represent the unique Camarilla title of Nosferatu Justicar. In this referendum, each Nosferatu gets 1 extra vote.

Master: unique location.
During your influence phase, lock to move 1 blood from the blood bank to a Nosferatu antitribu in your uncontrolled region.
flavor:
When the eye fails to find beauty... it commands the body to create it or, failing that, adjusts itself to perceive virtue in ugliness.
Joseph Brodsky, "Watermark"

rulings.text: An action directed at a card controlled by another Methuselah is directed at that Methuselah. [RBK who-may-attempt-to-block] [LSJ 20090324]

text: Ⓓ Send a Toreador into torpor or burn a location that requires a Toreador. If this acting Nosferatu has a capacity above 5, this action is at +1 stealth.

rulings.text: Can be used by a vampire in torpor. [LSJ 20020416]
Can be played by a minion of a Methuselah not involved in the current combat. [ANK 20181101]

text: Put this card on a Nosferatu in combat. The Nosferatu with this card has -1 strength each combat. You may play this card even if you are not involved in the current combat.
flavor:
There is no more infection, simply the mark.
Jewelle Gomez, "Louisiana: 1850"

rulings.text: Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]

text:
Master: out-of-turn.
Cancel an event card as it is played (no cost is paid). Put this card in play. During your master phase, you get one additional master phase action. During your discard phase, you get one fewer discard phase action, and this card is burned.
flavor:
The gods point to where chance would have taken me and then laugh that I am here instead, here where they would have me.
Victoria Ash, Toreador

rulings.text: Must be played (as well as other "as the action is announced" action modifiers) before action modifiers that are not explicitly played "as the action is announced" (e.g., {100401|Conditioning}). [ANK 20190425]
Replace the action card (if any) before playing it. [ANK 20181208]

text:
Requires a Sabbat vampire with capacity above 7. Only usable as the action is announced.
Non-infernal vampires with capacity less than 6 cannot block this action.

rulings.text: Does not affect equip actions performed prior to its arrival in play. [LSJ 20061218]
The minions who performed an equip action when it was in play unlock at the end of turn regardless of whether NRA PAC is still in play or not. [LSJ 20080619]

text:
Government.
Any minion who successfully performs an equip action unlocks at the end of the turn.

rulings.text: Only applies once each turn for the first eligible combat. [LSJ 20050215]

text:
Government.
During the first combat between an acting vampire and a blocking vampire each turn, neither combatant may end combat as a strike in the first round. A Methuselah may use a discard phase action to burn this card if his or her minions attempted no actions in the current turn.

Play when a vampire gains blood from a <Taste of Vitae> or steals blood from this vampire. Put an oath counter on that vampire. This vampire may put another oath counter on that vampire as a Ⓓ action. A vampire with 2 oath counters from this vampire cannot block or enter combat with this vampire. A vampire can play only one Oath each round.

rulings.text: The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]

text:
Master.
Put this card on an Banu Haqim controlled by another Methuselah. That Banu Haqim cannot attempt to bleed you. This card can be burned by another Banu Haqim as a Ⓓ action.

es.name: Obediencia
es.text:
Sólo utilizable si este vampiro está a punto de entrar en combate con un vampiro activo menor.
[dom] Endereza al vampiro activo y termina la acción. (No gires a este vampiro si está bloqueando). El vampiro activo no puede realizar la misma acción este turno.
[DOM] Como antes, pero no endereces al vampiro activo.

fr.name: Obéissance
fr.text:
Seulement utilisable si ce vampire est sur le point d'entrer en combat contre un vampire plus jeune qui agit.
[dom] Redressez le vampire qui agit et terminez l'action. (N'inclinez pas ce vampire s'il est en train de bloquer.) Le vampire qui agit ne peut pas effectuer la même action ce tour-ci.
[DOM] Comme ci-dessus, mais ne redressez pas le vampire qui agit.

rulings.text: The action has reached resolution, so is subject to NRA (Non Repeatable Action) rules. [LSJ 20070709]
Actions without card (provided by the rulebook) are not "the same" as actions provided by cards (played or in play). [LSJ 20060522]  [LSJ 20060824] [LSJ 20080725] [LSJ 20090617]

Actions without card (provided by the rulebook) can be repeated if they have different targets. Equipping from a minion targets the equipments: if one equipment is the same, the action is the same. [RTR 19950509] [LSJ 20080710] [ANK 20200502]
Actions provided by cards in play are not the same if the card is not the same, even if the cards have the same name. [LSJ 20080725]
Can be played by an unlocked older vampire to avoid a new combat queued after a preceding combat, if the opponent is still the acting vampire. [LSJ 19991025]
Cannot be played if the opponent is not the acting vampire, for example if a slave took his place. [ANK 20171212]
The action ends unsuccessfully immediately, no other action modifier or reaction can be played afterwards. [RTR 20180719] [ANK 20200207]

text:
Only usable if this vampire is about to enter combat with an acting younger vampire.
[dom] Unlock the acting vampire and end the action. (Do not lock this vampire if they are blocking.) The acting vampire cannot perform the same action this turn.
[DOM] As above, but do not unlock the acting vampire.

[dom][pro] [ACTION MODIFIER] +1 stealth. Allies get -1 intercept.
[DOM][PRO] [COMBAT] Only usable before range is determined. This round, this vampire gets +1 strength and 1 optional maneuver, and can prevent 1 damage. A vampire can play only one Obedient Flesh each round.

Discipline.
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Obfuscate [obf] and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Obfuscate [OBF].

Discipline.
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Oblivion [obl] and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Oblivion [OBL].

Master.
Put this card on a ready Toreador antitribu. The vampire with this card does not unlock as normal. During his or her controller's unlock phase, he or she burns 1 blood to unlock or is burned. If the vampire goes into torpor, this card is burned.

Discipline.
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Obtenebration [obt] and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Obtenebration [OBT].

[chi] [COMBAT] Strike: dodge.
[CHI] [ACTION MODIFIER] +1 stealth.
flavor:
When you suddenly can smell the moonlight (and what a stench moonlight can be), and footsteps become red streaks before your eyes, it can be overwhelming. At least for a time. And a little time goes a long way.
Zlatos, Ravnos

rulings.text: A vampire with no circle designation is in his own unique circle. Vampires with the same name (eg. {100633|The Embrace}, non-unique vampires) do not share a circle by default, each has his own circle of one by default. [LSJ 20020609]

text:
Requires a ready Blood Brother of the same circle as another one in combat. Usable by a vampire not involved in the combat.
[san] Only usable before range is chosen. The other Blood Brother gets an additional strike (limited) each round.
[SAN] As [san] above, but with two additional strikes (limited) each round.

rulings.text: Is a directed action if a vampire controlled by another Methuselah is chosen. [ANK 20190606]

text:
Requires a ready primogen. +1 stealth action. Title.
Choose a Camarilla vampire with a capacity above 5 who does not have a title. Put this card on that vampire to represent the Camarilla title of primogen. Not usable on Caitiff.
flavor:
Noblesse oblige.
Gaston Pierre Marc, "Maxims and Reflections"

text:
+1 stealth action.
Gain 1 pool. If you do not have the Edge, you get the Edge. Otherwise, you can burn the Edge to gain 1 additional pool.

They can lock to use their ability the turn they where recruited. [ANK 20180517]
