text:
Unique werewolf with 3 life. 3 strength, 0 bleed.
When a minion you control would enter combat with an acting minion, you may lock Ohoyo to cancel that combat and have Ohoyo enter combat with the acting minion instead. She gets an optional maneuver each combat. If she has less than 3 life during your unlock phase, she gains 1 life from the blood bank.

rulings.text: Cannot be used during a referendum that is automatically passing. [PIB 20150105] [LSJ 19980107]
Is replaced before unlocking cards: other unlock effects cannot be ordered before. [ANK 20200629-2] [LSJ 20091208] [RTR 19951017]

text:
Do not replace until your next unlock phase.
[obf] Only usable during a bleed action. +1 bleed (limited).

Only usable before range is determined. Retainers on the opposing minion lose their abilities this combat. The opposing minion cannot maneuver to close or press to continue this combat.

rulings.text: Ghouls are monsters, not mortal. [ANK 20200203-2] [LSJ 20060515]

Once the range is set, no other effect can be used to reset the range that round, but other pre-range effects can be played afterwards. Skip the Determine Range step for that round. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20180720]
If another effect was already setting that round's range (e.g. {101276|Neutral Guard}), that effect has priority. [PIB 20120214]

text:
Unique ghoul with 1 life.
The employer can burn 1 blood to set the range for the round before range is determined during the first round of combat.

text:
Only usable during the polling step of a political action.
This Lasombra gets +3 votes.

es.name: En estado de alerta
es.text:
Sólo utilizable por un siervo girado. Un siervo puede jugar sólo un ejemplar de esta carta entre sus fases de enderezamiento.
Este siervo se despierta (ignora el requisito de estar enderezado para jugar cartas de reacción e intentar bloquear hasta el final de la acción). Si este siervo es un aliado, no se endereza normalmente durante su siguiente fase de enderezamiento.

fr.name: Sur le qui-vive
fr.text:
Seulement utilisable par un serviteur incliné. Un serviteur ne peut en jouer qu'un seul exemplaire entre chacune de ses phases de redressement.
Ce serviteur se réveille (il n'a pas besoin d'être redressé pour jouer des cartes de réaction et tenter de bloquer jusqu'à la fin de l'action). Si ce serviteur est un allié, il ne se redresse pas normalement durant sa prochaine phase de redressement.

rulings.text: The minion need not attempt to block nor play further reaction cards: that is merely an option. [TOM 19951129]

Can be played or used during the “as a card is played” window, except in combat, or when there is no action. [ANK 20210817]

text:
Only usable by a locked minion. A minion can play only one On the Qui Vive between their unlock phases.
This minion wakes (they ignore the requirement to be unlocked for playing reaction cards and attempting to block until the end of the action). If this minion is an ally, they do not unlock as normal during their next unlock phase.

[pre][ser] Reduce a bleed against you by 2.
[PRE][SER] Only usable during a political action, after blocks are declined. Cancel an action modifier card as it is played, and its cost is not paid.

es.name: Fumadero de opio
es.text:
Lugar único.
Gírala para darle a un Ministro que controles +1 de sigilo.
es.flavor:
El opio agranda lo que no tiene límites,
alarga lo ilimitado,
hace más profundo el momento, aumenta el deleite,
y de placeres negros y lúgubres
colma el alma más allá de su capacidad
Charles Baudelaire, "El veneno"

fr.name: Fumerie d'opium
fr.text:
Lieu unique.
Vous pouvez l'incliner pour donner +1 en discrétion à un Disciple de Seth que vous contrôlez.
fr.flavor:
L'opium agrandit ce qui n'a pas de bornes,
Allonge l'illimité,
Approfondit le temps, creuse la volupté,
Et de plaisirs noirs et mornes
Remplit l'âme au delà de sa capacité.
Charles Baudelaire, "Le Poison"

text:
Unique location.
Lock to give a Ministry you control +1 stealth.
flavor:
And opium dreams can roam and rove
Past that which has no bourne,
Can plumb eternity, and mourn
The emptiness of love
And satiate the soul with joys forlorn.
Charles Baudelaire, "The Poison"

Unique.
This ally cannot be the target of directed actions requiring Auspex [aus], Chimerstry [chi], Dominate [dom], Presence [pre] or Serpentis [ser]. Reaction cards requiring any of those Disciplines cost 1 additional blood while this ally is acting.

Cabal may strike for 1R aggravated damage. Cabal may enter combat with any Tremere controlled by another Methuselah as a Ⓓ action.
flavor:
Am I not a jarring note
In the heavenly symphony?
Baudelaire, "Heautonimoroumen"

es.name: Resistencia organizada
es.text:
Requiere a un barón. Utilizable por un barón girado.
Un Anarquista que controles obtiene +1 de intercepción. También utilizable para enderezar a un Anarquista girado que controles; ese Anarquista intenta bloquear con +1 de intercepción, aunque la intercepción no sea necesaria.

fr.name: Résistance organisée
fr.text:
Requiert un baron. Utilisable par un baron incliné.
Un Anarch que vous contrôlez reçoit +1 en interception. Utilisable également pour redresser un Anarch incliné que vous contrôlez ; cet Anarch tente de bloquer avec +1 en interception, même si de l'interception n'est pas encore nécessaire.

Only usable if the opposing ally is being burned.
Each vampire you control gains X blood, where X is the cost to recruit the ally.

The capacity bonus stacks (2 per Orun), the votes do not (1 per 3 Oruns altogether). [LSJ 20051204] [LSJ 20060407] [LSJ 20090623]
The capacity bonus applies to cards played before the Orun was played (eg. {100079|Aranthebes, The Immortal}). [LSJ 20051110]
The effects do not apply if the vampire is not Laibon. [ANK 20221208]
If the Laibon performs a Ⓓ action to enter combat, they burn one Orun only after combat. [ANK 20240809]

text:
Master: trifle.
Put this card on a Laibon. For non-Orun cards played by Methuselahs other than this Laibon's controller, this Laibon is considered to have 2 additional capacity. A Laibon gets an additional vote for every three Orun he or she has. If this Laibon successfully bleeds for more than 2 or successfully performs an action directed at a non-mortal minion, he or she burns one Orun. Burn this card if this Laibon has more Orun and Aye than his or her capacity.

rulings.text: Cannot be used during a referendum that is automatically passing. [PIB 20150105] [LSJ 19980107]

text:
Only usable during a referendum. Usable by a locked vampire. Title.

Whenever this vampire is not a ready Laibon Osebo or there is an older ready untitled Laibon Osebo, move this card to (one of) the oldest ready untitled Laibon Osebo (if any).

The life is gained after the presses are handled. It is gained if the round ends prematurely. [RTR 20030519]

If Auspex [aus] was used to block him, the blocker can use an effect to set the range, but not a {101816|Sniper Rifle} as it would require him to strike with it, which he cannot. [LSJ 20100827]
If no Auspex [aus] was used previously, an Auspex [aus] strike can be used (eg. {100333|Charismatic Aura}). [ANK 20210614]

text:
Unique werewolf with 4 life. 2 strength, 0 bleed. Red List.
Ossian may enter combat with any vampire as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. In the first round of combat with a vampire who has played a card that requires Auspex [aus] during this action, that vampire cannot use any maneuvers or strikes. Ossian gains 1 life at the end of each round for each blood the opposing vampire used to heal damage or prevent destruction that round.

es.name: Mazmorra
es.text:
[obt] Ataque: el combate termina.
[OBT] Como antes, y el siervo oponente quema 1 de sangre o vida después de que el combate termine (incluso de lejos).

fr.name: Oubliettes
fr.text:
[obt] Frapper : fin de combat.
[OBT] Comme ci-dessus et le serviteur opposé brûle 1 point de sang ou de vie après la fin du combat (même à distance).

[obt] Strike: combat ends.

Master. Trifle.
Choose a ready Sabbat vampire you control. That vampire becomes Camarilla. (His or her clan is not affected.)
flavor:
When you tire of the mask of freedom and realize that the Traditions have served you all along, you take the name for yourself as well. Camarilla.
Anne Bowesley, Ventrue Prince (Queen) of London

text:
Mage with 2 life. 0 strength, 1 bleed.
Outcast Mage may strike for 2R damage. Outcast Mage gets one optional maneuver each combat.
flavor:
Priests in black gowns
Were making their rounds
And binding with briars
My joys and desires.
William Blake, "Garden of Love"

Master.

flavor:

Maximillian, Ventrue

Does not protect the target from self-inflicted damage from a weapon. [LSJ 19980216]

Only usable at close range.
[dem] Strike: 1 damage. This damage cannot be prevented by equipment or cards requiring Fortitude [for]. The opposing vampire's strikes with weapons inflict no damage this round.

Is a Directed Action against all (other) Methuselah.
(Actions which target another player's hand, uncontrolled region, crypt, or library (or cards therein) are directed at that player. Actions which target another player's ash heap are undirected by default) [LSJ 20010925] [LSJ 20100713] [PIB 20121230] [PIB 20150821] [RTR 20080808]

text:
+1 stealth action. Not usable if any Methuselah's crypt is empty.
Each Methuselah reveals the top card of his or her crypt. If there is a tie for highest or lowest cost among the revealed cards, every Methuselah burns 1 pool. Otherwise, the Methuselah revealing the highest cost steals 3 pool from the Methuselah revealing the lowest cost. All Methuselahs shuffle their crypts afterward.

rulings.text: [PRE] When the attached minion is blocked, all "if blocked" effects must be applied, ordered by the acting Methuselah, before any other card or effect can be used (eg. {100476|Crypt's Sons}, {100323|Change of Target}).

text:
+1 stealth action.

text:
Electronic.

[pre] La morsure est à +1 en morsure.

Lugar único. Zona de caza.

Sólo se puede jugar o proponer un ejemplar de esta carta por partida.
Si el referéndum prospera, cada Matusalén gana 3 de reserva sanguínea por cada vampiro que controle con capacidad 8 o más.

Pas plus d'un seul exemplaire ne peut être joué ou appelé par partie.
Si le référendum passe, chaque Mathusalem gagne 3 points de réserve pour chaque vampire sous son contrôle de capacité 8 ou plus.

The votes include bonus votes from cards or ability (eg. {200448|Eze, The Demon Prince}, {101091|Legendary Vampire}) but not conditional votes (eg. {201325|Sundown}, {100112|Aura of Invincibility}). [ANK 20211009] [LSJ 20040518-2]

Government.

Discipline.
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Potence [pot] and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Potence [POT].

rulings.text: Only requires one clan or the other (Tremere or Tremere antitribu) to be played. [ANK 20190203]
The damage is done during combat, the opponent can use combat cards to prevent it. [LSJ 20100205]
The damage does not depend on range. [ANK 20181024]

text:
+1 stealth action.

rulings.text: Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [TOM 19960225]
Damage done to the striking minion is environmental. [LSJ 19970801]
Minions can (uselessly) gain additional strikes even if they cannot strike. [LSJ 19970814-2]
If used with First Strike (e.g. Shadow Feint) it prevents the opponents normal non-dodge non-combat ends strike from resolving [LSJ 20011214] [LSJ 20020624]
The optional press can only be used during the current round. [TOM 19960521]

text: Strike: hand strike at +2 damage, and the opposing minion cannot strike for the remainder of the round (this doesn't affect the current strike resolution). If this strike is dodged, this striking minion takes 1 damage during strike resolution and the opposing minion gets an optional press.

If the action to equip with the Powder is successful, unlock the acting minion during the next discard phase. The bearer can burn this equipment before range is determined in a round of combat. If they do so, the opposing minion cannot use cards requiring Protean [pro] or Vicissitude [vic] until the end of combat and if the opposing minion is a werewolf, they get -2 strength until the end of combat.

rulings.text: Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]
If an action is canceled, it is not performed and the minion is free to attempt the same action again. [RBK cancel-a-card]
Cannot cancel cards that are not played from the hand in the normal fashion (e.g. can't cancel allies played via {101401|Piper}). [RTR 20001020]
Can be used to cancel all action cards, including employ retainer, recruit ally and political action. [ANK 20200813-2]
Cancelation must be immediate: a wake can be used in the "as played" window, but a reaction to "unlock and attempt to block" cannot. [LSJ 20021011]
Can be used if there is no action, but that allowance does not extend to other reactions (eg. wake effects). [PIB 20120808]
Cannot be played during combat. [LSJ 20080618]
If a minion who is attempting to block is locked, then that block will fail, unless they woke earlier during the action. [LSJ 20010702] [RTR 19941006] [LSJ 19991025] [LSJ 20100527]
rulings.group: Lock a minion during block attempt

rulings.text: The cost for a canceled non-action-card is still paid, including additional and alternative cost (e.g. to play {100598|Eagle's Sight} to block a Wraith or zombie while {201726|Parijat, the Dark Oracle} is ready the top card of the Library must be burned, even if {100598|Eagle's Sight} was canceled) [RBK cancel-a-card] [ANK 20260216]

es.name: Base de poder: Madrid
es.text:
Lugar único.
Si esta carta tiene 3 o menos fichas durante tu fase de enderezamiento, puedes añadirle 1 ficha. Gírala durante la fase de votación de cualquier referéndum para darle a un vampiro Sabbat titulado +1 voto por cada ficha de esta carta. Cualquier vampiro controlado por otro Matusalén puede quemar todas las fichas de esta carta con una acción Ⓓ.

fr.name: Siège du pouvoir : Madrid
fr.text:
Lieu unique.
Si cette carte a 3 compteurs ou moins durant votre phase de redressement, vous pouvez lui ajouter 1 compteur. Vous pouvez l'incliner durant l'étape de vote de n'importe quel référendum pour donner +1 voix pour chaque compteur sur cette carte à un vampire du Sabbat titré. N'importe quel vampire contrôlé par un autre Mathusalem peut brûler tous les compteurs de cette carte en action Ⓓ.

text:
Unique location.
If this card has 3 or fewer counters during your unlock phase, you can add 1 counter to it. You can lock this card during the polling step of any referendum to give a titled Sabbat vampire +1 vote for each counter on this card. Vampires controlled by other Methuselahs can burn all the counters from this card as a Ⓓ action.

If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]

Durant votre phase de redressement, un vampire disponible que vous contrôlez peut gagner 1 point de sang. Un vampire ne peut gagner de points de sang que d'un seul terrain de chasse à chaque tour.

rulings.text: The bearer is not commited to use it if he or she uses another effect to set the range. [RTR 20020501]
If a new combat occurs due to an effect like {101507|Psyche!}, the Rifle cannot be used to set the range. [LSJ 20010814]
If a Slave locks to enter combat instead of a blocked minion, the opponent cannot use the Rifle to set the range [ANK 20200115]
The ability to set the range can only be used if the weapon was equipped when blocking (eg. not when using {100555|Disguised Weapon} after the block). [LSJ 20021028]

When used to set range, you may choose not to strike if another card gives the option not to strike (e.g. {200871|Lucian, the Perfect}, {100489|Dam the Heart's River}) was played after Sniper Rifle was used to set range [LSJ 20071017]

Once the range is set, no other effect can be used to reset the range that round, but other pre-range effects can be played afterwards. Skip the Determine Range step for that round. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20180720]
If another effect was already setting that round's range (e.g. {101276|Neutral Guard}), that effect has priority. [PIB 20120214]

text:
Weapon: gun.
Strike: 2R damage, only usable at long range. If the bearer blocks, they can, before range is determined, set the range for the first round of the resulting combat to long, and their initial strike that round must be with this weapon.
flavor:
Weapons are tools of ill omen.
Sun Tzu, "The Art of War"

es.name: Absorber
es.text:
Un vampiro puede jugar sólo un ejemplar de esta carta por asalto.
[for] Prevente de 2 de daño no agravado.
[FOR] Prevente de 4 de daño no agravado.
es.flavor: Las heridas que ha sufrido habrían matado a un mortal y habrían destruído a muchos Vástagos. Jan sólo podía dar gracias a la sangre de Hardestadt y de los antiguos del clan Ventrue por haber sobrevivido tanto tiempo.

fr.name: Absorber
fr.text:
Un vampire ne peut en jouer qu'un seul exemplaire par round.
[for] Prévenir 2 points de dégâts non aggravés.
[FOR] Prévenir 4 points de dégâts non aggravés.
fr.flavor: Les blessures qu'il avait subies auraient à coup sûr tué un mortel et auraient été fatales à de nombreux vampires. Jan ne pouvait que remercier le sang de Hardestadt et des anciens du clan Ventrue pour avoir survécu tout ce temps.

rulings.text: Cannot be used to prevent aggravated damage, even if the minion treats them as normal damage (eg. {101790|Skin of Night}). [LSJ 20040812-2] [PIB 20130327]
If fewer points of (preventable) damage are being resolved, then the effect prevents all of those points. [RTR 20041202]
Unused prevention points can't be carried over unless optional ('can/may prevent'). [ANK 20200318] [LSJ 20001114]
Cannot be used if there is no damage to prevent. [LSJ 20001114]

text:
A vampire can play only one Soak each round.
[for] Prevent 2 non-aggravated damage.
[FOR] Prevent 4 non-aggravated damage.
flavor: The wounds he'd suffered would definitely have killed a mortal and would have destroyed many a Kindred. Jan had only the blood of Hardestadt and the elders of Clan Ventrue to thank that he'd survived this long.

text:
Only usable on an undirected action.
+1 stealth.
flavor:
The higher we soar, the smaller we appear to those who cannot fly.
Friedrich Nietzsche

text:
[pre] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.
[PRE] As above, and gain 1 pool if the bleed is successful (for 1 or more).
flavor:
Charming people live up to the very edge of their charm and behave just as outrageously as the world will let them.
Logan Pearsall Smith, "Afterthoughts"

rulings.text: Can be played with no older vampire in the uncontrolled region, though the ready vampire would be removed and his blood lost. [LSJ 20041015]

text:
Master.
Put this card on a ready vampire you control. During your influence phase, remove this vampire from the game and move all the blood counters from that vampire to an older vampire in your uncontrolled region.

es.name: Zona de caza: Alta sociedad
es.text:
Lugar único. Zona de caza.
Durante tu fase de enderezamiento, un vampiro preparado que controles puede ganar 1 de sangre. Un vampiro puede ganar sangre de sólo una zona de caza por turno.
es.flavor: Los Toreadores son prisioneros de su deseo por la vida nocturna que, cual sirena, los atrae con promesas de placeres prohibidos.

fr.name: Haute société, terrain de chasse
fr.text:
Lieu unique. Terrain de chasse.
Durant votre phase de redressement, un vampire disponible que vous contrôlez peut gagner 1 point de sang. Un vampire ne peut gagner de points de sang que d'un seul terrain de chasse à chaque tour.
fr.flavor: Les Toréadors sont prisonniers de leur soif de vie nocturne. Telle une sirène, elle les attire avec des promesses de plaisirs interdits.

text:
Unique location. Hunting ground.
During your unlock phase, a ready vampire you control can gain 1 blood. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground each turn.
flavor: The Toreador are imprisoned by their lust for the night life. Like a siren, it beckons them with promises of forbidden pleasures.

text:
Unique master.
Put this card on a vampire. During his or her controller's unlock phase, the vampire with this card either burns 1 blood or is burned (the controller's choice). The vampire with this card can move it to any other vampire as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

Master: archetype.
Put this card on a Sabbat vampire you control. Once per turn, when this vampire remains ready and burns a minion in combat or sends a vampire to torpor in combat, he or she gains 1 blood from the blood bank. A vampire can have only one archetype.
flavor:
When he is best, he is little worse than a man,
and when he is worst, he is little better than a beast.
William Shakespeare, "The Merchant of Venice", act I, scene 2

text:
Do not replace until after the current turn.
[pro] +1 intercept, only usable during a directed action.
[PRO] +1 intercept.
flavor:
O dark dark dark. They all go into the dark.
T.S. Eliot, "East Coker"

text:
[ani] Strike: 2 damage.
[ANI] Strike: 2 aggravated damage.
flavor:
I heard the most bewitchingly beautiful voice from the shadows that night.
Lolita, Toreador antitribu

text:
+1 stealth action. Unique.
Unlock this acting Kiasyd and put this card in play. All Kiasyd and changeling allies get +1 bleed. During your discard phase, burn this card and inflict 1 unpreventable damage on each Kiasyd or changeling ally you control who did not successfully bleed this turn.

Only usable before range is chosen.
[ani] The opposing minion gets -1 strength this round. A vampire may play only one Song of Serenity each combat.
[ANI] As above, but for the remainder of combat.

rulings.text: [QUI] A hunt is not successful if no blood is gained, even if the hunt action is still successful. [LSJ 20050720-2]
"Since your last turn" means between the end of your last turn and now. Your last turn does not qualify, your current turn does. [LSJ 20020429]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[qui] Ⓓ Send a vampire who has committed diablerie since your last turn to torpor, and burn 2 blood from them.
[QUI] Ⓓ Bleed. This action gets +1 bleed against the controller of any vampire who has successfully hunted since your last turn.

es.name: Quemadura del alma
es.text:
[tha] Ataque: 1 de daño a distancia. Este daño no se puede prevenir con cartas que requieran Fortaleza [for]. Los ataques del vampiro oponente con armas no infligen ningún daño en este asalto.
[THA] Como antes, pero 2 de daño a distancia.

fr.name: Brûlure de l'âme
fr.text:
[tha] Frapper à toute portée : 1 point de dégâts. Ces dégâts ne peuvent pas être prévenus par les cartes qui requièrent Force d'âme [for]. Les frappes avec des armes du vampire opposé n'infligent pas de dégâts ce round-ci.
[THA] Comme ci-dessus, mais pour 2 points de dégâts à toute portée.

rulings.text: If the opponent dodges this strike, his weapons are unaffected and do damage this round. [LSJ 20040928]
A weapon strike done with first strike is unaffected (unless Soul Burn is used with first strike too). [LSJ 20040928]
Does not protect the target from self-inflicted damage from a weapon. [LSJ 19980216]
Only nullify the weapon damage when it resolves, an opponent can successfully use {101654|Rötschreck} after declaring a strike with {101014|Ivory Bow}. [ANK 20170519]
The opponent cannot play prevention cards of that discipline (eg. for cycling). [LSJ 20050628]

text:
[tha] Strike: 1R damage. This damage cannot be prevented by cards requiring Fortitude [for]. The opposing vampire's strikes with weapons inflict no damage this round.
[THA] As above, but for 2R damage.

rulings.text: [OBF][VIC]Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

[OBF][VIC]If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

[OBF][VIC]The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
[OBF][VIC]If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
[OBF][VIC]A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[obf][vic] Ⓓ Bleed.
[OBF][VIC] Put this card on this vampire. During an action this vampire performs, they can cancel a card requiring Auspex [aus] as it is played, and its cost is not paid.

rulings.text: A minion can only perform this special hunt once per turn. [RBK action-card-or-card-in-play]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Hunt, or burn a wraith to hunt with +3 hunt (this is a directed action if you do not control the wraith).
[NEC] As above, with an additional +1 hunt.

rulings.text: If the new vampire is the same as the one who burned, he is still considered a new vampire for all purposes. (eg. he can bleed even if the previous version has already bled this turn) [LSJ 20100213]
Does not trigger if the bearer is removed from the game (eg. {100842|Golconda: Inner Peace}) [LSJ 20000113]
Functions even if the bearer (now burned) was prohibited from using equipments (eg. because of {100585|Drawing Out the Beast}). [LSJ 20010729]

If the drawn vampire (B) is younger and would be put into play with Gem but is burned instead (self-contesting, for example), then the Gem activates again, drawing a new vampire (C) and comparing his capacity to B's capacity. [RTR 20010711] [LSJ 20030918]
Can grab an imbued. In that case, the imbued is either placed in the uncontrolled region or placed empty into the incapacitated region with the Gem, as determined by his starting life. [LSJ 20060323]
Still produces its full effect if the new younger vampire cannot use equipment (eg. {200179|Beast, The Leatherface of Detroit}). [LSJ 20100527]
You can draw more cards than are in the library or crypt (even from an empty library or crypt); draw as much as you can. [LSJ 20060620]

text:
Unique equipment.
If this vampire is burned, draw the top card from your crypt. If it is younger, put the Soul Gem on him or her and move him or her to your ready region with blood from the blood bank equal to his or her capacity; otherwise, move that card to your uncontrolled region (and burn the Soul Gem). If bearer is diablerized, the diablerizing vampire cannot take the Soul Gem.

rulings.text: Only requires one clan or the other (Tremere or Tremere antitribu) to be played. [ANK 20190203]
Reduction applies to allies or retainers recruited in a non-normal way (eg. {101401|Piper}). [ANK 20210928]

text:
+1 stealth action.
Put this card on a slave Gargoyle. The Gargoyle with this card can burn it to reduce the cost of recruiting or employing an ally or retainer that requires a Gargoyle by up to 3 blood or pool.
flavor:
This ritual will cushion the creature's mind and body against the shock of your embrace.
Rebekka, Tremere Chantry Elder

text:
+1 stealth action.
[aus][pre] Ⓓ Put this card on a ready vampire. Vampires with Auspex [aus] get +1 intercept when attempting to block the vampire with this card. This vampire can burn this card as an action that costs 1 blood. A vampire can have only one Soul Painting.
[AUS][PRE] As [aus][pre] above, but all vampires get +1 intercept when attempting to block this vampire.

[aus] Search your crypt for a younger vampire without Obfuscate [obf], reveal them, and move them to your uncontrolled region (shuffle afterward).

(eg. {102144|War Ghoul} when recruited, {100254|Brigitte Gebauer} using her last life, {200749|Kamiri wa Itherero}'s ability). [RTR 19960124] [LSJ 20090922] [ANK 20181022]
[ACTION MODIFIER] If played on a diablerie, can be played before or after getting a Discipline card (if any), but must be played before the Blood Hunt. [RTR 19991206]

text:
Only usable if this vampire burns a vampire controlled by your prey.
[nec] [ACTION MODIFIER] This vampire gains blood equal to half the burned vampire's capacity rounded down.
[NEC] [COMBAT] As above, but usable in combat.

[POT]/[THA]The opponent cannot play prevention cards of that discipline (eg. for cycling). [LSJ 20050628]

text:
[pot] or [tha] Strike: hand strike at +2 damage.
[POT] or [THA] As above, and damage from this strike cannot be prevented by cards requiring Fortitude [for].

[aus][dom] [ACTION] +1 stealth action. Put this card on a minion you control. If an action to steal the minion with this card is successful, this minion is burned instead and the acting minion takes 1 unpreventable damage.
[AUS][DOM] [REACTION] As above, but play when an action to steal a minion you control is successful.

rulings.text:
Is a Directed Action against all (other) Methuselah.
(Actions which target another player's hand, uncontrolled region, crypt, or library (or cards therein) are directed at that player. Actions which target another player's ash heap are undirected by default) [LSJ 20010925] [LSJ 20100713] [PIB 20121230] [PIB 20150821] [RTR 20080808]

text:
Requires a ready anarch.
Each other Methuselah locks an unlocked ready younger vampire he or she controls. If this action is blocked by a non-titled vampire, the acting anarch can burn 1 blood to cancel combat and unlock.
flavor:
Hey, the anarchs rule! They are way cool, and they are gonna rock this city down! I'm joinin' tomorrow man! You wanna come?
Todd, Caitiff

text:
Master: unique location.
During your unlock phase, you may move 1 blood from a ready Nosferatu you control to this card. If a minion you control blocks a bleed against you, you may lock this card during the second round of the resulting combat to inflict 1 damage to the acting minion for each blood on the Spawning Pool. This damage cannot be prevented.

text:
[ani] +1 intercept. Only usable during a bleed action.
[spi] +1 intercept.

flavor:
A dead little bird told me.
Cynthia Ingold, Ahrimane

rulings.text: If the action lacks a suitable target because of the unlock (e.g. {100046|Ambush}), the block attempt still happens, as does the resulting combat if the block is successful. [LSJ 20090514]

text:
Master: out-of-turn.
Choose a ready vampire you control. That vampire unlocks and attempts to block. Once this action you may burn 1 pool to give that vampire +1 intercept.

Unique master.
Put this card in play. During your unlock phase, you may lock this card and discard two copies of the same card from your hand to gain 1 pool (draw afterward).

[nec] [ACTION MODIFIER] +1 stealth.
[NEC] [REACTION] +1 intercept.
flavor:
My locks are uncurled with dripping, drenching dew.
You know the old, whilst I know the new:
But tomorrow, you shall know this too.
Christina Rossetti, "The Poor Ghost"

rulings.text: If they use their last life to play an action modifier, the action fails. If they use their last life to play a strike, combat ends before strike resolution. [ANK 20180928-1]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If they takes aggravated damage from a card they plays as a vampire (eg. {100273|Burst of Sunlight}), they lose one life but do not go to torpor. [LSJ 20060409]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If they use their last life to pay for an action, the action still resolves fully. If that leads to an oust, the oust is resolved before resolving effects triggered by the fact that they burn. [LSJ 20080512]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: If a card they play as a vampire sends them to torpor (eg. {101581|Reform Body}), they burn. REVERSAL of previous rulings. [LSJ 20060409]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: They cannot use a card to commit diablerie (eg. {100043|Amaranth}) [RTR 19970630] [LSJ 20080717]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: Does not stack with similar effects (or another copy of itself) to provide superior version of the discipline(s) (e.g. {101083|Leech} and {101526|Putrescent Servitude} together does not provide superior [POT]) [ANK 20180111]
Can be used to meet one (but not more than one) of the normal Discipline requirements of a multi-Discipline card. [LSJ 20011217] [LSJ 20090508]
While a minion has an effect that allows them to play cards that require Discipline(s), they do not actually have those Discipline(s). [LSJ 19980303]

Multiple similar effects (e.g. two {100978|Infernal Familiar}, or {200616|Ian Forestal} with an {100978|Infernal Familiar}) cannot be used to meet the requirements of a multi-Discipline card that the minion is missing one or more Disciplines to play. [LSJ 20020218]

While using their ability to meet a discipline requirement, they also meet that requirement for any other cards associated with the original effect (e.g. meeting the [ani] requirement for {101342|Pack Alpha} or {101255|Muricia's Call} also meets the [ani] requirement for the {101550|Raven Spy} employed by that effect). [LSJ 20080205-2] [LSJ 20060417]
The ally counts as "independent" when playing cards as a vampire [LSJ 20020503] [LSJ 20060126]
The "can act the turn it is recruited" text does not let him act during an opponent's turn if it was recruited then (eg. using {100645|Enkil Cog}). [ANK 20200930] [ANK 20200813-3]
rulings.group: Can act the turn it is recruited

text:
Wraith with 1 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
[obl] This ally can perform actions the turn it is recruited. Unlock this vampire if this is their first successful recruit ally action this turn. This ally can play non-action cards requiring basic Oblivion [obl] as a vampire. During your unlock phase, burn this ally.
[OBL] As above, but during your unlock phase, you can burn 1 pool instead of burning this ally.

[cel] Ⓓ Bleed. If more than 1 pool is bled with this action, ignore the excess. Minions without Celerity [cel] cannot block this action.
[CEL] As above, but minions without superior Celerity [CEL] cannot block this action.

rulings.text: The copies you burn need not be ones you control. [LSJ 20090428]

The mummies put into play are unique by card name. The name is "in play" for anything that cares. They contest unique minions of the same name, vampire or allies. If one is {201042|Nefertiti}, then {200001|Aabbt Kindred} will be able to take directed actions. [LSJ 20070928-2] [LSJ 20071001-2]
The mummies do not contest non-unique vampires (eg. {200001|Aabbt Kindred}), but two mummies made of the same non-unique vampire contest one another. [LSJ 20070928-2]
If one of the mummy is burned, the card goes to the ash heap where it counts as a vampire (eg. {101423|Possession} can be used, but not {100388|Compel the Spirit}). [LSJ 20071014]
The mummies are not affected by {102194|Wormwood}. [LSJ 20100716]

text:
+1 stealth action. Only one Spell of Life can be played each turn.
Put this card in play. You can burn five copies of this card in play to put up to five vampires from your uncontrolled region in play; each becomes a unique mummy ally with life equal to capacity, 2 strength and 1 bleed who can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action.

rulings.text: The "does not unlock as normal" effect is redundant with being infernal. If the minion is infernal, his controller can still pay a pool to unlock him. [LSJ 20050114]
A second copy allows a second use in the same round. [ANK 20230316]

text:
Weapon.
1R damage each strike. Only usable at long range. Only usable once each round. If any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on an opposing vampire, that vampire does not unlock as normal on his or her next unlock phase.

rulings.text: [SPI][PRO] The [pro] and [spi][pro] versions do not contest with it. [ANK 20180629]

[pro][COMBAT]The ability to make the damage from the vampire's strikes aggravated that round must be used before strike resolution and damage prevention in order to affect the current strike. Can be played after both strikes have been chosen. [RTR 19960112]

[pro] [COMBAT] Damage from this vampire's hand strikes is aggravated this round.

text:
[dom] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed.
[obe] Ⓓ Bleed with +1 bleed and lock a ready minion controlled by your prey (even if the target of the bleed is changed).

[aus] +1 de intercepción.

es.flavor:
Somos eternos; y para nosotros, el pasado
Es, como el futuro, presente.
Lord Byron, "Manfred", acto I, escena 1

Lord Byron, "Manfred", acte I, scène 1

We are eternal; and to us, the past

Lord Byron, "Manfred", act I, scene 1

I call the phantoms of a thousand hours

Percy Bysshe Shelley, "Hymn to Intellectual Beauty"

es.name: Misión de espionaje
es.text:
[obf] +1 de sigilo.
[OBF] Sólo utilizable si un sangrado va a tener éxito. En vez de eso, el sangrado no quema reserva sanguínea, no tiene éxito, y esta carta se le pone a este vampiro. La próxima vez que este vampiro vaya a sangrar con éxito al mismo Matusalén, quema esta carta y este vampiro obtiene +2 de sangrado.

Me reúno con mi sombra en la cada vez más profunda sombra...
Theodore Roethke, "En un oscuro tiempo"

fr.name: Mission d'espionnage
fr.text:
[obf] +1 en discrétion.
[OBF] Seulement utilisable si une morsure devait être réussie. À la place, la morsure ne brûle pas de points de réserve, n'est pas réussie et cette carte est mise sur ce vampire. La prochaine fois que ce vampire est sur le point de mordre avec succès le même Mathusalem, brûlez cette carte et ce vampire reçoit +2 en morsure.
fr.flavor:
Je rencontre mon ombre au plus profond de l'ombre...
Theodore Roethke, "Dans un sombre moment"

rulings.text: [OBF] Cards and effects (e.g. {100085|Archon Investigation}) cannot be played or used after one or more Spying Missions are burned to increase a bleed, until after action resolution. [LSJ 19980105]

text:
