rulings.text: If a card they play as a vampire sends them to torpor (eg. {101581|Reform Body}), they burn. REVERSAL of previous rulings. [LSJ 20060409]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: They cannot use a card to commit diablerie (eg. {100043|Amaranth}) [RTR 19970630] [LSJ 20080717]
rulings.group: Allies who can play as a vampire

rulings.text: Does not stack with similar effects (or another copy of itself) to provide superior version of the discipline(s) (e.g. {101083|Leech} and {101526|Putrescent Servitude} together does not provide superior [POT]) [ANK 20180111]
Can be used to meet one (but not more than one) of the normal Discipline requirements of a multi-Discipline card. [LSJ 20011217] [LSJ 20090508]
While a minion has an effect that allows them to play cards that require Discipline(s), they do not actually have those Discipline(s). [LSJ 19980303]

Multiple similar effects (e.g. two {100978|Infernal Familiar}, or {200616|Ian Forestal} with an {100978|Infernal Familiar}) cannot be used to meet the requirements of a multi-Discipline card that the minion is missing one or more Disciplines to play. [LSJ 20020218]

While using their ability to meet a discipline requirement, they also meet that requirement for any other cards associated with the original effect (e.g. meeting the [ani] requirement for {101342|Pack Alpha} or {101255|Muricia's Call} also meets the [ani] requirement for the {101550|Raven Spy} employed by that effect). [LSJ 20080205-2] [LSJ 20060417]
The ally counts as "independent" when playing cards as a vampire [LSJ 20020503] [LSJ 20060126]

text:
Unique mage with 3 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
Talaq may strike for 1R damage. Talaq may play cards that require basic Quietus [qui] or basic Blood Sorcery [tha] as a vampire with a capacity of 3. Talaq gets an optional maneuver each combat.

es.name: La motosierra de Talbot
es.text:
Arma única.
Ataque: 3 de daño. Si el portador está preparado durante tu fase de enderezamiento, esta arma inflige 3 de daño imprevenible a un siervo preparado que controles. El portador no puede cazar. El portador puede entrar en combate con un siervo con una acción Ⓓ con +1 de sigilo. El portador obtiene 1 acoso (obligatorio), sólo utilizable para continuar el combate durante el primer asalto, y puede prevenirse de 1 de daño por combate.

fr.name: La tronçonneuse de Talbot
fr.text:
Arme unique.
Frapper : 3 points de dégâts. Si son possesseur est disponible durant votre phase de redressement, cette arme inflige 3 points de dégâts qui ne peuvent être prévenus à un serviteur disponible que vous contrôlez. Son possesseur ne peut pas chasser. Son possesseur peut entrer en combat contre un serviteur en action Ⓓ à +1 en discrétion. Son possesseur reçoit 1 poursuite (obligatoire), seulement utilisable pour continuer le combat durant le premier round et peut prévenir 1 point de dégâts durant chaque combat.

rulings.text: Using the Chainsaw action to enter combat or preventing damage with it does not force the minion to strike with it. [LSJ 19971215]

The damage inflicted during the unlock phase is weapon damage, it is neither inflicted by the wearer nor environmental. {200984|Mictlantecuhtli} can be chosen and would take no damage. [LSJ 20090304-1] [LSJ 20100514]

The action provided by the equipment to the attached minion fizzles (resolves successfully for no effect) if the equipment is not attached to the acting minion when the action resolves unblocked. [RTR 19960221]

text:
Unique weapon.
Strike: 3 damage. If the bearer is ready during your unlock phase, this weapon inflicts 3 unpreventable damage on a ready minion you control. The bearer cannot hunt. The bearer can enter combat with a minion as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. The bearer gets 1 press (mandatory), only usable to continue combat during the first round, and can prevent 1 damage each combat.

rulings.text: The "strike: destroy weapon" cannot be chosen if there is no weapon to destroy. [RTR 19980928]
Once in play, can be equipped from the minion it's on (rulebook action) by another minion that does not meet the requirements. [ANK 20180719-3]

text:
Melee weapon.
Strike: strength+1 damage. A Ravnos can use this weapon to strike: burn weapon with first strike.

Unique master.
Put this card on a Gangrel antitribu you control. Damage from this vampire's hand strikes is aggravated. Directed actions cost this vampire an additional blood. This vampire's controller may use a master phase action to burn this card.
flavor:
Their fatal hands
No second stroke intend.
John Milton, "Paradise Lost"

rulings.text: [abo] Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [TOM 19960225]

[abo][REFLEX]Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

[abo][REFLEX]If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

[abo][REFLEX]The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
[abo][REFLEX]If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
[abo][REFLEX]A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]
[abo] [REFLEX] Any frenzy card that targets/selects/chooses/affects the minion when played, is considered being played on the minion. [LSJ 20051113]

[abo][REFLEX]The cost for a canceled non-action-card is still paid, including additional and alternative cost (e.g. to play {100598|Eagle's Sight} to block a Wraith or zombie while {201726|Parijat, the Dark Oracle} is ready the top card of the Library must be burned, even if {100598|Eagle's Sight} was canceled) [RBK cancel-a-card] [ANK 20260216]

text:
[abo] [REFLEX] Cancel a frenzy card played on this vampire as it is played.
[abo] Strike: hand strike at +1 damage. This combat, this minion cannot cancel frenzy cards nor press to end.
[ABO] As above, but strike: burn equipment.

rulings.text: No reaction or modifier can be played afterwards: the action ends immediately. [RTR 20180719]

The action has not reached resolution. The same vampire can undertake the same action again, but not if it was blocked then continued before (eg. [PRO] {100771|Form of Mist}). [LSJ 20070709] [LSJ 20090220] [ANK 20210124]
The action was still taken (eg. counts against {100645|Enkil Cog} or [OBF] {102097|Veil the Legions}). [ANK 20210124]

When played, a multi-Disciplines card counts as requiring the Discipline(s) being used. In the hand, library, or ash heap, the card is considered to require any and/or all Disciplines listed on it. [LSJ 20011204-3] [PIB 20130704]

text:
Only usable if a minion attempts to block.
[pot] Cancel the action and unlock this vampire. (The action is not blocked. Do not lock the blocking minion.)
[tem] As [pot] above, and if an action card was played, take it back in your hand (discard down afterward).
[TEM] As [tem] above, and this vampire gets +1 stealth during their next action this turn.

rulings.text: The action provided by the equipment to the attached minion fizzles (resolves successfully for no effect) if the equipment is not attached to the acting minion when the action resolves unblocked. [RTR 19960221]

text:
Unique equipment.
This vampire can look at the top three cards of any Methuselah's library and burn up to one of those as a +1 stealth action that costs 1 blood. If that action is successful, this vampire unlocks at the end of the turn. This vampire gains 1 blood when a Gehenna event is played.

Unique mage with 2 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
Tara can strike: 1R damage. Tara can burn an equipment on a Ravnos as a Ⓓ action; that Ravnos gains blood equal to the cost of the equipment, 1 blood instead if the equipment has no cost.

rulings.text: Is played during the Strike phase even if you commit to a strike in the Determine Range phase (eg. {101982|Thrown Gate}). Cannot be played if the strike cannot be chosen anymore during the Strike phase (eg. {100959|Immortal Grapple}). [LSJ 20080409]
If it is canceled, any blood cost (eg. {101960|Terror Frenzy}) has to be paid. [PIB 20121031]

text:
Aim. Play when choosing a strike.
The opposing minion may discard two combat cards [COMBAT] to cancel this card. If any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on the opposing minion, he or she gets -1 strength this action, and you may destroy a weapon he or she has. A minion may play only one aim each strike.

rulings.text: Is played during the Strike phase even if you commit to a strike in the Determine Range phase (eg. {101982|Thrown Gate}). Cannot be played if the strike cannot be chosen anymore during the Strike phase (eg. {100959|Immortal Grapple}). [LSJ 20080409]
If it is canceled, any blood cost (eg. {101960|Terror Frenzy}) has to be paid. [PIB 20121031]
Can be played on a strike that does no damage, even a dodge or a combat ends, but has no effect in that case. [RTR 19960221] [PIB 20130319]

Once the range is set, no other effect can be used to reset the range that round, but other pre-range effects can be played afterwards. Skip the Determine Range step for that round. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20180720]
If another effect was already setting that round's range (e.g. {101276|Neutral Guard}), that effect has priority. [PIB 20120214]

The affected minion cannot play a card that provides an additional strike, even if just to benefit from another effect (e.g.
{100020|Acrobatics}). [LSJ 20011214-5]
Adding damage to a strike that does not deal damage has no effect, so the strike still will not do damage. [RTR 19960221]
Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [RTR 19970630] [TOM 19960225]

text:
Aim. Play when choosing a strike.
The strike does +2 damage. The opposing minion may discard a combat card [COMBAT] to cancel this card. If any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on the opposing minion, he or she cannot use any additional strikes or presses this round, and you may set the range for the next round. A minion may play only one aim each strike.

rulings.text: Is played during the Strike phase even if you commit to a strike in the Determine Range phase (eg. {101982|Thrown Gate}). Cannot be played if the strike cannot be chosen anymore during the Strike phase (eg. {100959|Immortal Grapple}). [LSJ 20080409]
If it is canceled, any blood cost (eg. {101960|Terror Frenzy}) has to be paid. [PIB 20121031]

text:
Aim. Play when choosing a strike.
The opposing minion may discard two combat cards [COMBAT] to cancel this card. If any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on the opposing minion, he or she may use maneuvers or presses only if they require Obfuscate [obf] , Blood Sorcery [tha] or Flight [FLIGHT] this action. A minion may play only one aim each strike.

rulings.text: Is played during the Strike phase even if you commit to a strike in the Determine Range phase (eg. {101982|Thrown Gate}). Cannot be played if the strike cannot be chosen anymore during the Strike phase (eg. {100959|Immortal Grapple}). [LSJ 20080409]
If it is canceled, the strike resolves with the default target. [ANK 20200311]
If it is canceled, any blood cost (eg. {101960|Terror Frenzy}) has to be paid. [PIB 20121031]
Adding damage to a strike that does not deal damage has no effect, so the strike still will not do damage. [RTR 19960221]
Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [RTR 19970630] [TOM 19960225]

text:
Aim. Only usable as this minion chooses a strike. A minion can play only one aim each strike.
You can target a retainer on the opposing minion with this strike (instead of the opposing minion). Or you can target the opposing minion directly as usual, but if any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted, this strike inflicts +1 damage. The opposing minion can discard two combat cards to cancel this card as it is played.

es.name: Apuntar a los puntos vitales
es.text:
Puntería. Sólo utilizable cuando este siervo elija un ataque. Un siervo puede jugar sólo una puntería por ataque.
Si este ataque inflige daño con éxito al siervo oponente, este último recibe +2 de daño de este ataque, y no puede acosar en este asalto. El siervo oponente puede descartarse de dos cartas de combate para cancelar esta carta al ser jugada.

fr.name: Cibler les points vitaux
fr.text:
Visée. Seulement utilisable lorsque ce serviteur choisit sa frappe. Un serviteur ne peut jouer qu'une seule visée par frappe.
Si au moins 1 point de dégâts de cette frappe est infligé avec succès au serviteur opposé, il subit +2 points de dégâts de cette frappe et ne peut pas poursuivre ce round-ci. Il peut défausser deux cartes de combat pour annuler cette carte lorsqu'elle est jouée.

rulings.text: Is played during the Strike phase even if you commit to a strike in the Determine Range phase (eg. {101982|Thrown Gate}). Cannot be played if the strike cannot be chosen anymore during the Strike phase (eg. {100959|Immortal Grapple}). [LSJ 20080409]
The additional damage is the same type as the strike's damage. [RTR 19970630]
If it is canceled, any blood cost (eg. {101960|Terror Frenzy}) has to be paid. [PIB 20121031]
Can be played on a strike that does no damage, even a dodge or a combat ends, but has no effect in that case. [RTR 19960221] [PIB 20130319]
Adding damage to a strike that does not deal damage has no effect, so the strike still will not do damage. [RTR 19960221]
Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage. [RTR 19970630] [TOM 19960225]

text:
Aim. Only usable as this minion chooses a strike. A minion can play only one aim each strike.
If any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on the opposing minion, they take +2 damage from this strike, and they cannot press this round. They can discard two combat cards to cancel this card as it is played.

Unique mortal with 1 life.
The employer gets +1 bleed.

Only usable at long range.
[qui] Strike: 1R aggravated damage.
[QUI] Strike: 2R aggravated damage.

es.name: Saborear la Vitae
es.text:
Sólo utilizable al final de un asalto de combate. No utilizable por un vampiro que se esté quemando o entrando en letargo. Un vampiro puede jugar sólo un ejemplar de esta carta por asalto.
Este vampiro gana tanta sangre como sangre haya perdido el vampiro oponente debido al daño en este asalto.

fr.name: Gorgée de vitæ
fr.text:
Seulement utilisable à la fin d'un round de combat. Non utilisable par un vampire en train d'être brûlé ou d'aller en torpeur. Un vampire ne peut en jouer qu'un seul exemplaire par round.
Ce vampire gagne autant de points de sang que de points de sang perdus par le vampire opposé à cause de dégâts ce round-ci.

rulings.text: Cannot be played against an ally. [PIB 20121028]
Must be played after the presses are handled and can be played if the round ends prematurely. [RTR 20001020] [LSJ 20001024] [RTR 20030519]

Can be played before or after effects that are played at the end of the round or "when the combat would end" (eg. [AUS] {101950|Telepathic Tracking}). Can be played after [CEL] {101507|Psyche!} [LSJ 20021113] [ANK 20191219] [ANK 20180910-1]
Can be played if the opponent was burned. [LSJ 20031201-2]

text:
Only usable at the end of a round of combat. Not usable by a vampire being burned or going to torpor. A vampire can play only one Taste of Vitae each round.
This vampire gains blood equal to the amount of blood lost by the opposing vampire to damage this round.

rulings.text: The burn option can be used if all your Seraph are in torpor. [LSJ 20091203]
You cannot use the burn option if you have a ready Seraph, even if they already have a Tattoo Signal. [LSJ 20070410]

text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a Seraph.
Put this card on this acting Seraph. This ready Seraph may lock this card to unlock another Black Hand vampire. A minion may have only one Tattoo Signal.

rulings.text: [ANI] The prey goes first in the combat (for declaring maneuvers, strikes, presses). [LSJ 20070319]

text:
[ani] Ⓓ Enter combat with any vampire, with an optional maneuver in that combat.
[ANI] Choose a ready vampire controlled by your predator and another controlled by your prey (not usable when only one other Methuselah is in the game). The chosen vampires enter combat. If only one is ready at the end of that combat, he or she gains 4 blood.

rulings.text: Must be played before the bleed can be considered successful (eg. before [OBF] {101857|Spying Mission}), but can be played before or after block attempts. [TOM 19960303] [LSJ 20061212]

text:
[aus] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[AUS] Reduce a bleed against you by 2.

es.name: Distracción telepática
es.text:
[aus] +1 de intercepción.
[AUS] Sólo utilizable si un siervo te está sangrando, tras renunciar a bloquear. Gira a este vampiro reactivo. Cambia el objetivo del sangrado por otro Matusalén que no sea el controlador del siervo activo (ese Matusalén puede intentar bloquear).

fr.name: Distraction télépathique
fr.text:
[aus] +1 en interception.
[AUS] Seulement utilisable si un serviteur est en train de vous mordre, après avoir renoncé à bloquer. Inclinez ce vampire qui réagit. Redirigez la morsure vers un autre Mathusalem autre que le contrôleur du serviteur qui agit (ce Mathusalem peut tenter de bloquer).

rulings.text: [AUS]Can be used after a block attempt fails (after declining to block). [ANK 20211003]
rulings.group: Change the target of a bleed

rulings.text: [AUS]Must be used before action resolution, ie. before any modifier or reaction played "as the action/bleed would be successful" are played. It cannot be played after a {101857|Spying Mission} on the vampire triggers. [LSJ 19980105]
rulings.group: Change the target of a bleed

rulings.text: [AUS]Cannot be used to direct a bleed to a Methuselah who would be an invalid target for a bleed. [PIB 20130711]
rulings.group: Change the target of a bleed

rulings.text: [AUS]Cannot be used before all blocks have been declined. [LSJ 20061213]
rulings.group: Change the target of a bleed

rulings.text: [AUS]No blocks can be attempted if it is canceled as it is played (as blocks have been declined) unless another effect subsequently changes the target of the bleed. [LSJ 20061211]
rulings.group: Change the target of a bleed

text:
[aus] +1 intercept.
[AUS] Only usable if a minion is bleeding you, after blocks are declined. Lock this reacting vampire. Change the target of the bleed to another Methuselah other than the acting minion's controller (that Methuselah can attempt to block).

es.name: Rastreo telepático
es.text:
[aus] Acoso, sólo utilizable para continuar el combate. Si hay otro asalto de combate, este vampiro obtiene 1 maniobra opcional en ese asalto.
[AUS] Sólo utilizable si ambos combatientes aún están preparados y el combate está a punto de terminar. En lugar de eso, un nuevo asalto comienza.

fr.name: Pistage télépathique
fr.text:
[aus] Poursuivre, seulement utilisable pour continuer le combat. Si un autre round de combat a lieu, ce vampire reçoit 1 manœuvre optionnelle ce round-là.
[AUS] Seulement utilisable si les deux combattants sont toujours disponibles et que le combat doit prendre fin. À la place, démarrez un nouveau round.

rulings.text: Can be played before of after effects that are played "at the end of combat". [LSJ 20021113] [ANK 20191219] [ANK 20180910-1]
rulings.group: Playable "when combat would end" or "is about to end"

rulings.text: [AUS]Effects that end combat and then do something else after combat (include continuing the action as if unblocked) will be lost, except for unlock effects. [RTR 20020501] [LSJ 19980109]
[AUS]Cannot be played after [CEL] {101507|Psyche!}. When played before, combat continues and Psyche! can only be played at the end of it. [ANK 20191219]
[AUS]Must be played after presses, can be played if the round ends prematurely. [RTR 20030519]

text:
[aus] Press, only usable to continue combat. If another round of combat occurs, this vampire gets 1 optional maneuver that round.
[AUS] Only usable if both combatants are still ready and combat would end. Instead, start a new round.

rulings.text: May be played before, during, or after votes and ballots have been cast. [LSJ 19980130]
[aus] The results are not tallied (eg. {101692|Scorn of Adonis} or {100251|Bribes} have no effect). [LSJ 20010209]
Cannot be used during a referendum that is automatically passing. [PIB 20150105] [LSJ 19980107]

text:
Only usable during the polling step of a political action.
[aus] Cancel the referendum. If you played a political action card to call this referendum, return it to its owner's hand (discard down afterward).
[AUS] Force a vampire to abstain (this can cancel their votes and ballots).

rulings.text: Each copy of this card provides its own action: if the vampire manage to unlock during the minion phase, he can perform the action more than once (once per copy). [RTR 20030519]
The two actions provided are not cross-restrictive. Each can be performed once during the same turn by the same minion. [LSJ 20100909]

The action provided by this card is considered to be an action requiring the listed clan/sect/capacity/title (e.g. the action provided by {101324|Open War} is considered an action that requires an Anarch, the action provided by {102290|The Gate of Acheron} is considered an action that requires Hecata). [LSJ 20080604]
rulings.group: Action requirements from a card in play

text:
Requires a ready titled Sabbat vampire.
Choose a Sabbat vampire. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen vampire. This vampire is a Templar. He or she may enter combat with a ready vampire controlled by another Methuselah as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. Any Sabbat vampire may call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.
flavor:
I don't have to kill anyone? Then why call for me?
Talley, The Hound, Lasombra

es.name: Zona de caza: Templo
es.text:
Lugar único. Zona de caza.
Durante tu fase de enderezamiento, un vampiro preparado que controles puede ganar 1 de sangre. Un vampiro puede ganar sangre de sólo una zona de caza por turno.

fr.name: Temple, terrain de chasse
fr.text:
Lieu unique. Terrain de chasse.
Durant votre phase de redressement, un vampire disponible que vous contrôlez peut gagner 1 point de sang. Un vampire ne peut gagner de points de sang que d'un seul terrain de chasse à chaque tour.

text:
Unique location. Hunting ground.
During your unlock phase, a ready vampire you control can gain 1 blood. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground each turn.

rulings.text: If played on one of your own vampires, the action is undirected. Its effect can be used to unlock the vampire. [LSJ 20010828] [ANK 20180917]
Multiple Temptations on the same minion are handled separately. Counters from one Temptation do not affect counters on another Temptation. [LSJ 20010227]
There is no stack in VTES; no effect can be used in response to the decision to burn the counters (e.g. {201274|Shalmath} cannot unlock). [PIB 20121028]
If Temptation has 0 counters, you may still burn all counters to unlock and take control of a vampire with 0 blood. [LSJ 20010828-2]
If one is ousted while having temporary control of a minion, the minion is removed from the game.  (Reversal of Previous Rulings) [ANK 20181110] [LSJ 20081105]
The stolen minion is removed from the game when he should return to a Methuselah who has been ousted. [ANK 20181110]
The stolen minion returns to his previous controller even if he is in torpor/incapacitated (but stays in torpor/incapacitated). [LSJ 20010119]
If used to steal a vampire in combat, combat ends. Any damage yet to resolve still resolves before the change of control. [LSJ 20020618]
rulings.group: Can steal minion during an action

rulings.text: If used to steal a minion attempting to block, if the block attempt becomes illegal, the block attempt fails. [LSJ 20080326]
rulings.group: Can steal minion during an action

rulings.text: If used to steal a minion during an action, Methuselahs who declined to block are still declining to block. The new controller, if he is eligible and has not declined to block yet, can block with the stolen minion even if the previous controller has declined to block. [PIB 20150501]
rulings.group: Can steal minion during an action

rulings.text: If used to steal a minion targeted by an action, the action continues with the same target. Methuselahs who declined to block do not get another opportunity. If the target is not legal anymore (eg. [DOM] {101801|Slaughtering the Herd}), the action fizzles (ends successfully with no effect). [LSJ 20020725]
rulings.group: Can steal minion during an action

rulings.text: Can be used to take control of the target at any point during the appropriate minion phase. It does not have to be done before non-mandatory actions. [LSJ 20001201]
rulings.group: Can steal minion during an action

text:
[ser] Ⓓ Put this card on a ready vampire; you still control this card. During your master phase, you can add 1 counter to this card. During your minion phase, if the number of counters on this card equals or exceeds the amount of blood on the attached vampire, you can burn the counters to unlock and take control of them until the end of the turn.
[SER] As above, and this card comes into play with 1 counter.

Master. Requires a ready justicar.
Choose a vampire. Methuselahs may bid pool for control of that vampire. The winner pays the bid to the blood bank and takes control. Methuselahs may be credited up to 5 pool on the bid: winner pays 1 pool toward his or her debt during his or her discard phase until the debt is repaid. Only 1 Temptation of Greater Power can be played in a game.
flavor:
The Toreador's loyalty was easily won with cheap trinkets and even cheaper promises.
Gangrel, Newark 2002 Storyline

rulings.text: The blood comes from the blood bank. [ANK 20190311]

text: Choose a ready unlocked infernal Baali you control. Add 3 blood to a younger infernal vampire in your uncontrolled region.

es.name: Forma tenebrosa
es.text:
[obt] +1 de sigilo.
[OBT] Como antes, y los siervos sin Obtenebración [obt] deben quemar 1 de sangre para intentar bloquear
es.flavor:
Sé como una sombra en una noche oscura; invisible, silenciosa, no dejes señales de tus idas o venidas.
Las advertencias

fr.name: Forme ténébreuse
fr.text:
[obt] +1 en discrétion.
[OBT] Comme ci-dessus et les serviteurs sans Obténébration [obt] doivent brûler 1 point de sang pour tenter de bloquer (les alliés ne peuvent pas brûler de points de sang).
fr.flavor:
Soyez comme une ombre dans la nuit noire ; invisible, inaudible, qu'il n'y ait aucune trace de vos entrées et sorties.
Les Admonestations.

rulings.text: [OBT]A minion previously attempting to block can resign his attempt and pay no blood. [LSJ 20031121-2]
rulings.group: Burn blood to attempt to block

text:
[obt] +1 stealth.
[OBT] As above, and minions without Obtenebration [obt] must burn 1 blood to attempt to block (allies cannot burn blood).
flavor:
Be as a shadow on a dark night; unseen, unheard, let there be no sign of your coming in or going out.
The Admonitions

es.name: Tensión en la tropa
es.text:
Única.
Pon esta carta en juego. Cualquier Matusalén quema 1 de reserva sanguínea después de que un siervo preparado que controle se queme o sea enviado al letargo. Cualquier Matusalén puede usar una acción de fase heril y descartarse de dos cartas heriles para quemar esta carta.
es.flavor:
Hasta los ghouls de guerra parecen nerviosos.
Banu Haqim, Trama de 2002, Seekonk.

fr.name: Tension dans les rangs
fr.text:
Unique.
Mettez cette carte en jeu. Tout Mathusalem brûle 1 point de réserve après qu'un serviteur disponible sous son contrôle est brûlé ou envoyé en torpeur. N'importe quel Mathusalem peut utiliser une action de phase de maître et défausser deux cartes de maître pour brûler cette carte.
fr.flavor: Même les goules de guerre ont l'air nerveuses...

rulings.text: Pool is not paid when an imbued is incapacitated. [LSJ 20060409-2]
When several minions burn or enter Torpor simultaneously, the acting Methuselah sets the order in wich the pool is burned. [LSJ 20090208-2]

text:
Unique.
Put this card in play. After a ready minion is burned or sent to torpor, their controller burns 1 pool. Methuselahs can use a master phase action and discard two master cards to burn this card.
flavor:
In the Gehenna War, the only winning move is not to play. Unfortunately, you don't get a choice.
Theo Bell, Brujah

rulings.text: Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]
Cancelation must be immediate: a wake can be used in the "as played" window, but a reaction to "unlock and attempt to block" cannot. [LSJ 20021011]

text:
Requires a ready Laibon. Not usable if you control any ready non-Laibon vampires.
Reduce a bleed against you made by a non-Laibon controlled by your predator by 1, or burn a blood to cancel a card that would retarget a bleed to you played by a non-Laibon as it is played (no cost is paid).

rulings.text: When blocked, all "if blocked" effects must be applied, ordered by the acting Methuselah, before any other card or effect can be used (eg. {100476|Crypt's Sons}, {100323|Change of Target}). [ANK 20220116] [ANK 20211207] [ANK 20210627] [RTR 19991206] [LSJ 20091125]

text: Put this card on a ready vampire who follows the Path of Cathari. If this vampire is blocked, the blocking minion's controller burns 1 pool before block resolution. A vampire can have only one Terrifying Visage.

rulings.text: [ANI] Also affects the cost of combat cards played at then of a round or combat (eg. {100549|Disarm}, {101950|Telepathic Tracking}, {101507|Psyche!}, {101945|Taste of Vitae}). [ANK 20180910-3]

text:
Frenzy. Only usable before range is determined.
[ani] Only usable during the first round. This combat, the opposing minion cannot maneuver to close range, press to continue combat or use equipment.
[ANI] This combat, combat cards cost the opposing vampire +1 blood. A vampire can play only one Terror Frenzy at superior each combat.

rulings.text: Does not prevent the acting ally from playing the equipment directly this turn if he unlocks (not the same action). [ANK 20180817]
Their special is an equip action. [TOM 19960130]
Requirements apply. [ANK 20180817] [LSJ 20100303] [LSJ 20100725]

text:
Mortal with 1 life. 2 strength, 1 bleed.
Terrorists may take a +1 stealth action to go through your library, find a Bomb, and equip them with it. Pay the cost to equip as normal. Reshuffle your library afterwards.
flavor: In times of war, the laws are silent.

text:
Unique.
This vampire gets superior Daimoinon [DAI] and is infernal. Cards requiring Daimoinon [dai] cost this vampire -2 blood. If this vampire is locked during your master phase, burn this equipment.

es.name: Thadius Zho
es.text:
Mago único con 2 de vida. 0 de fuerza, 2 de sangrado.
Thadius Zho puede atacar: 2 de daño a distancia. Obtiene 1 maniobra opcional por combate. Puede quemarle 1 de sangre a cualquier vampiro con una acción Ⓓ con +1 de sigilo.

fr.name: Thadius Zho
fr.text:
Mage unique avec 2 points de vie. 0 en force, 2 en morsure.
Thadius Zho peut frapper à toute portée : 2 points de dégâts. Il reçoit 1 manœuvre optionnelle durant chaque combat. Il peut brûler 1 point de sang de n'importe quel vampire en action Ⓓ à +1 en discrétion.

text:
Unique mage with 2 life. 0 strength, 2 bleed.
Thadius Zho can strike: 2R damage. He gets 1 optional maneuver each combat. He can burn 1 blood from a vampire as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

rulings.text: If your prey cannot afford to contest, she pays what she has, she is ousted, and you still yield. [RTR 20010711]

text:
+1 stealth action.
[dom] Put this card into play and choose a card you are contesting with another Methuselah. Your cost to avoid yielding the contested card is now paid by your prey. (You still decide whether you will yield.) Any minion may burn this card as a Ⓓ action.

Master: Discipline.
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gains 1 level of Blood Sorcery [tha]. Capacity increases by 1: the vampire is one generation older. Cannot be placed on a vampire with superior Blood Sorcery [THA].

es.name: Robo de Vitae
es.text:
[tha] Ataque a distancia: roba 1 de sangre o vida (convirtiéndose en sangre).
[THA] Ataque a distancia: roba 2 de sangre o vida (convirtiéndose en sangre).
es.flavor:
¡La sangre es la vida!
¡La sangre es la vida!
Bram Stoker, "Drácula"

fr.name: Vol de vitæ
fr.text:
[tha] Frapper à toute portée : voler 1 point de sang ou de vie (convertie en sang).
[THA] Frapper à toute portée : voler 2 points de sang ou de vie (convertie en sang).
fr.flavor:
Le sang, c'est la vie !
Le sang, c'est la vie !
Bram Stoker, "Dracula"

rulings.text: Can target a minion with less blood or life than the amount stolen. [RTR 20010711]
If both opponents play Theft of Vitae, they resolve simultaneously: blood amounts are adjusted by the total of gain and loss and no blood wear off. [ANK 20200123] [LSJ 20041027]

text:
[tha] Strike, ranged: steal 1 blood or life (becoming blood).
[THA] Strike, ranged: steal 2 blood or life (becoming blood).
flavor:
The blood is the life!
The blood is the life!
Bram Stoker, "Dracula"

text:
Usable by a locked vampire.
Unlock a gargoyle creature ally or a ready slave Gargoyle you control.

rulings.text: The reduction applies to equipments that are locations (eg. {101345|Palatial Estate}). [LSJ 20080107]

text:
Master: unique location.
Locations cost you 1 less blood or pool.
flavor:
Money can't buy friends, but it can get you a better class of enemy.
Spike Milligan

rulings.text: The vampire coming out of uncontrolled keeps the cards and blood he has, if any. [LSJ 20100206-2]

A vampire with no circle designation is in his own unique circle. Vampires with the same name (eg. {100633|The Embrace}, non-unique vampires) do not share a circle by default, each has his own circle of one by default. [LSJ 20020609]

text: Choose a ready Blood Brother you control. Move a unique Blood Brother of the same circle from your uncontrolled region to your ready region. Not usable if they would contest a card in play.

Only usable at close range before strikes are chosen. A vampire can play only one Thin Blood each round.
[qui] The opposing vampire burns 1 blood.
[QUI] The opposing vampire burns 2 blood.

rulings.text: When computing the cost of a card, multiplications and divisions are applied first, followed by additions and subtractions. [PIB 20150917] [RTR 20070707]
Is not a vampire in the ash heap (eg. {101423|Possession} cannot target it). [LSJ 20020115]
If moved to the uncontrolled region (eg. by {100131|Banishment}), it stays a vampire and can be influenced. [RTR 19990712]
If it would be put into the crypt for any reason, it is burned instead [LSJ 20041201-2]

text:
Requires a ready non-sterile vampire of capacity less than 3.
Put this card into play; it becomes a 1-capacity vampire. This vampire is clanless and sterile. This vampire is not considered unique, must hunt this turn and is the same sect as the acting vampire. Cards that cost blood cost this vampire twice as much blood to play. During your unlock phase, you may lock this vampire to look at the top two cards of any Methuselah's library.

es.name: Thing
es.text:
Acción con +1 de sigilo.
Añade 2 de sangre a un Gangrel de tu zona incontrolada.

fr.name: Thing
fr.text:
Action à +1 en discrétion.
Ajoutez 2 points de sang à un Gangrel dans votre région incontrôlée.

text:
+1 stealth action.
Add 2 blood to a Gangrel in your uncontrolled region.

rulings.text: The decision to move blood on the Progeny or not is taken upon resolution. [PIB 20150418]
Is not a vampire in the ash heap (eg. {101423|Possession} cannot target it). [LSJ 20020115]
If moved to the uncontrolled region (eg. by {100131|Banishment}), it stays a vampire and can be influenced. [RTR 19990712]
If it would be put into the crypt for any reason, it is burned instead [LSJ 20041201-2]

text:
+1 stealth action. Requires a non-sterile prince or justicar.
Put this card in play. It becomes a 1-capacity (non-unique) Camarilla vampire of the same clan as the acting vampire and cannot perform actions this turn. You can search your library (shuffle afterward), hand and/or ash heap for a Discipline master card and put it on this new vampire. Move up to 2 blood from the acting vampire to this new vampire.
flavor: Thou shalt only sire another with the permission of thine elder.

rulings.text: The hunt need not be successful for a vampire to avoid the effect. [LSJ 20050727]

text:
Gehenna.
After each Methuselah's minion phase ends, each ready vampire controlled by that Methuselah with capacity less than the number of Gehenna events in play who did not hunt during that minion phase burns 1 blood.
flavor:
Night after night. Rising, hunting, killing, feeding. Nothing more than ambulatory corpses without the good sense to lie down and be still.
Felton, Tremere

rulings.text: Must be played (as well as other "as the action is announced" action modifiers) before action modifiers that are not explicitly played "as the action is announced" (e.g., {100401|Conditioning}). [ANK 20190425]
Replace the action card (if any) before playing it. [ANK 20181208]
If the action continues "as if unblocked", all action modifiers and reaction cards are still in effect, even those pertaining to a successful block. [RTR 19941109] [ANK 20190116]
If the action continues "as if unblocked", any Methuselahs that have declined to block before do not get another opportunity to block. [ANK 20190116]

For actions resulting from an action card, "continue as if unblocked" moves the action card from the ash heap (where it went when the action was blocked) to limbo (where it should be if the action is not blocked). If the action card is not in the ash heap, then the action cannot be continued. [LSJ 20070808-1]

text:
Requires a Laibon with capacity above 4. Only usable when the action is announced.
The acting vampire gets two additional votes in any referendums conducted during this action (even blood hunt referendums). Any younger vampire successfully blocking this action burns 1 blood (before combat, if any). If he or she cannot, the block fails and the action continues as if unblocked.

rulings.text: [dom] Damage is environmental. [RTR 19970630] [ANK 20200422]

[dom] Damage is inflicted even against a dodge. A "strike: combat ends" ends combat before damage is applied, as will a combatant going to torpor during first strike. [RTR 19941109] [TOM 19951216] [PIB 20140324] [ANK 20200422]
[DOM] Cards that merely provide the ability to strike (eg. {100001|.44 Magnum}), are allowed. [ANK 20210928-2]
[DOM] Strike cards that are played during the Determine Range step because they provide a maneuver (eg. {100029|Aid from Bats}) are not allowed. [ANK 20210928-2]

text:
Only usable before range is determined on the first round.
[dom] Opposing minion takes 1 additional damage in the first round of combat during normal strike resolution.
[DOM] Opposing minion cannot play any strike cards for the duration of this combat.

+1 stealth action.
Burn a card played by another Methuselah on a vampire you control. Lock that vampire.

Only usable during a bleed action.
[dom] +1 bleed (limited).
[DOM] +2 bleed (limited).
flavor:
As by tenderness and ruth
Others rule thy life and youth,
I by terror choose to reign.
Charles Baudelaire, "The Revenant"

rulings.text: A vampire with no circle designation is in his own unique circle. Vampires with the same name (eg. {100633|The Embrace}, non-unique vampires) do not share a circle by default, each has his own circle of one by default. [LSJ 20020609]
The optional press can only be used during the current round. [TOM 19960521]

text:
Requires a ready unlocked Blood Brother of the same circle as another one you control in combat.
Only usable before range is determined. The range this round is automatically close, and the Blood Brother in combat gets an optional press, only usable to continue combat.

Master: unique location. Hunting ground.
Lock during your master phase to move a blood from the blood bank to this card. Lock during your unlock phase to move 1 blood from this card to your pool or to a ready vampire you control. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground card each turn.

[ser] Ⓓ Burn 2 blood from a ready titled vampire.
[SER] As above, and lock the target vampire.
flavor:
For there's no greater evil than a lack of leadership. That destroys whole cities, turns households into ruins, and in war makes soldiers break and run away.
Sophocles, "Antigon"

rulings.text: The optional maneuver cannot be used if the strike cannot be used (eg. {100916|Hidden Lurker}). [LSJ 20021028]

text:
[pot] Strike: 1R damage, with an optional maneuver.
[POT] Strike: 2R damage, with an optional maneuver.
flavor:
Just be glad we aren't back in the days when most gates were made out of wood.
Angela Decker, Pander

rulings.text: [POT]The optional press can only be used during the current round. [TOM 19960521]

text:
Only usable at long range.
[pot] Strike: 3R damage.
[POT] As above, with an optional press.

[ani] Ⓓ Steal 1 blood or life from a minion controlled by your prey.
[ANI] As above, and put this card on this vampire. This vampire gets +1 bleed against your prey. Minions can burn this card as a Ⓓ action. A vampire can have only one Tier of Souls.

rulings.text: [MYT]The optional maneuver cannot be used if the strike cannot be used (eg. {100916|Hidden Lurker}). [LSJ 20021028]

text:
Weapon. This weapon can be used to strike only once each round.
[myt] Strike: 2R damage.
[MYT] As above, or strike: 1R damage, with 1 optional maneuver each combat.

Requires a ready Sabbat vampire with a capacity above 6.
Successful referendum means you steal 1 pool from each Methuselah who does not control a vampire with a capacity above 6.

Master: unique location.
When this card is played or the controller of this card changes, the controller chooses a vampire in his or her uncontrolled region. For each blood counter you transfer to the chosen vampire during your influence phase, move one counter from the blood bank to the Tomb. At the end of your influence phase, if the total number of counters on the chosen vampire and on the Tomb equals or exceeds that vampire's capacity, you may move the vampire to the ready region. Burn this card (and the counters on it) when this vampire leaves the uncontrolled region.

rulings.text: Can target a minion with less blood than the amount stolen. [RTR 20010711]

text:
[ser] Strike: steal 1 blood or life (becoming blood).
[SER] Strike: steal 2 blood or life (becoming blood).
flavor:
No matter what he hope or plan,
There is no moment left when man
Is not subject to the constant
Warnings of this odious Serpent.
Charles Baudelaire, "The Serpent's Tooth"

es.name: Gran baile Toreador
es.text: Elige a dos Toreadores preparados que controles, pon esta carta en juego, y gira a uno de los dos. El Toreador girado no se endereza normalmente. Las acciones que no sean de sangrado del otro Toreador no se pueden bloquear. Cualquier siervo puede quemar esta carta con una acción Ⓓ; los Nosferatu obtienen -1 de sigilo en esa acción.

fr.name: Grand bal Toréador
fr.text: Choisissez deux Toréadors disponibles que vous contrôlez, mettez cette carte en jeu et inclinez un des deux. Le Toréador incliné ne se redresse pas normalement. Les actions qui ne sont pas des morsures de l'autre Toréador ne peuvent pas être bloquées. N'importe quel serviteur peut brûler cette carte en action Ⓓ ; les Nosferatus reçoivent -1 en discrétion durant cette action.

rulings.text: The same vampire can serve as the "second Toreador" for multiple Toreador Grand Balls. [TOM 19960528]
The first Toreador chosen for the Toreador Grand Ball is unblockable on all non-bleed actions. This remains true even after the vampire attempts a bleed. [LSJ 19970814]
The "does not unlock as normal" effect is redundant with being infernal. If the minion is infernal, his controller can still pay a pool to unlock him. [LSJ 20050114]

text: Choose two ready Toreador you control, put this card in play, and lock one of the two. The locked Toreador does not unlock as normal. The other Toreador's non-bleed actions cannot be blocked. Minions can burn this card as a Ⓓ action; Nosferatu get -1 stealth during that action.

es.name: Justicar Toreador
es.text:
Título.
Elige a un Toreador preparado. Si el referéndum prospera, esta carta se pone en el Toreador elegido para representar el título Camarilla único de Justicar Toreador. En este referéndum, cada Toreador preparado obtiene +1 voto.

fr.name: Justicar Toréador
fr.text:
Titre.
Choisissez un Toréador disponible. Si le référendum passe, cette carte est mise sur le Toréador choisi pour représenter le titre unique de la Camarilla de Justicar Toréador. Durant ce référendum, chaque Toréador disponible reçoit +1 voix.

rulings.text: Only a Camarilla vampire can be chosen, it cannot be played without a valid target. [LSJ 20041026]

Cannot be used or played if the conditions for the terms of the referendum cannot be met (e.g. no legal selection, insufficient cards/players to choose from, prohibited by card text, uniqueness, etc). [LSJ 20100129] [ANK 20191228]

text:
Title.
Choose a ready Toreador. Successful referendum means this card is put on the chosen Toreador to represent the unique Camarilla title of Toreador Justicar. In this referendum, each ready Toreador gets +1 vote.

(Partial reversal of RTR 20010711) [RTR 20020501] [LSJ 19980109]

text:
Only usable in combat with a Toreador, Toreador antitribu, ally or younger vampire.
[pre] Strike: combat ends.
[mel] Strike: combat ends. After combat ends, if this vampire was blocked while performing a non-bleed non-political action, the action continues as if unblocked.
[MEL] As [mel] above, but usable to continue a bleed or political action.

Not usable during the first round of combat.
[nec] Strike: 1R damage.
[NEC] Strike: 1R aggravated damage.
flavor:
Suppose the yesterdays ate up our grand tomorrows?
If the old madness came this way?
Paul Verlaine, "Sagesse", Book One

es.name: Poste arrancado
es.text:
Sólo utilizable antes de determinar la distancia.
[pot] Este vampiro obtiene una fuerza de 2 en este combate.
[POT] Este vampiro obtiene una fuerza de 3 en este combate.

fr.name: Panneau arraché
fr.text:
Seulement utilisable avant l'étape de manœuvre.
[pot] Ce vampire reçoit une force de 2 ce combat.
[POT] Ce vampire reçoit une force de 3 ce combat.

rulings.text: Sets base strength. It can reduce the base strength of a minion (eg. {101645|Rock Cat}). [PIB 20130303]
Any "+X strength" effect adds to it. [LSJ 20100813]

text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[pot] This vampire gets a strength of 2 this combat.
[POT] This vampire gets a strength of 3 this combat.

rulings.text: Is not replaced until the condition is met, even if it is burned. [LSJ 20080805]

text:
Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire moves from torpor to the ready region.
Actions performed by vampires in torpor cost +1 blood. Rescuing an older vampire from torpor costs +1 blood.
flavor:
There is no after for us, and yet there is an after if kine survive.
Anonymous Malkavian, "Das Buch vom Grabkrieg"

text:
Only usable when the opposing vampire goes into torpor. Not usable by a vampire being burned or going to torpor.
Combat ends. You may look at the opposing vampire's controller's hand.
flavor:
To chase one's victim, to prepare one's plan minutely, to slake an implacable vengeance, and then to go to bed... There is nothing sweeter in the world.
Josef Stalin

[dem] Ⓓ Put this card on an ally or younger vampire. The attached minion gets -1 stealth. During their unlock phase, add 1 counter to this card. Burn this card if it has 3 counters.

Only usable when a bleed against you is successful or a referendum passes. Play after resolution.

rulings.text: [abo][REFLEX]Cards are not replaced during the "as played" window. The cancelation must be played immediately: no other effects can be used, except for wakes (eg. neither {100135|The Barrens} nor {100588|Dreams of the Sphinx} can be used). [LSJ 20061207] [RBK playing-a-card] [LSJ 20061013]

[abo][REFLEX]If the canceled card had a "do not replace until" clause (or alternate replacement like {101869|Steely Tenacity}), that clause is canceled as well and the card is replaced normally. [LSJ 20080630] [LSJ 20011023]

[abo][REFLEX]The canceled card has still been played. The same reaction or modifier cannot be played again by the same minion. Any card which text prohibits to play more than once cannot be played again. [ANK 20190104] [RBK cancel-a-card] [LSJ 19980212]
[abo][REFLEX]If a limited effect is canceled (bleed, additional strike), then the limit is not triggered and another limited effect can be used. [LSJ 20030224]
[abo][REFLEX]A card played "as if from hand" can be canceled "as played" [LSJ 20060106]
[abo] [REFLEX] Any frenzy card that targets/selects/chooses/affects the minion when played, is considered being played on the minion. [LSJ 20051113]

[abo][REFLEX]The cost for a canceled non-action-card is still paid, including additional and alternative cost (e.g. to play {100598|Eagle's Sight} to block a Wraith or zombie while {201726|Parijat, the Dark Oracle} is ready the top card of the Library must be burned, even if {100598|Eagle's Sight} was canceled) [RBK cancel-a-card] [ANK 20260216]
Cannot be used while a block is being attempted, or has already been successful. [ANK 20260316] [LSJ 20041022]

[abo]If the action fails, modifiers and reactions that can be used at the end/after an action can still be used afterwards (after combat, if any). [ANK 20221205] [ANK 20220118] [RTR 20180719] [LSJ 20041022]
[abo]If the action fails, the action has reached resolution, so is subject to NRA (Non Repeatable Action) rules. [ANK 20211015] [RTR 20180719]
[abo]If an action fails, it was not blocked. Cards/effects depending on a block (e.g. {101222|Mirror Image}, [FOR] {100788|Freak Drive}) cannot be played/used. [LSJ 20070219]

Only usable when a vampire successfully hunts. Put this card on that vampire. During this vampire's minion phase, he or she must hunt, even if at capacity. Any vampire may burn this card as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action.

rulings.text: Damage inflicted at the end of combat is environmental. [RTR 19970630]
If the acting minion is not ready after the combat, then the action ends and no referendum is conducted. [LSJ 20060902]
The action cost, if any, is paid before Yawp Court gets locked. [LSJ 20080201]
If the acting vampire gets out of torpor immediately (eg. {102149|Warsaw Station}), the action ends and no referendum is conducted. [LSJ 20090325-1]

If {101654|Rötschreck} is played against the acting vampire, the Sabbat vampire takes 2 damage (combat ends before torpor), the acting vampire goes to torpor and no referendum is conducted. [LSJ 20080821]

The effect is applied after cards that are played "at the end of the round (eg. {100549|Disarm}) or "when combat would end". If a combat ends and a new combat would begin, the damage is applied between the two combats and the referendum is conducted after all the combats if the acting vampire is still ready. [ANK 20180910-1] [LSJ 20060903]

text:
Unique location. Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
If a political action is successful, before the referendum, you can lock this location and a ready unlocked Sabbat vampire you control to have that vampire enter combat with the acting vampire. If the acting vampire is still ready at the end of combat, the Sabbat vampire takes 2 environmental damage and the referendum is conducted as normal.

rulings.text: The bonus disappears if the card is burned (either burned by a referendum or if the controller is ousted). [PIB 20121028]

Cannot be used or played if the conditions for the terms of the referendum cannot be met (e.g. no legal selection, insufficient cards/players to choose from, prohibited by card text, uniqueness, etc). [LSJ 20100129] [ANK 20191228]

text: Choose one or more Methuselahs who are not chosen for any other Year of Fortune in play. If this referendum is successful, put this card into play. Each chosen Methuselah gets +1 hand size. Any vampire can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

rulings.text: Cannot be used during a referendum that is automatically passing. [PIB 20150105] [LSJ 19980107]
The ability to fail an action must be used before action modifiers or reactions that are not explicitly played "as the action is announced". [ANK 20190425]
The acting player has the opportunity to play "as announced" effects first (eg. Seduction). [LSJ 20081105]

If the action fails, modifiers and reactions that can be used at the end/after an action can still be used afterwards (after combat, if any). [ANK 20221205] [ANK 20220118] [RTR 20180719] [LSJ 20041022]
If the action fails, the action has reached resolution, so is subject to NRA (Non Repeatable Action) rules. [ANK 20211015] [RTR 20180719]
If an action fails, it was not blocked. Cards/effects depending on a block (e.g. {101222|Mirror Image}, [FOR] {100788|Freak Drive}) cannot be played/used. [LSJ 20070219]

text:
Unique location.
If a ready Banu Haqim you control is the target of a directed action or is chosen by the acting Methuselah in the terms of a referendum, you can lock this location to unlock the acting minion and have the action or referendum fail. Only usable as the directed action is announced or during the polling step of the referendum before votes and ballots are cast.

rulings.text: They may use their built-in action against a vampire with only 1 blood. If successful, that vampire burns his 1 blood. [LSJ 20070213]
If they are burned by a strike, the blood gained from burning them is awarded after strike resolution (it cannot normally not be used to heal from their strike). [LSJ 20080212]

If the action is unblocked when it resolves and the target is unlocked, the action "fizzles" (cost, if any, is paid, and it is considered successful, but has no effect). [ANK 20210124] [LSJ 20070411] [LSJ 20090514]

text:
Unique mortal with 3 life. 2 strength, 0 bleed.
The Young Bloods can burn 2 blood from a locked vampire with a capacity less than 8 as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action. If a vampire controlled by another Methuselah burns the Young Bloods in combat or as an action, he or she gains 2 blood.

rulings.text: May be put on any minion if the controller changes. If the new controller has no minions, it is burned. [RTR 19960112]
An action targeting it (eg. {100391|Conceal}) is directed at the Methuselah controlling it, not the minion it is on. [LSJ 20090324]"
Is an equipment while in hand, library or ash heap, both equipment and location when played (eg. for cost-related effects), and just a location while in play. [LSJ 20080114]
The ability to fail an action must be used before action modifiers or reactions that are not explicitly played "as the action is announced". [ANK 20190425]
The acting player has the opportunity to play "as announced" effects first (eg. Seduction). [LSJ 20081105]

If the action fails, modifiers and reactions that can be used at the end/after an action can still be used afterwards (after combat, if any). [ANK 20221205] [ANK 20220118] [RTR 20180719] [LSJ 20041022]
If the action fails, the action has reached resolution, so is subject to NRA (Non Repeatable Action) rules. [ANK 20211015] [RTR 20180719]
If an action fails, it was not blocked. Cards/effects depending on a block (e.g. {101222|Mirror Image}, [FOR] {100788|Freak Drive}) cannot be played/used. [LSJ 20070219]

text:
While in play, this equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment. Haven. Unique.
Lock as an action directed at this Lasombra is announced to have that action fail. Lock to give this Lasombra +1 stealth. A vampire can have only one haven.

rulings.text: Can only be played by the controller of the acting minion. [LSJ 19990425]
Multiple copies can be played by different minions on the same action. [ANK 20200515]
Can be played any time during the action before resolution; a block attempt is not required. [LSJ 20020612]

text:
Only usable by a ready unlocked Ravnos other than the acting minion.
Allies and vampires younger than this modifying Ravnos get -1 intercept.
flavor:
Belladonna, n. In Italian a beautiful lady; in English a deadly poison. A striking example of the essential identity of the two tongues.
Ambrose Bierce, "The Devil's Dictionary"

rulings.text: Can be played if the action "failed" [RTR 20180719]
Cannot be played if the action "fizzles" (is unblocked at resolution, but has no effect because some requirement cannot be met or cost cannot be paid in full). [ANK 20220218]

Is played after resolution, after all combats (if any) are handled, but still during the action. Action modifiers and effects that can be played "after resolution" can be played before or after it. [PIB 20150915] [LSJ 19981028] [ANK 20190425]
Is played after all combats are handled. Can be played from torpor. [LSJ 20030130] [ANK 20181219] [ANK 20180906]

text:
Only usable after resolution of an unsuccessful action.
[cel] Unlock this vampire at the end of the turn.
[CEL] Unlock this vampire.

+1 stealth action. Requires a ready Sabbat vampire.
Put this card on this acting vampire and move 1 blood from the blood bank to this vampire. This Sabbat vampire can burn this card any time after this turn ends to unlock. A vampire can have only one Zillah's Tears.
flavor:
Caine's Promise is not intended for everyone, but only for his true childer, Zillah's childer, born of her tears.
Blackhorse Tanner, Ventrue antitribu

es.name: El Valle de Zillah
es.text: Añade 4 de sangre a un vampiro de tu zona incontrolada con capacidad 8 o más.
es.flavor:
Y cada noche, durante tres noches, Zillah bebió de su Sire, sin saberlo. Y, a la tercera noche, Caín anunció que se casaría con ella, su chiquilla más dulce, y ella aceptó.
El libro de Nod

fr.name: Vallée de Zillah
fr.text: Ajoutez 4 points de sang à un vampire de capacité 8 ou plus dans votre région incontrôlée.
fr.flavor:
Et chaque nuit, trois nuits durant, Zillah s'abreuva du sang de son Sire, bien qu'elle l'ignorât. La troisième nuit, Caïn annonça qu'il allait épouser Zillah, la plus douce de ses Infantes, et elle accepta.
Le Livre de Nod

text: Add 4 blood to a vampire in your uncontrolled region with capacity 8 or more.
flavor:
And each night, for three nights, Zillah drank from her Sire, though she did not know it. And, on the third night, Caine announced he would marry Zillah, his sweetest Childe, and she agreed.
The Book of Nod

rulings.text: Damage done to the bearer is environmental. [LSJ 19970801]
No damage is done to the bearer if he does not strike with the gun (eg. if it is destroyed with first strike). [LSJ 20100310]
The optional maneuver cannot be used if the strike cannot be used (eg. {100916|Hidden Lurker}). [LSJ 20021028]

text: Before range is determined, put this card on this minion. This card represents an equipment card and doesn't count as a combat card while in play. This equipment is a weapon, gun. Ammo cards cannot be used with this gun. It does 1R damage each strike, with an optional maneuver each combat. Bearer takes 1 damage during strike resolution when striking with this gun, but only once each combat. This card is kept as normal equipment and is not discarded after combat.

+2 stealth action.
Put this card on the acting minion. This minion may burn this card to get +1 stealth.
flavor:
I have always found that plans are useless, but planning is indispensable.
Dwight Eisenhower

rulings.text: The damage is environmental, the retainer is the damage source. Immunity to retainer or retainer type works against it. [ANK 20180612] [ANK 20211127]

Damage is inflicted even against a dodge. A "strike: combat ends" ends combat before damage is applied, as will a combattant going to torpor during first strike. [RTR 19941109] [TOM 19951216] [PIB 20140324] [ANK 20200422]
Does not gain additional strikes from its owner. [RTR 19941109]

text:
Zombie with 2 life.
Zombie inflicts 1 damage on the opposing minion each round of combat during normal strike resolution at close range. This vampire can burn this retainer to gain 2 blood as a +1 stealth action.

rulings.text: The two actions provided are not cross-restrictive. Each can be performed once during the same turn by the same minion. [LSJ 20100909]

text:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. During your master phase, you may choose a location controlled by another Methuselah. Until the end of your minion phase, any minion can move that location to its owner's library as a Ⓓ action (the owner shuffles afterward). If that action is successful, that controller gains X pool, where X is the pool cost of the location. Any vampire can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action. You may lock this card to gain 1 vote in that referendum.

es.name: Zona de caza: Zoo
es.text:
Lugar único. Zona de caza.
Durante tu fase de enderezamiento, un vampiro preparado que controles puede ganar 1 de sangre. Un vampiro puede ganar sangre de sólo una zona de caza por turno.

fr.name: Zoo, terrain de chasse
fr.text:
Lieu unique. Terrain de chasse.
Durant votre phase de redressement, un vampire disponible que vous contrôlez peut gagner 1 point de sang. Un vampire ne peut gagner de points de sang que d'un seul terrain de chasse à chaque tour.

text:
Unique location. Hunting ground.
During your unlock phase, a ready vampire you control can gain 1 blood. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground each turn.
